## 香港演員鍾雪瑩、袁澧林發聲之後，她們分享親歷的性別冒犯

圖像來源，Getty Images

*       *   Author, 余美霞
    *   Role, BBC中文記者

*   Published 23 分鐘前

*   閱讀時間: 8 分鐘

兩位香港知名「90後」女演員近日在網絡社交媒體上，揭露一名本地文藝娛樂記者對她們使用性相關冒犯言論，引發社會迴響。

10月13日，[金馬影后鍾雪瑩](https://www.instagram.com/csy/)先發表限時動態，對該記者以「激罕色慾演出」來描述她在新電影中的演出表達反感。[袁澧林（Angela Yuen）跟帖聲援](https://www.instagram.com/angela.yuen/p/DeZoWaSjYzb/)，發布一則近3000字文章，表示約半年前受訪時，同被對方形容像是「夜總會陪酒」。

袁澧林隨後再講述自己在行業中遭遇的性騷擾經歷。她形容，每一次「小玩笑」都在鞏固「女性被物化的體系」，指出冒犯者「可以是『任何行業』中的『任何人』」。

在香港演藝圈，願意公開談論性別冒犯的女性並不多見。二人的發聲觸發不少網民發帖，分享自己的經歷。BBC中文聆聽四位來自不同行業女性的經歷，了解這類言語冒犯是如何在工作環境中出現；當性別冒犯被包裝成「玩笑」，她們是如何應對。

**【提示：以下內容涉及性相關言語騷擾與冒犯，敬請斟酌閱讀。】**

圖像來源，Getty Images

圖像加註文字，香港女演員鍾雪瑩、袁澧林日前在社交平台上，揭露一名文藝娛樂記者曾對她們使用性相關冒犯言論，引發相當迴響。

## 「他們知道沒有後果」

**鴿子（化名），30歲，香港電影從業者**

其實在Angela發聲之前，我和其他曾受言語騷擾的同事已經想發聲很久，但是一直沒有渠道。我們沒有名氣，你知道吧？槍打出頭鳥。發聲了，我們一定是大輸家。

言語騷擾，我每一天都會遇到。那可以是針對你的身材、外貌，也可以是他們在對話中刻意加入色情元素，目的就是想看到你嬌羞、不知所措，從中獲得支配的快感。

還記得剛剛入行，學院教授特意提醒我，要我再三「想清楚」。他說，「外面的人」不是那麼美好。但那時候，我還沒有感受到這一行業的惡意，反而對創作充滿衝勁。

到大三實習，我迎來了當頭棒喝。當時我在一家本地電視台擔任節目編導。這個由男性主導的行業，九成編輯都是40多歲的男性。我凡是穿短褲上班，有人就會帶頭叫：「有腿看！」然後數個編輯一起湧過來。

他們覺得這樣好玩、在調戲我。我曾向較年輕的男編輯反映不適，卻獲回覆：「你穿短褲，就是對自己身材有自信、想給人看嘛。」我覺得很委屈——我在大學經常穿短褲，從未感受到淫邪的目光。為什麼來到這裡，就會變成是我的刻意展示呢？

到後來畢業正式入行，我才知道原來這樣的凝視和說笑是常態。原因就是因為冒犯者知道你不會反抗，也知道這樣做不會有後果。

言語性騷擾的發生就像呼吸一樣自然，講這些話的人大多都是在行裡打滾很久的前輩。

有人會以「身材好好那個」來形容我；有人每次看到我的腿都會點評「很長」。比如我跟一個前輩打招呼，他會笑着假裝要解開褲子，「拿東西」出來。

又有一次，我看到另一名前輩拿着一瓶褐黃色的液體，問他是不是在撒尿。他笑笑回我：「這瓶口太小了，（我的陽具）裝不下。」

我自問已經算是個性別意識很強的人，也不算怕事。但「愣住」往往是我第一反應。有時候，在場的人會幫忙打圓場，說為我「討公道」。所以無論當下有多生氣，我會覺得「發爛渣（發脾氣、撒潑）」是一件不厚道的事。

圖像來源，PROVIDED

圖像加註文字，香港電影從業者鴿子（化名）表示，在劇組裡每一天都會遇到言語騷擾。

但有一次我真的忍不住。一次臨近下班，一名前輩在眾目睽睽下，把手搭在一位較膽小的女同事肩膀上，連續揑了好幾下。我馬上喝止他：「縮開你的X手！」在場的人都愣住。但那位前輩沒有退開，反而像報復一樣，整個人再挨近那同事。

當我再喝止時，他突然走到我面前，我和他之間只隔了一隻手掌的距離。當下其實我很害怕，不知道他會做什麼事，但我要故作鎮定。對望幾秒後，他氣憤地丟下一句：「整容樣！」然後就走開。

那位前輩在1980年代入行，很多同行都是他帶出來的，所以事情發生時，和我交情不錯的人也不敢出來「做架両（給我撐腰）」。

我有把事情跟上司反映。男部門主管說：「所以我不會給我女兒做這一行。」女高層則表示：「我當年更誇張啦！我有被製片問過要不要跟他回家、又被問有多久沒有跟男朋友做愛。」

演藝行業是一個缺人手的行業，沒有人想把事情鬧大。我覺得很沮喪、絕望。

但其實，我並不覺得這些男性無法理解女性的處境。他們也有跟過同志導演拍戲。在那情況下，這群男人就會自動代入「被害者」的角色——他們害怕自己被侵犯、被凝視。假如他們換位思考，就會知道女生每天都在面對這些不安。

況且他們也不是一視同仁。他們從不會這樣騷擾女高層，反而專挑一些隨和怕事的女生下手。說到底，他們就是欺善怕惡。所以我覺得很不公平。我作為女生，在職場上侊似要付出巨大努力來證明自己，才會機會得到尊重、不再被當作成調戲對象。

但這不就很荒謬嗎？

我很感謝 Angela 願意站出來講話，她的影響力最起碼可以在短時間裡，讓行業裡的人收斂一下。但長遠下去，至少在這行業，最有效的方法始終是由上而下去推動——當有話語權的人設下原則，並且認真和嚴格執行，冒犯才不會再被當作是一個「玩笑」。

圖像來源，PROVIDED

圖像加註文字，鴿子（化名）認為，至少在演藝行業，阻止言語騷擾最有效的方法是由上而下去推動。

## 「你不是記者嗎？自己怎麼不發聲呢？」

**陳子凝（化名），80後，前香港新聞工作者**

我覺得在這一行，最大的壓抑或委屈之一，就是我們經常說要為別人發聲、爭取公義。但諷刺的是，你會發現有些同事在幫別人發聲，但同時會開性別玩笑。這個反差特別大。

大學畢業後，我進了一家本地報章工作。有時我們要跟遊行示威現場採訪，天氣熱，我會穿背心短褲，這時我會被嘲攝影師嘲諷着「很少布」。我成功做了一個獨家訪問，老闆會打趣說：「你訪到他是因為你漂亮」、「你那天是不是穿了短裙出去呀？」

你就會覺得，你好像要比其他人更加努力，才能確保成果不會被視為「性別紅利」。我甚至想過，是不是只要不打扮、隨便穿，大家就會看到我的能力？但我不甘心，因為問題並不在我身上。

受到這些對待的頻率，除了與性別有關，還取決於權力和階層。你的年資決定你的話語權，也影響你會被笑多久。

我當年是一張白紙入行，還很在意如何在行業立足發展、也在意別人的目光。這些不適的經歷會讓你覺得職場本來就是如此、記者圈就是會被開這些玩笑。即使感到委屈，你都必須忍受，因為你是一個新人。

圖像來源，Getty Images

圖像加註文字，在香港新聞界有頗深資歷的陳子凝（化名）發現有些同事幫別人發聲，但同時會開性別玩笑。

有一次，我在立法會完成工作回到大樓記者室，有位攝影師同事扯開嗓子說：「嘩，你像個魚蛋妹（性工作者），如果你是我女兒，我早就打你了。」我不知道當下有多人聽見，有人看了過來，但沒有人出聲。我覺得很受侮辱。

回公司的路上，我和一位要好的男同事分享，說自己真的受不了他。但因為從來沒有人跟我講過，他們也覺得這樣是有問題，所以同一時間，我心裡又會替這位攝影師想藉口：不知道是不是他和女兒有什麼糾紛呢？自己會特別內耗。

況且發聲也不一定有用。有一次，我到國外出差，需要找一個「中間人」牽線。我們約了一頓飯，席間他一直對我毛手毛腳，但因為他能幫我聯絡上需要的人，我只好陪笑。

當時他叫上了一位當地記者出席。在拍照那一刻，他突然抱住我的肩膀，一下子親到我的臉上。我從沒遇過這種情況，嚇到完全說不出話來。同行的攝影記者沒有幫忙，反而跟着一起拍。

離開以後，我馬上私訊編輯。他僅回覆我：「這個地方的人可能是這樣子的，你小心一點。」

小心？我可以小心什麼呢？回來之後，我再跟老闆多講一次，說如果下次有同樣場合，可以找男記者去嗎？老闆說，如果你想，是OK的，但最好還是你去。

我覺得我不被理解、沒有被共情。但我無法理解這種落差——他們經常教我東西，又對我很好，為何卻在騷擾面前，他們好像見慣不怪、只想冷處理？

外界常常覺得記者很堅強、不會軟弱。如果我們被人欺負了，他們會反問：「你不是記者嗎？怎麼自己不出聲呢？」但其實我也只是一個普通人，我們也會有情緒有創傷。更何況我們的圈子很小，我不知道該不該講、也不知該如何講，最後只好自己消化。

不過，現在的我已經學會反駁了。

有部分原因是因為自己長大，也許在這一行做久之後，也開始覺得自己終於有話語權。

當然，社會風氣也有在慢慢改變。我在社交平台看到不少人在現實中會幫忙遭偷拍、被非禮的女生。但有時又會覺得，面對冒犯玩笑，界線還是很模糊：很多人都不知道應不應該出聲，也不知道該不該為了你而得罪人。

所以每次有受害人出來發聲，大家都會覺得這人「很勇敢」——我也覺得 Angela 很勇敢。但又會想，「勇敢」其實也意味着有很多人不敢走出來。

我理解，每個人發聲都有成本。就像在我的經歷中，我沒遇到會為我站出來發聲的人。但我想，也許我可以先成為這個人。

既然過去的講性別玩笑的風氣可以形成，那我們這一代也有機會撐開一些空間，形成另一種社會風氣。我希望有一天，不同性別的人都可以自由、自信；在面對冒犯時不用怪責自己，而是可以直斥其非。

圖像來源，Getty Images

圖像加註文字，陳子凝（化名）強調，記者也只是一個普通人，也會有情緒有創傷。

## 「我不知道什麼才算性騷擾」

**Yan，20歲，澳門留學台灣大學生**

我在大學修讀劇場專業。為了盡早了解舞台的運作，我透過學長找到一份幫忙搭建演唱會舞台的兼職。那是一份體力活，需要爬上爬下、搬箱子，行業裡男性佔絕對多數，比例大約是八比二。

入行都是邊做邊學。天氣很熱，大家都穿短褲，我也跟着穿了一條運動短褲，長度大概只到大腿中間。但我發現，男女生穿短褲面對的目光很不一樣。每次經過那群男性工人，他們都會盯著我雙腿看，令我很不自在。

我聽不懂台語。學長後來轉述給我聽，說這群工人在談論我：「妹妹今天穿短褲，雙腿好漂亮，像網上看到的（女生）一樣。」還有人形容我像「外賣茶」——在台灣，這是性工作者的意思。

我是覺得他們很煩，但我不是那種「一燃即爆」的女生。後來工作時，我只好盡量避免從他們面前經過。

休息時，一名負責管理的女生有私下找我，叫我以後不要穿短褲，說這樣很易受傷，同時隱晦地提醒我，「大家學識水平不是很高」。我聽出了她的弦外之音，也相信她的本意是要保護我。可我覺得怪怪的，為什麼要改變的總是女生？

但其實，我不太理解什麼才真的算是性騷擾。

圖像來源，AFP via Getty Images

圖像加註文字，Yan在舞台兼職時穿短褲，遭遇男性工人的猥褻目光。

中學時在澳門，每天早上我都要坐巴士上學。有好些時間，我會看到一個刻意不拉褲鏈的阿叔。他會跟着女學生上車，站在她們身後。

有一次，他站在我後面，身體貼住我的背。我感受到他的體温，心裡湧出一陣不舒服。可能是怕丟臉，我當時不知所措，也無法避開。後來再見到他，我學會站遠一點。

這件事我沒有跟別人說。但有一次，我再次和他搭同一輛巴士。車上有一位學姐，她突然給我遞來手機，手機裡的備忘錄寫着：「小心你後面有個變態佬」。

我當下很震驚，心想：她應該也有經歷這種騷擾吧。但同時無力感襲來：我們只是中學生，面對這種事，除了互相提醒，我們還能做什麼呢？我們其實什麼都做不了。

這段經歷對我影響很大。它好像給我以後不適的感受定下標準：過去，我即使有人觸碰我的身體，我也沒有出聲，那麼現在遇到色情意味的騷擾，好像也算不上什麼。

離開演唱會舞台工作以後，我報讀了一個健身教練課程。教練比我大八年，才28歲。我的身材比較豐滿。第一次見面時，他就說，如果我跟着他訓練，身材就會變得「有點太好了」，「我會受不了的」。

還有一次，我請教他喝酒對身體的影響。教練說自己很少會喝酒，因為知道自己喝完酒性慾會很高漲。他接着說，但也要看對象，身材不好的女性也不OK，但如果是我的話，他肯定會跟我發生關係。

我感到不適，但還是把它當成「一個玩笑」。我怕如果我認真了，會被人覺得開不起玩笑。我乾笑了兩聲，趕緊中止對話。

「黃色玩笑」真的太常見了。經歷多了，我的腦子好像慢慢有了個開關，自動過濾掉不適的感覺。又或者說，我是麻木了。

圖像來源，Getty Images

圖像加註文字，台灣大學生Yan曾被健身教練以言語騷擾。（資料圖片）

## 「我們是可以出聲的」

**關小姐（化名），36歲，香港公共關係從業員**

我做公關十年了，是直近兩年，我才學習為自己發聲。

我接觸的客戶和公司很廣泛，從學校、美妝、各種消費品到資訊科技都有。正因為這樣，我們面對色情玩笑的機會有很多。

「做PR（公關），穿得那麼密實嗎？」「什麼是PR？夜總會嗎？」又比如我們安排酒店培訓，客人會問：「培訓？是否有人陪瞓（陪睡）先？」在粵語中，「培訓」和「陪睡」同音。

類似的「玩笑」也不只來自男性，女性也會講類似的話。比如面對大客戶，銷售部門的女同事會半開玩笑地提醒：「明天你記得少扣兩個鈕子」、「裙子記得短一點」。

我明白她是想我們落力一點，但每次聽到這些話我都會反白眼，心想：什麼東西啊？久而久之，我都慢慢消化了。我們工作很忙，如果再要花時間處理這些玩笑，實在太累了。後來就會覺得，算了。

更何況我們做公關的，職責就是跟人建立關係——指出別人的不是，不就等於打破關係嗎？如果剛剛入行不久、職位較低，連做錯事都會怕被人解僱，就更加不敢把這些事講出來。

我曾經遇過一位自己以為關係不錯的記者。在一次完成專訪以後，他突然挽着我手臂，說要跟我「拍拖拖」。公司從沒有教過我們該如何應對這種狀況，我整個人立馬僵硬，不懂反應。我找機會先鬆開他的手，再刻意提起男朋友。我想暗示他：我是有男朋友的，請你不要再碰我。

事後我不斷思忖，為什麼我當下不能直接拒絕他？第一，我真的很害怕。第二，我怕以後的訪問報導很難刊登、見面會很尷尬。一輪覆盤過後，我就會轉過來怪自己了——明明感到不舒服了，為什麼要這樣委屈自己？

圖像來源，Getty Images

圖像加註文字，根據香港平等機會委員會「2021年全港性騷擾調查」，結果顯示有接近12%受訪者在過去兩年曾遭職場性騷擾。（資料圖片）

做公關，我們習慣做事說話都要包裝、講求圓滑。又有一次，活動結束後趕着發新聞稿，我請客人和我一起在電腦前確認照片。他突然說：「照片這麼隨意被別人看嗎？不會是什麼私密照吧？」

我當下很生氣，臉色立刻沉了下來，這句話真的很過分。但我還要保持禮貌跟客人說：「我不喜歡你說話的方式，請你尊重」。那客人裝作聽不到，事件也就這樣過去了。

其實我有想過要他道歉，但事情不是那麼簡單。很多時候冒犯發生得很快，當下如果沒有立即反應，時機就過了。出來工作以後，首先考慮的通常都不是自己的感受，而是會不會得罪客人、連累同事。這是很難過的事。

直到近兩年，社會經驗多了，我開始學習多愛自己一點，遇到不合理的事就要去反抗。社會風氣也改變了，我看到越來越多是互相聲援被人騷擾的女性，就像最近大家都稱自己是「Jane Doe」一樣，我很受感動。

還有，Gen Z 也有影響到我。人們常說「00後整頓職場」，我覺得是真的！他們界線分明，懂得說不。我才發現原來勇敢說出來，才會爭取到想要的東西。

現在自己懂得分辨哪些算是冒犯的玩笑，如果我看到下屬因為這些說話難堪，我也會指出來。當然，出聲未必會得到想要的結果。但至少出了聲，對方有所收斂，已經能讓我感到舒服一點、釋懷一些。

## 用玩笑包裝，把「試底線」合理化

圖像來源，Getty Images

圖像加註文字，「Anti 480」反性暴力資源中心資深教育主任尹智豪指出，性騷擾深受社會文化形塑，很難單靠當事人發聲改變風氣。

根據香港平等機會委員會[《2021年全港性騷擾調查》](https://www.eoc.org.hk/en/Articles/Detail/632)結果，在3,928名受訪者中，有接近12%在過去兩年曾遭職場性騷擾，最常見的形式是「有關性的話題或笑話」。

台灣勞動部則在2026年公布[《職場就業平等調查》](https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1633/88356/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)， 顯示在4,802名女性受訪者中，有3.3%人在過去一年遭受職場性騷擾；當中超過一半人沒有提出申訴，主因是把事件「當開玩笑」。

香港「Anti 480」反性暴力資源中心資深教育主任尹智豪向BBC中文表示，男性和女性同樣均會受到性別言語騷擾，取笑的方向和承受的壓力有所不同——女性較多集中在身材、外貌，以及牽連性騷擾的玩笑。而男性較多面對有關男子氣概、性別氣質的玩笑。

尹智豪指出，「玩笑」很常是言語冒犯者把「試底線」合理化的方法，「試下某個人的底線可以去到哪裡，如果那個人反抗，就（以玩笑作）藉口將責任推回受害者身上」。

他強調，即使言語騷擾沒有對受害者造成身體直接傷害，但受害者也會因為無法脫離共同社交圈子，以及擔心冒犯持續發生而承受精神和社交壓力。

尹智豪指出，性騷擾深受社會文化形塑，比起單靠當事人發聲拒絕，若身旁的人能主動幫忙制止，或身處的企業學校等環境主動建立應對機制，同會有助改變文化。

# Worker electrocuted and burned in fire at Hong Kong Cultural Centre backstage

A 29-year-old female worker suffered third-degree burns after an electrical fault sparked a fire at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui. Authorities are investigating whether the Electricity Ordinance was violated, as she is not a registered electrical worker.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 20 Oct 2026 at 01:13 HKT · updated 20 Oct, 04:24 · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Worker%20electrocuted%20and%20burned%20in%20fire%20at%20Hong%20Kong%20Cultural%20Centre%20backstage%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Worker-electrocuted-and-burned-in-fire-at-Hong-Kong-Cultural-aec61f "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Worker-electrocuted-and-burned-in-fire-at-Hong-Kong-Cultural-aec61f&text=Worker%20electrocuted%20and%20burned%20in%20fire%20at%20Hong%20Kong%20Cultural%20Centre%20backstage "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Worker-electrocuted-and-burned-in-fire-at-Hong-Kong-Cultural-aec61f "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Worker-electrocuted-and-burned-in-fire-at-Hong-Kong-Cultural-aec61f&text=Worker%20electrocuted%20and%20burned%20in%20fire%20at%20Hong%20Kong%20Cultural%20Centre%20backstage "X")[](mailto:?subject=Worker%20electrocuted%20and%20burned%20in%20fire%20at%20Hong%20Kong%20Cultural%20Centre%20backstage&body=Worker%20electrocuted%20and%20burned%20in%20fire%20at%20Hong%20Kong%20Cultural%20Centre%20backstage%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Worker-electrocuted-and-burned-in-fire-at-Hong-Kong-Cultural-aec61f "Email")

A 29-year-old female worker suffered third-degree burns to her face and hands after an electrical fault sparked a fire at the backstage of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui on Monday morning.

The incident occurred around 11.25am at the main auditorium backstage at 10 Salisbury Road. The woman, surnamed Chow, was dismantling a power distribution box when an operational error caused an electric shock and sparks, burning her face and hands.

Paramedics applied cooling dressings and took her to hospital conscious. She is in the intensive care unit in stable condition.

CLP staff checked and confirmed the main power supply was normal. An Electrical and Mechanical Services Department engineer said the fire was caused by a short circuit in a high-voltage switch. The Labour Department attended and preliminarily classified the case as an industrial accident.

The EMSD said the injured woman is not a registered electrical worker and is investigating whether anyone violated the Electricity Ordinance. It said the stage renter's registered electrical contractor was dismantling fixed electrical installations, and it is initially suspected the woman touched a live part during electrical work, causing a short circuit and fire. The department has cut off power to the damaged installation and issued an improvement notice to its owner.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said an outsourced worker of a renting arts group was injured while dismantling stage equipment backstage at the Grand Theatre and was taken to hospital. Cultural centre operations were not affected, and the LCSD, EMSD and Labour Department are investigating.

title: Explainer: What is Africa Bitcoin Corporation and why did it make the FSCA mad?
summary: Africa Bitcoin Corporation Limited (ABC), the business formerly known as Altvest Capital Limited, has a complex corporate history of frequent strategic shifts, multiple exchange transfers, governance turbulence, complex internal accounting
content:
Africa Bitcoin Corporation Limited (ABC), the business formerly known as Altvest Capital Limited, has a complex corporate history of frequent strategic shifts, multiple exchange transfers, governance turbulence, complex internal accounting structures, and, more recently, severe regulatory enforcement.

It was originally established in 2021/2022 with a lofty stated goal of “democratising access to alternative private equity assets for retail investors via specialised preference share classes”.

Then the group pivoted in 2025 into what it called “Africa’s first listed bitcoin treasury company”.

But while the company rebranded and began to accumulate bitcoin reserves, its core financial engine remains tied to small-to-medium enterprise (SME) private credit loan book through its subsidiary, the Altvest Credit Opportunities Fund (ACOF).

> ### **Wait, what’s a bitcoin treasury company?**
>
>
>
> Glad you asked. This strategy play was made famous when Michael Saylor and his software company MicroStrategy started buying BTC in August 2020 because the then CEO believed it to be a superior store of value than cash. When the market turned bearish in 2022, Saylor took it as a market signal to buy the dip and maximise future gains.
>
>
> He eventually stepped down as CEO and serves as executive chairman, the company dropped the Micro from its name and is now only known as Strategy – and it has continued accumulating a
>
> [massive holding of what is now 848,517 BTC](https://www.strategy.com/ledger)
> .
>
>
> By contrast, according to the company’s financial disclosures and Sens announcements, ABC holds 5.5331 BTC in total as of May 2026. It’s first bitcoin purchase happened in February 2025 when the price was $96,195 – about $14,000 more than the current bitcoin price.
>
>
> ABC uses its bitcoin as security (like putting up a house as collateral for a bank mortgage) to borrow money overseas at under 4% interest. They can then turn around and lend that cheaper money to small businesses in Mzansi at normal market rates, making much bigger profit margins.
>
>
> As the company buys more bitcoin over time, each share of ABC stock is backed by a slightly larger fraction of bitcoin. When bitcoin’s price dropped in late 2025 and early 2026, accounting rules required ABC to lower the listed value of the bitcoin on its official balance sheet; which then showed a paper loss of about R2.4-million on the R7.8-million they spent acquiring it.
>
>
> But because the ABC policy is to HODL (hold on for dear life) its coins and did not sell them during the price dip, no actual money was lost. So until the debt covenants come due, everything is still fine and dandy and hopefully the price recovers.

But that’s not why Warren Wheatley was called to the FSCA naughty step alongside his wife, former Miss South Africa Tatum Keshwar-Wheatley, and former chief investment officer Akshay Karan (brother of Banker X founder and CEO and former Altvest executive chairman, Koshiek Karan). The trio were issued 20-year debarment orders and R9-million in total administrative penalties in August 2026 for market manipulation during 2022.

And in September 2026, the FSCA opened a second active investigation into potential market manipulation involving ABC securities traded during April and May 2026.

Wheatley and Karan both resigned from their positions and are contesting the debarment order in their private capacity.

Which brings us to October 2026, when Wheatley’s associate vehicle (WGW Capital) led a consortium (comprising owners of a collective 71.8%-76% holding) shareholder demand that forced the resignation of the independent chairperson and board members.

### **Exchange hopping**

Since debuting on the Cape Town Stock Exchange (CTSE) in May 2022, the company has treated stock exchanges like a pub crawl.

Within four months of its CTSE debut, it added a secondary listing on A2X. By October 2024, it abandoned the CTSE altogether for the JSE’s AltX. Late 2025 saw a flurry of cross-border activity: secondary listings in Namibia (NSX), over-the-counter trading in the US (OTCQB), and a quote on the Frankfurt bourse. By May 2026, it had graduated to the JSE Main Board, with plans to list on the UK’s Aquis Growth Market, well, until October’s boardroom implosion forced management to slam the brakes on London.

For a micro-cap firm, this kind of hyperactive listing velocity rarely builds deep liquidity. Instead, it spreads compliance costs thin and creates the illusion of global momentum while the underlying assets struggle to perform.

But if the listing strategy was restless, the audit rotation was a growing concern. Cycling through three external auditing firms in four years is the corporate equivalent of changing mechanics every time someone tells you your brakes need skimming.

Deloitte audited the FY2022 and FY2023 books before asking to be released in October 2023. BDO South Africa stepped in, only to resign two years later in October 2025.

[![Image 1: bitcoin](https://cdn.dailymaverick.co.za/i/fpMp-t0X4i6w-1U7DdDkY2bDJ6s=/200x100/smart/filters:strip_exif()/file/attachments/2999/Screenshot2026-10-19at202003_917961.png)](https://africabitcoincorporation.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/ABC_Investor_Deck_Q3_2026_UK.pdf)

Latest ABC investor prospectus deck.

BDO didn’t leave quietly; it cited international group audit rules (ISA 600), pointing out that because ABC’s new Bitcoin subsidiary held the group’s primary growth assets that were audited by a different firm, BDO couldn’t verify the group numbers without blindly trusting third-party working papers.

Forvis Mazars took over the hot seat in November 2025 on the strength of its digital asset expertise.

### **Keeping it in the family**

While auditors came and went, cash was flowing steadily toward insiders. In 2023, the company paid R9.81-million for the business and intellectual property of Mark Barnes’ Kisby Capital Partners (KCP). On the other side of the table was Altvest CEO Warren Wheatley, who served as an executive director of KCP and whose family trust (WGW Family Trust) held a 22.5% stake in the business being bought.

Meanwhile, marketing, media and investor relations were outsourced to Tatum Keshwar Investments – a private consultancy run by Wheatley’s spouse – for substantial consultancy fees. Even within the group structure, the parent company kept the lights on by extracting R7.8-million in shared service fees and R7.1-million in management fees from its own SME debt fund subsidiary, the Altvest Credit Opportunities Fund (ACOF).

> ### **Building the shareholder tower**
>
>
>
> But to understand why the balance sheet looks so strained, you have to look at the original model. Between 2021 and 2024, Altvest sold _Preferred Ordinary Shares_ tied to specific, ring-fenced assets:
>
>
> **Class A shares** bought a 50% stake in Umganu Luxury Lodge alongside former cricketer Kevin Pietersen. While private share sales by Pietersen implied a R46-million valuation for the lodge, it remains an illiquid, unlisted luxury property that is famously difficult to exit or turn into cash.
>
>
> **Class B shares** targeted a 46% stake in the family-restaurant chain Bambanani Group, though capital raise shortfalls left Altvest with just 19% of the ordinary shares.
>
>
> **Class C shares** backed the ACOF private credit fund.
>
>
> Because these hybrid shares behave partly like debt and partly like equity, accounting for them under IFRS standards turns simple Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations into a structural headache.

It was then when the fractionalised SME model failed to set the market alight (the stated reason for buying KCP), and with the group swinging from an R11.81-million profit in FY2025 to a R5.91-million net loss in the six months to August 2025, that management tore up the playbook and reached for Saylor’s strategy to pitch itself under JSE ticker BAC as a crypto-treasury hedge against a depreciating rand.

Beneath the Bitcoin rebrand, the old plumbing was creaking. Not only was ABC charging its ACOF debt fund millions in management fees, it was also borrowing from it.

ABC issued an unsecured R11.55-million promissory note to ACOF at the prime interest rate. When ABC couldn’t pay it back by the March 2026 deadline, ACOF’s board simply extended the repayment date to June.

African Bitcoin Corporation executive chairman Stafford Masie came to the Adopting Bitcoin Conference at the V&A Waterfront, Cape Town, with massive news about Eskom’s bitcoin ambitions. (Photo: Lindsey Schutters)

### **Check the engine**

Where did ACOF get its firepower? Largely from a R75-million credit facility provided by the state-backed Small Enterprise Development Finance Agency (SEDFA) at prime less 0.55%.

To secure that taxpayer-backed loan, directors and shareholders had to pledge personal assets and sign guarantees _in solidum_ – including the ABC shares held by Wheatley’s WGW Capital.

If you study the 251 pages of SENS announcements and the audited financial reports, it reveals that the pledge created a dangerous feedback loop: the founder’s control of the listed company was now directly tied to the debt obligations of its subsidiary.

The tension between founder control and independent oversight finally snapped in late 2025 and 2026. First came the quiet exits of heavyweight independent directors: Audit Chair Khaya Sithole, Buyisiwe Makhunga, and Bright Khumalo all walked away around the turn of the year.

Then came the FSCA pressure.

Crypto Corner

[Go to page](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/newsletter/crypto-corner/archive/2810/)

Rather than stepping back, Wheatley’s investment vehicle, WGW Capital, went to war with the remaining board. Using Section 61(3) of the Companies Act, WGW demanded an urgent shareholder meeting to install its own slate of directors.

When the independent board pushed back on governance grounds, WGW filed a supplementary demand to have the sitting directors removed immediately.

On 9 October 2026, the governance machine stuttered to a halt. Chairperson Norma Sephuma, interim CEO Stafford Masie and independent directors Snowy Masakale and GG Alcock resigned en masse, stating plainly that they had irresolvable differences with the majority shareholder.

ABC wrapped a loan book balance sheet in the language of a bitcoin treasury revolution, and tried listing itself from Cape Town to Frankfurt, but it can’t outrun the consequences of accumulative actions. **DM**

As seasons signal the waning months of 2026, the U.S. Army’s operational map continues to evolve. New commands and force restructuring have put greater emphasis on the Western Hemisphere and Indo-Pacific, while the ongoing conflict with Iran and Ukraine’s fight against Russia have complicated the force posture in U.S. Central Command’s area of operations and what might have been a troop drawdown in Europe, respectively. Taken together, the moves offer a snapshot of locations the Army prioritized in 2026, and where it might turn its focus next. Western Hemisphere In a sweeping force restructure, the Army stood up a new Western Hemisphere Command in late 2025, consolidating three major commands under a single headquarters at Fort Bragg, North Carolina. The move aligns with the 2026 National Defense Strategy , which prioritized defending the “U.S. Homeland” and the Western Hemisphere over the U.S.’s persistent goal of opposing China. The service shuttered some of its global advisory brigades, retaining only two Security Force Assistance Brigades, or SFABs . One of the remaining SFABs is regionally aligned to U.S. Southern Command, and the Army reported that the Western Hemisphere Command would assume responsibilities previously shouldered by the Security Force Assistance Command. U.S. Southern Command also activated Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere in August, creating a standing headquarters to coordinate regional operations with 18 partner nations and target cartels and other transnational criminal networks. The Army also, in partnership with Panama, revived its jungle school course in the Central American country after a decades-long hiatus. Officials have said that maintaining jungle warfare skills is applicable in the Indo-Pacific region as well. Central Command Force posture in the Central Command area of operations — spanning the Middle East, Central and South Asia, and Northeast Africa — continues to change. In mid-April, U.S. troops shut down several American bases in Syria , handing them over to government forces and ending a 10-year presence in the country. Last month, the U.S. formally left Iraq after more than two decades of war, spurring warnings from security experts who say the withdrawal could give Iran, its allies and the Islamic State increased freedom to operate in the country. However, amid the U.S.’s war with Iran, the U.S. has extended an 82nd Airborne Division deployment to the region, keeping troops for a total of one year. In February, the Army announced that a brigade from the 10th Mountain Division was set to deploy to the region as well, though it did not provide a specific timeline. Speaking broadly about the force — not just the Army — a senior U.S. official told Reuters in June that the U.S. planned to maintain its robust military presence in the region as hostilities between the U.S. and Iran persist. Europe In the European theater, the U.S. Army’s force posture appears to be in flux. Shortly after the Army abruptly scrapped the planned deployment of the 2nd Armored Brigade Combat Team, 1st Cavalry Division, to Poland, the Pentagon announced in May it was deploying 5,000 troops to the country. Defense Department spokesperson Sean Parnell called the surge a “temporary delay” of the Trump administration’s plan to reduce the number of Brigade Combat Teams assigned to Europe from four to three. This summer, the Pentagon launched a broad review of U.S. troops, bases and force posture across Europe. The review, which is expected to take up to six months, comes after the Trump administration’s calls for European countries to take on heftier NATO defense responsibilities. Still, the Army continues to participate in multinational training exercises in Europe, like Dynamic Front 2026 and Exercise Saber Junction. Europe’s theater has been particularly rife with lessons about drone warfare. Maj. Gen. Christopher Norrie, the acting Commanding General of U.S. Army Europe and Africa, said in a September briefing that troops rotated through the Army’s “training support mission” in Ukraine’s capital to learn about drone units. Indo-Pacific Deterrence appeared to define the Indo-Pacific theater in 2026. “In the big scheme of things, our highest duty is to deter,” Gen. Ronald Clark, commander of U.S. Army Pacific, told Military Times in an interview . Earlier in the year, Exercise Balikatan 2026 — the largest drill of the series yet — was held in the Philippines and included troops from the Philippines, the U.S., Australia, Canada, France, Japan and New Zealand. The exercise’s focus, Clark said, had shifted over the years from counterterrorism to “large-scale combat operations.” Though Chinese leader Xi Jinping ordered troops to seize Taiwan by 2027, the outlying island is conspicuously absent from the 2026 National Defense Strategy. In June, the Army launched a new Indo-Pacific multi-domain command that brought together conventional forces and the Cross Domain Contact Layer, a continuous network that combines sensors, drones, precision weapons, artificial intelligence, electronic warfare and more. According to a May 2025 executive order, the Army plans to create four such commands, including one Multi-Domain Command—Japan. Africa The Army has reduced some of its Africa-focused force structure, shuttering the 2nd Security Force Assistance Brigade, previously aligned with U.S. Africa Command , late last year. The command has seen a 75% force drawdown in the last ten years, creating what Gen. Dagvin Anderson, the command’s top leader, described in testimony before Congress as “an intelligence black hole,” and said the organization was operating with “minimum necessary resources.” The U.S. special operations task force in Somalia posted an ad for three cultural and political advisors in late May. The Arctic The Marine Corps announced this year that it is moving troops deeper into Alaska with an initiative — aptly called “Campaign - Alaska” — designed to build a more persistent presence in the Arctic and prepare service members for extreme cold-weather operations. The new rotating force will train and experiment in the frigid conditions and will likely add to interservice operations and exercises with partners like the Army’s Alaska-based 11th Airborne Division. While the Army announced no major force posture changes in Alaska or the Arctic, the Army Corps of Engineers is working to expand where troops can operate in the region. Researchers are developing new standards for landing Black Hawks and Chinooks on frozen lakes after testing found that aircraft could land on thinner ice than previous Army doctrine allowed, possibly opening up 25% more terrain for aviation operations.

# China pulls ahead of the US in Africa’s copper race as Congo arrests 300 Chinese nationals over illegal mining

[Awogbemila Temitope](https://africa.businessinsider.com/author/awogbemila-temitope "Awogbemila Temitope")

**China has established a massive lead over the United States and other Western competitors in securing critical minerals across the African continent. However, that dominant global foothold is facing sudden local friction after authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo detained approximately 300 Chinese nationals during a major security crackdown on unauthorized mining operations in the country's copper heartland.**

Congo law enforcers [Source: mining]

*   China holds a dominant position in securing critical minerals across Africa, outpacing Western competitors.
*   Authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo detained about 300 Chinese nationals during a crackdown on illegal mining in the copper-rich region of Kolwezi.
*   The crackdown highlights the legal and regulatory complexities China faces as it expands its mineral interests in central Africa.
*   Massive Chinese investment has significantly increased Congo’s copper production, but unauthorized mining on private concessions remains a major issue.

The enforcement action reveal the complex legal and regulatory challenges accompanying China's multi-billion-dollar mineral expansion in central Africa.

### DR Congo detains 300 Chinese nationals in copper hub crackdown

[Security forces](https://africa.businessinsider.com/local/markets/a-powerful-african-military-considers-joining-pakistan-and-turkey-in-defending-saudi/y5e0nvc) from Congo's National Security Council and immigration authorities carried out a targeted operation in the mining hub of Kolwezi, taking around 300 Chinese workers into custody.

ADVERTISEMENT

According to a report by miningmx, officials conducted the arrests over _"their alleged involvement in illegal mining on concessions belonging to other companies"._

While massive Chinese investments have allowed the [Democratic Republic of the Congo](https://africa.businessinsider.com/local/lifestyle/african-mineral-powerhouse-dr-congo-bars-contact-with-former-colonial-ruler-over/4l81k1y) to triple its copper output since 2015 (becoming the world's second-largest copper producer) unauthorized mining on private corporate concessions remains a persistent challenge.

Following formal diplomatic intervention by the Chinese embassy in Kinshasa, local authorities released several of the detained workers.

### China beats the US in securing Africa's critical minerals supply chain

Beijing's long-term industrial planning has given state-backed companies a decisive lead over Western rivals in controlling raw materials needed for [electric vehicles](https://africa.businessinsider.com/transportation/the-era-of-the-400-mile-range-ev-is-upon-us/qjvlc5d), defense systems, and clean energy technology.

ADVERTISEMENT

China currently commands over half of global [critical minerals](https://africa.businessinsider.com/local/markets/us-makes-3-strategic-moves-across-africas-mineral-belt-as-washington-chases-critical/6wdqbl5) production and roughly 87% of global processing and refining capacity.

In a report published by the Africa Center for Strategic Studies, expert Paul Nantulya notes that _"China has gained a dominant position in Africa's critical minerals sector through long-term investments in mining and refining capacity"._

Mercuria confirmed that 12,000 tonnes of Congolese copper entered Project Vault during the week of 12 October. [Mercuria] BI Africa

Within 20 years, Beijing channeled approximately $24 billion in transition mineral loans and credit to [African nations](https://africa.businessinsider.com/local/lifestyle/10-african-countries-with-the-highest-freedom-scores-according-to-latest-ranking/4xq8lxk), acquiring major mining assets in countries like Botswana, Mali, Tanzania, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

[In the Democratic Republic of the Congo](https://africacenter.org/spotlight/china-africa-critical-minerals/?utm_source=chatgpt.com), which is the world's primary producer of cobalt, 24 of the 33 exporting mining firms are Chinese-owned.

title: Chinese Experts on China-U.S. Strategic Stability and What It Means for Canada - Tessera Institute for Global Affairs
summary: _Briefing by Anonymous Researcher with Tessera Institute_ Just over four months after U.S. President Donald Trump’s state visit to Beijing, Chinese President Xi Jinping traveled to Washington on September 23, 2026, for his first U.S. state
content:
_Briefing by Anonymous Researcher with Tessera Institute_

Just over four months after U.S. President Donald Trump’s state visit to Beijing, Chinese President Xi Jinping traveled to Washington on September 23, 2026, for his first U.S. state visit in 11 years. While Canadian observers and media have offered their own assessments of the visit and its implications for Canada, Chinese analysts’ perspectives offer a complementary lens for examining prospects for greater stability in China-U.S. relations and what this could mean for Ottawa’s foreign policy choices.

Chinese media coverage of the summit repeatedly highlighted Trump’s unusual planeside welcome at Joint Base Andrews and the Chinese elements incorporated into the state-dinner menu. More broadly, the meeting was portrayed as a continuation of what Beijing called “constructive strategic stability,” a new formulation for characterizing bilateral relations that China introduced during Trump’s visit in May. At the September summit, China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) further elaborated on the concept, adding the phrase “on the basis of respect, fairness, and reciprocity” to its statement on the meeting. Comments from two established Chinese scholars Wu Xinbo and Su Xiaohui, provide insight into how their assessments of the relationship differed between May and September.

Wu Xinbo and Su Xiaohui stood out as two of the few scholars interviewed about both state visits, offering a valuable opportunity to compare commentary on the two summits.

Wu Xinbo, Dean of Fudan University’s Institute of International Studies and Director of its Center for American Studies, is a prominent scholar of China-U.S. relations and American foreign policy. Fudan’s Center for American Studies is one of China’s leading institutions specializing in U.S. affairs and maintains close ties with China’s foreign-policy establishment, including the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Wu himself has served on the MFA’s Foreign Policy Advisory Group. His May interview appeared in _Zhengshier_, a well-known political-affairs platform produced by _The Beijing News_, while his September interview was with _Caijing_, an influential magazine known for its coverage of economic and policy affairs.

Su Xiaohui, Deputy Director of the Institute of American Studies at the China Institute of International Studies (CIIS), has an even closer institutional connection to China’s foreign policy apparatus: CIIS is a research institution directly affiliated with the MFA and a designated national high-end think tank. Su was interviewed by _China.com_ in May, a major Chinese online media platform that frequently uses experts to interpret major domestic and international developments, and by _Changjiang News_ in September, an international-affairs commentary program produced by Hubei Media Group.

These interviews offer insight into establishment-linked public commentary rather than a representative picture of Chinese scholarly opinion or direct evidence of internal policymaking.

In May, Wu’s and Su’s assessments of the relationship were broadly positive, though they differed in emphasis. When China’s MFA first introduced the concept of “constructive strategic stability,” both scholars focused on its potential to provide a more stable and constructive framework for the relationship. [Wu](https://m.bjnews.com.cn/detail/1778932185129681.html) described the stability as not temporary, but strategic and sustainable, pointing to the possibility of a lasting improvement in bilateral relations under the new framework. [Su](http://fangtan.china.com.cn/2026-05/17/content_118498341.htm), meanwhile, pointed out that the relationship remained difficult, but the two sides had incentives to prevent further deterioration, manage competition, and gradually improve cooperation. Her comments suggested that stability would depend on continued communication and gradual progress rather than the resolution of underlying differences.

By September, [Wu](https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1877570554665594549&wfr=spider&for=pc)’s assessment had become more measured, with greater emphasis on the practical challenges of sustaining strategic stability. He acknowledged that competition would continue and could sometimes produce confrontation, framing strategic stability as a way to manage rather than eliminate those tensions. [Su](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/umKbhzC3j1vqtfXfNSVyMA)’s assessment, by contrast, remained broadly consistent with her May position. She continued to emphasize dialogue, practical cooperation and gradual progress, while recognizing the complexity of China-U.S. economic and trade relations and stressing that not all problems could be resolved at once. Taken together, the two interviews suggest less a broad shift from optimism to pragmatism than a growing emphasis on the practical work required to sustain a more stable relationship. This emphasis was also reflected in the MFA’s official formulation, in which the addition of “respect, fairness, and reciprocity” suggests that strategic stability is being framed less as a resolution of China-U.S. differences than as a framework for managing them.

The fact that the White House’s September readout also used the formulation “on the basis of respect, fairness, and reciprocity” suggests some convergence between Beijing and Washington on how the relationship should be managed, even as significant differences remain. For Canada, this development may matter less for removing strategic constraints than for greater predictability within them. A more stable China-U.S. relationship could give Ottawa additional room for maneuver in managing its relations with both powers, particularly when pursuing Canadian economic and diplomatic interests that do not always align neatly with Washington’s priorities. It could also create more favorable conditions for Canada to engage Beijing on areas of mutual interest while continuing to address its security concerns and maintain close ties with the United States. Such stability would not eliminate the pressures Canada faces from strategic competition, but it could make those pressures easier to navigate and allow Ottawa to pursue its interests more deliberately.

### Sources

*   _Sina Finance_, “Exclusive Interview with Wu Xinbo: How Can China and the United States Move Toward a Constructive Relationship of Strategic Stability?” September 28, 2026.
*   _Changjiang News_, “Su Xiaohui: To Implement the Leaders’ Consensus, China and the United States Need to Move Toward Each Other,” September 2026.
*   _ZhengShier_, “Exclusive Interview with Wu Xinbo: Discussing Trump’s Visit to China,” May 16, 2026.
*   _China.com_, “Trump’s Visit to China Opens a New Positioning for China-U.S. Relations; Head-of-State Diplomacy Builds Momentum for a Major Year,” May 17, 2026.

title: CCTV cameras at Hong Kong malls to be linked to police surveillance network, says security chief
zh_title: 保安局长表示，香港商场的闭路电视摄像机将与警方监控网络相连
summary: 保安局局长邓克里斯 (Chris Tang) 周日告诉 TVB，警方正在将全市商场的闭路电视摄像机与其人工智能 SmartView 监控系统连接起来。旺角的闭路电视摄像机。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。唐没有透露具体涉及的商场，但表示警方正处于与私人购物中心讨论的最后阶段，目标是到 2028 年将 60,000 个摄像头纳入综合警察系统。“我们看到，在一些没有闭路电视的地方，公众不想参观，因为它们很危险，人们担心成为犯罪的受害者，”唐在《Can》中说
content:
保安局局长邓克里斯 (Chris Tang) 周日告诉 TVB，警方正在将全市商场的闭路电视摄像机与其人工智能 SmartView 监控系统连接起来。旺角的闭路电视摄像机。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。唐没有透露具体涉及的商场，但表示警方正与私人购物中心进行最后阶段的讨论，目标是到 2028 年将 60,000 个摄像头纳入综合警察系统。“我们看到，在一些没有闭路电视的地方，公众不想参观，因为它们很危险，人们担心成为犯罪的受害者，”唐用粤语说。另请参阅：作为 40 亿港元扩张计划的一部分，香港警方今年可能会在闭路电视摄像机中添加面部识别功能。他补充说，警方是否能够获得 24 小时实时直播，或者只是下载数据，将取决于该地点的犯罪风险。唐说，在犯罪热点地区，“可能需要实时监控”。保安局局长邓克里斯于 2023 年 9 月 27 日会见记者。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。根据 2026 年的立法文件，SmartView 是一项政府举措，旨在在香港“犯罪率高、人流量大的公共场所”安装闭路电视摄像机。唐周日表示，可能没有必要告知公众新摄像头已连接到警察网络，因为许多商场已经张贴了录音警告标志。
另请参阅：警方新计划将人工智能闭路电视覆盖范围扩大到公共住宅区，引发隐私问题 去年 10 月，警方宣布在公共住宅区推出警察摄像头网络。闭路电视扩展，具有面部识别功能 作为 SmartView 在 2026 年至 2028 年第二阶段推出的一部分，政府计划每年增加 20,000 个监控摄像头，包括设置新摄像头以及将私人摄像头和来自不同政府部门的摄像头连接到警察网络。警方 SmartView 闭路电视系统。照片：香港政府一站通。作为 SmartView 第三阶段的一部分，当局的目标是从 2028 年到 2031 年增加 6,500 个监控摄像头。今年二月，警察局长周祖表示，当局计划“在今年内”将面部识别功能纳入警方管理的闭路电视摄像机中。去年10月，警察行动部高级警司梁铭良表示，迄今为止，监控系统已协助破获超过480起刑事案件，并逮捕了超过840人。它还被用于人群控制和台风期间协助当局。

【原文 English Original】
The police are linking CCTV cameras at malls across the city to its AI-enabled SmartView surveillance system, Secretary for Security Chris Tang told TVB on Sunday. A CCTV camera in Mong Kok. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Without naming the malls involved, Tang said the police force was in the final stages of discussion with private shopping centres, with an aim of bringing 60,000 cameras into the integrated police system by 2028. “[W]e see that in some places without CCTV, members of the public do not want to visit because they are dangerous and people fear becoming victims of crime,” Tang said in Cantonese. See also: Hong Kong police may add facial recognition to CCTV cameras this year as part of HK$4 billion expansion plan He added that whether police will have access to a 24-hour live feed, or just the ability to download data, would depend on the location’s crime risk. At crime hotspots, “real-time monitoring might be needed,” Tang said. Secretary for Security Chris Tang meets the press on September 27, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. SmartView is a government initiative to install CCTV cameras across Hong Kong’s “public places with high crime rate and pedestrian flow,” according to a 2026 legislative paper. Tang said on Sunday that it may not be necessary to inform the public about new cameras being linked to the police network since many malls already displayed signs warning of recording. See also: New police plan to expand AI-enabled CCTV blanket to public housing estates raises questions over privacy Last October, it was announced that the police camera network had been rolled out at public housing estates. CCTV expansion, with facial recognition As part of SmartView’s second phase rollout between 2026 and 2028, the government plans to add 20,000 surveillance cameras per year, including setting up new ones and connecting private cameras and those from different government departments to the police’s network. The police SmartView CCTV system. Photo: GovHK. Authorities aim to add 6,500 surveillance cameras from 2028 to 2031 as part of SmartView’s third phase. In February, Commissioner of Police Joe Chow said authorities planned to incorporate facial recognition functions into CCTV cameras managed by the police “within this year.” Last October, Police Operations Wing Senior Superintendent Leung Ming-leung said that, so far, the surveillance system had aided in detecting more than 480 criminal cases and had led to the arrests of over 840 individuals. It has also been used for crowd control and to assist authorities during typhoons.

# China announces export controls for tunnel boring machines

Key piece of equipment for construction in neighboring India deemed dual-use item

Workers inspect a tunnel boring machine at a workshop of Jinan Heavy Machinery in Jinan,China, on May 11, 2019. Starting Nov. 18, the construction equipment will be subject to China's export control rules. © Reuters

October 19, 2026 17:37 JST

[](https://twitter.com/share?text=China+announces+export+controls+for+tunnel+boring+machines&url=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Feconomy%2Fchina-announces-export-controls-for-tunnel-boring-machines&via=NikkeiAsia)[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Feconomy%2Fchina-announces-export-controls-for-tunnel-boring-machines)[](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=China+announces+export+controls+for+tunnel+boring+machines+https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Feconomy%2Fchina-announces-export-controls-for-tunnel-boring-machines)[](https://t.me/share/url?text=China+announces+export+controls+for+tunnel+boring+machines&url=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Feconomy%2Fchina-announces-export-controls-for-tunnel-boring-machines)[](mailto:?subject=China%20announces%20export%20controls%20for%20tunnel%20boring%20machines&body=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Feconomy%2Fchina-announces-export-controls-for-tunnel-boring-machines)

BEIJING (Reuters) -- China's Commerce Ministry said on Monday it would set export controls on tunnel boring machines, a key piece of equipment for construction in neighboring India.

India remains heavily dependent on imported tunnel boring machines, underscoring the country's long-standing struggle to build domestic manufacturing capacity. China is among the key suppliers of tunneling and other boring equipment used in metro rail and highway construction.

China's Commerce Ministry said export operators would need to apply for a license in accordance with provisions of export control law and regulations on the export control of dual-use items.

Advertisement

The restrictions go into effect on Nov. 18.

It also said it would adjust export control measures for drone-related items and dredgers, part of updates to the country's dual-use items exports list.

content:
今年（2026）5月，我在香港國際機場跟一隻安睡在大堂的巨型喵遇上了。這是機場主辦的一項互動遊戲體驗，引來不少旅客拍照。

這是人類的dreamworld吧！

曾經跟貓生活的人都知道，活生生的貓在旅途上都得被困在籠子裡，過程中極度不安，不是喵喵叫便是怕到僵硬了。我去年因工作關係，需要安排我家橘貓（名字：波橘）坐飛機從台灣回到香港。從入籠那刻開始，到機場清關，抵達家門，便受驚受苦了11個小時。看見巨貓的可愛造型，不禁感覺諷刺萬分。

我和波橘的結緣源自於移民。數年前，我獨個兒從香港移居台灣工作，在COVID-19期間於動物保護及防疫所領養了她。多年與波橘的共居生活，讓我深刻體會到美國哲學家[唐娜．哈洛威（Donna Haraway）](https://zh.wikipedia.org/zh-tw/%E5%94%90%E5%A8%9C%C2%B7%E5%93%88%E6%8B%89%E7%BB%B4)在2003年出版的[《伴侶物種宣言》（The Companion Species Manifesto）](https://www.pricklyparadigm.com/the-companion-species-manifesto?rq=The%20Companion%20Species%20Manifesto)中，提到人與其他物種既相異但又「共生」的概念；我的生活受著波橘牽引，我的自我（selfhood）逐漸與她不可分割。

香港自2019年起出現了大規模移民潮，我因此決定展開一個關於移民與寵物的研究。2024年至今，我已進行38個深度訪談，並到英國向當地的香港移民了解跨物種家庭如何「做照顧」。本文是這些訪談的初步發現。

動物也移民

2019年香港爆發[「反送中」運動](https://www.twreporter.org/topics/hong-kong-extradition-law)，不少民運人士被捕。2021年英國政府推出 英國國民（海外）護照（BNO）簽證計畫

英國政府在2021年1月31日開始實施英國國民（海外）護照（BNO, British National (Overseas) Visa）簽證計畫。這是針對BNO的擴權，讓持有該護照的港人可擁有英國居留權，並在英國居留5年後可申請英國國籍，一年後獲得英籍，稱為5+1簽證。英國政府當時估計5年之內，約有32萬多港人會抵達英國。

，讓曾經持有BNO護照的香港人在有條件的情況下移居英國，17萬港人透過這個管道移民英國。

參考香港統計處2019年發布的住戶統計調查，全港有9.4%住戶飼養貓狗，而香港平均住戶人數為2.6人，若以此百分比估算，單計這波移英潮便至少有6,000隻貓狗受影響。

不少家庭帶著動物一起移民，同時，亦有不少動物救援組織表示相繼接到棄養個案。在網路上的寵物移民群組，不少網友熱心分享寵物移民心得，從申請填寫表格，到機場遇到的突發事件，皆鉅細靡遺地無私分享，唯求眾人可以帶著動物家人「齊上齊落

粵語，指共同進退，為反送中運動的口號之一。

」，呼籲不要棄養。

移民與家庭照顧的主流論述通常圍繞著人和人的關係。本文將透過分享跨物種家庭的移民決定、到埗

粵語，指到達目的地或抵達。

後的適應以及照顧安排，提出「多於人」（more-than-human）的視野，思考社會制度如何限制並治理動物的移動性、人對動物的照顧如何被規範，以及移民經驗與共居動物環環相扣。

在旅途上照顧動物家人

對動物的照顧，是愛還是控制？美籍華裔地理學家[段義孚](https://zh.wikipedia.org/zh-tw/%E6%AE%B5%E4%B9%89%E5%AD%9A)在他1984年出版的英文專書[《支配與感情：製造寵物》（Dominance and Affection: The Making of Pets）](https://yalebooks.yale.edu/book/9780300102086/dominance-and-affection/)指出人與寵物之間的親密關係，背後充滿著人類對寵物的支配及控制慾望。

有學者持批判角度分析資本主義脈絡下的寵物文化：飼養純種寵物成為人類炫耀社經地位的方法，寵物美容亦只是消費文化的擴張。另一邊廂，則有飼主及學者反駁以上說法，認為人類在日常生活中有細心觀察寵物的行為及狀態，並調整作息時間及家居空間來回應動物的需要，提出人與寵物是共生關係，寵物不是全然被動，而是能影響與他們共居的人類諸多的決定，包括本文要談的移民。

在英國殖民管治下，香港自80年代起已無狂犬病個案，因此香港的貓狗入境英國，只需要施打狂犬病疫苗及持醫師證明其健康良好，一般不需要隔離。縱然如此，有不少受訪者對於要帶動物到英國，尤其是老貓老狗，一開始仍抱持「不敢想像」的態度。

即使2019年的政治狀況令他們及家人認為有盡快離開香港的必要，但由於擔心動物未能承受長途飛行帶來的身心壓力，寧願延後移民計畫。直至在網路上見到不少成功例子後，才決定帶著動物上路。

2021年COVID-19已經爆發，移民人士面臨諸多出入境限制，花盡心思及金錢才能安排動物從香港到達地球的另一端。英國機場規定所有寵物必須以貨運的形式入境，寵物得被關到有氧氣及恆溫設施的貨艙。有些家庭為了讓動物家人可以一同共進客艙，不惜繞道歐洲，再經水路或陸路入境英國；然而航空公司嚴格限制可入客艙的動物重量，若超重仍得以貨艙載運。有受訪者為此不惜替膽小的愛貓減重，務求讓膽小貓「合格」，不用被關進貨艙。

這種照顧實踐是一種兩難：一方面貓很膽小，飼主不想貓被關到貨艙；另一方面，強迫減重對貓及對飼主也是一種折磨。好險，膽小貓最終「合格」。能全程陪伴膽小貓，飼主比較放心，但貓要困在客艙椅子下十多個小時，飼主心痛但也只可伸手去安撫膽小貓。

隨著人類與動物的關係愈來愈親密，航空業界以及邊境管制對寵物作出相對友善的政策調整。不少旅行社以私人包機作招徠，簡化飼主辦理寵物出入境手續及避開民航機對寵物重量的限制。

在邊境管制方面，有些國家對寵物入境有嚴格規範，但漫長的檢疫程序可能促使飼主選擇以偷運方式將寵物帶回家，進而增加因偷運而引發的狂犬病風險。

為了堵住這一防疫缺口，政府做出相應對策。以台灣為例，過往香港貓狗進入台灣必須接受至少7天隔離，但自2024年2月起，只要貓狗在進入台灣前半年的驗血報告合格，則可免予隔離檢疫，平衡了公共衛生與人／動物親密性之間的衝突。

性別與家庭角色

把自己的根從香港拔起來，再種到英國的土壤。這個巨大的轉變必定影響了家庭的內部運作，尤其是照顧責任的重新分配。

香港的家庭照顧系統長期依靠家務移工，一般家庭只要月收入達港幣15,000元（約新台幣60,000元），便可以聘請家務移工，並不像台灣需要證明家庭成員有照顧需要。

一位50多歲（已婚，育有一子一女）的女受訪者表示，以前在香港有家務移工，日常照顧狗的工作都由工人來負責，自己只是下班回家後，跟狗玩玩，假日帶狗 出街

粵語，指出門。

而已。她說來了英國之後，自己便變成了那位「工人」，由準備狗的鮮食，到打掃清潔，都是她來負責。由芭芭拉．艾倫瑞克（Barbara Ehrenreich）與亞莉．霍希爾德（Arlie Russell Hochschild）兩位美國女性主義社會學家合編的[《全球化女性：新經濟中的保母、女傭與性工作者》（Global Woman: Nannies, Maids, and Sex Workers in the New Economy）](https://www.amazon.com/Global-Woman-Nannies-Workers-Economy/dp/0805075097)一書中，女性主義學者明確指出富裕國家的女性，雖然透過在職場上的表現及經濟貢獻，可以聘用家務工來免除自己的照顧責任，但「照顧仍然是女人的工作」這個意識形態從未被動搖，只是轉嫁到經濟發展較差地區的婦女來承擔。

值得注意的是，一些40多歲已婚但沒有生育的男女，他們在香港沒有聘請家務移工，家務多半由妻子承擔；來英之後，他們展演出一種相對平等的照顧關係。例如，我跟一對40多歲的夫婦訪談那日，妻子提到今天是愛狗的生日，便順口問丈夫為愛狗準備了什麼晚餐？丈夫不用猶豫便立即答上，可見丈夫的照顧實踐不只是遛狗（家外），還包含了煮鮮食的照顧工作（家內）。

誰為照顧定分界？

毛孩，是擬人的概念，意思是指把貓狗當成孩子般照顧。

當然，飼主或旁觀的人都心知毛孩不是人，這條人與動物的界線可是非常清晰，亦常出現在訪談的對話中。一位受訪者知道愛狗有分離焦慮，每次她一出門，愛狗便在門口等她，即使家裡有其他人亦如是。她說：「難道我為了一隻狗不出門嗎？不是每個地方都可帶狗去，我有自己的生活要過。」

但是，當有人決定全職照顧愛狗，為了狗兒放棄職涯、當個「全職狗媽」（full-time dog mom）呢？

這位女受訪者40多歲，未婚，在香港是專業人士，跟母親同住，早出晚歸，所有家務雜事都交由母親。BNO護照計畫推出不久，她便一人帶著愛狗移民英國，與一直在英國生活的男朋友會合。移民後，她體會到英國的職場文化跟她過往在香港的工作經驗存在著巨大差異，加上COVID-19疫情讓她認清了生命的短暫，反思過往未曾對愛狗盡責任，這種愧疚感讓她決定全職照顧多病的愛狗。她母親對這個決定極度反感，認為女兒正值壯年應該工作賺錢，完全不能理解女兒這麼年輕就放棄工作的選擇。

然而，若放在移民的脈絡下，這個決定卻是合情合理。

移民帶來的急遽轉變和衝擊，讓她不得不重新思索人生的意義及方向。她說10年前熱愛工作及旅遊的自己，根本無法想像10年後會為了照顧一隻狗而待在家裡。

本文的3個故事：有兒女的、已婚的、未婚的，他們移民英國後，調整了與動物的關係，在照顧方面從假手他人到親力親為。當人與動物的關係變得親密的同時，「全職狗媽」所引起的不安正好顯示出：照顧動物的行為往往受到規範──人與動物的界線不可被模糊。若以照顧小孩的心力與金錢投入於動物時，便會引來批評，「愛狗成痴」、「貓痴」等標籤隨之而來。

動物長期照顧

延伸到動物的長期照顧議題。身邊不少友人為年老病重的寵物花盡心思，包括高昂的醫療費用以及侵入性治療，例如插鼻胃管。有些動物失禁，一日辛勞回家後還得清潔滿屋的排泄物。延長生命是愛還是折磨？放手是更好的解脫？在[《就算牠沒有臉：在人類世思考動物倫理與生命教育的十二道難題》](https://www.cite.com.tw/book?id=89814&srsltid=AU7gw4WPXqUeciPikYh5PwUcYQEv54g_VNNqimMY349qyy4CKdFovwxm)，作者黃宗慧與黃宗潔討論了寵物安樂死的兩難，尤其飼主容易處於自我質疑的狀態，責怪自己不該擅自為動物做選擇。

安樂死的議題也反映了不同地方的寵物文化。雖然香港曾被英國殖民，但在動物福利與醫療的理解上卻存在顯著分歧。英國獸醫強調動物的生活品質（quality of life），一般不會進行非必要的侵入性治療，若判斷寵物的病況不會好轉，而且正經歷疼痛，為讓動物免於痛苦，便可能建議安樂死。

許多香港飼主則傾向延續治療。一位受訪者表示，英國的獸醫拒絕為他患有腎病的老貓進行積極治療（施打造血針），而是建議安樂死。他起初拒絕，但居住的市郊地區難以找到第二位獸醫，眼見愛貓痛苦卻無法獲得治療，最後只好答應安樂死。這對帶著動物移民英國的香港人而言，是一個巨大的文化衝突。

在跨國移動的脈絡下，動物長照如何進行？這不單涉及醫療資源是否容易取得（大城市vs.市郊），也牽動文化差異與照顧倫理的再定義（免除痛苦vs.延續治療）。

動物移民不只是一趟飛機之旅，而是環環相扣地牽動性別角色、照顧倫理、文化適應與醫療資源等多重面向，影響移民者的決定以及家庭的照顧實踐。跨物種家庭的跨國移動，為照顧與移民研究帶來新的視角。

【性別有事】專欄介紹

「性別有事」典自著名哲學理論家茱蒂絲・巴特勒（Judith Butler）的經典著作《Gender Trouble》，不僅討論圍繞著「性別」的相關議題和事件，有時也會對「性別」概念與知識找麻煩。

《報導者》性別專欄由[台灣女性學學會](https://twfeminist.org/)規劃、撰稿，記錄性別研究大小事，回應國內外在性別議題上出了什麼事，努力每月一更、促進台灣當代社會性別議題新陳代謝。

title: 柴静：周恩来为什么没留住张爱玲？｜张爱玲录音公开（附：节目手记）
summary: 柴静 Chai Jing 柴静：周恩来为什么没留住张爱玲？｜张爱玲录音公开 节目手记 一 张爱玲录音如何发掘？ 节目播出后，张爱玲录音被海内外广泛转发，很多人问我寻找它的过程。 我做的是视频节目，寻找一手的音视频材料是基本需求：张爱玲1995年才去世，那时录音、录像已经普及，按理说应该留下过记录。 但我在网上搜的结果显示：目前没有来源可靠的张爱玲本人录音或录像。 我去问她工作过的加州大学伯克利分校东亚图书馆，负责人回复说没有。 我查南加州大学张爱玲的遗稿目录，没有发现线索。
content: 柴静 Chai Jing 柴静：周恩来为什么没留住张爱玲？｜张爱玲录音公开 节目手记 一 张爱玲录音如何发掘？ 节目播出后，张爱玲录音被海内外广泛转发，很多人问我寻找它的过程。 我做的是视频节目，寻找一手的音视频材料是基本需求：张爱玲1995年才去世，那时录音、录像已经普及，按理说应该留下过记录。 但我在网上搜的结果显示：目前没有来源可靠的张爱玲本人录音或录像。 我去问她工作过的加州大学伯克利分校东亚图书馆，负责人回复说没有。 我查南加州大学张爱玲的遗稿目录，没有发现线索。 我查了张爱玲1961年10月访问台湾期间是否留下影片或声音记录。没有找到。 我也写信给美国国家档案馆和南加大，并查询美国国务院驻外机构档案，未有进展。 1969年张爱玲在给宋淇的信中，提到她在拉德克利夫研究所做过演讲。 有演讲，会不会有录音？ 我写信给拉德克利夫的施莱辛格图书馆，这所学院如今已并入哈佛大学。研究服务主管 Becky Morin 回复说，馆里有一份2025年已经数字化的录音，编目名称是： Bunting Institute Seminars. Reyher; Bas-Comain. Reyher 是张爱玲婚后用的姓。我之前的搜索漏掉了这种可能。 打开她发来的录音链接，是一位女性在用英语讲中国文学翻译，声音很轻。 我需要确认这是张爱玲。 这个过程中，我查到学者 Christopher Lee 2015年在《PMLA》上整理发表的张爱玲英文演讲《中国翻译：文化影响的载体》。文中提到，1969年4月1日张在拉德克利夫研究所的演讲。我把录音和 Christopher Lee 发表的讲稿逐段对照：从佛经翻译、严复、林纾，一直讲到五四，论述的次序和内容都对得上。 是张爱玲。 张爱玲声音很轻，演讲时有时侧过脸去，主持人曾提醒她对准麦克风，录音质量不佳。我用 Adobe Audition 做了适度降噪和均衡调整，没有用 AI 重新生成她的声音，听不清的词没有补造。 有一个意外收获：演讲结束后，有听众提问，她回答，谈到《红楼梦》等内容。这段约半小时的问答我只能辨识片断，严谨起见，没有在节目中使用。对未来的研究者来说，这应该是重要资料。 媒体使用需要授权。我询问后Becky 查了相关档案，确认了节目使用录音的许可和程序，我已经在节目简介中注明。当前录音在国内外流传，反映了大众对张爱玲的关切。请转发、剪辑或引用的朋友尽量遵循版权和使用要求，注明来源，附上原始馆藏链接。 【录音来源：哈佛大学拉德克利夫研究院施莱辛格图书馆，馆藏以 Reyher 著录。 原始馆藏：https://hollisarchives.lib.harvard.ed... 因为从录制、保存到整理、数字化，一段半个多世纪前的声音能留到今天并不容易----那些为我们中国文化保存了珍贵记忆的人，值得感谢，应当被看见。 二、“周恩来要留下张爱玲”从哪里来？ 节目中，这句话注明依据夏衍的回忆。因为视频时间限制，无法做脚注。有人问起，所以我把相关材料在这里多展开一些。 先说夏衍与周恩来的关系。 1937年，《救亡日报》在上海创办，夏衍出任总编辑，此后长期在周恩来领导下做文化和统一战线工作。1945年他回到上海，龚之方、唐大郎等小报界朋友设宴迎接他。这两位正是张爱玲的出版人：1946年，《传奇》增订本由他们经办的山河图书公司出版；夏衍自述，经由唐大郎介绍，他认识了张爱玲及她的作品。 据吴祖光回忆，夏衍在抗战结束后，在上海开地下党会议，就在龚之方的办公室。 1949年，夏一回上海，就与唐大郎通话。 唐说，你回来了，我们就没饭吃了。 夏说，我回来了，你们就有饭吃了。 不久，《亦报》创刊。 1949年以后，张爱玲的《十八春》和《小艾》便在《亦报》上连载。 夏衍在《懒寻旧梦录》第七章“迎接新中国的诞生”中，详细记下了1949年赴上海前接受工作安排的经过。5月初，他从香港经塘沽抵达北平。11日晚，周恩来约他与潘汉年、许涤新见面，交代接管上海的分工。随后中南海的会议上，周恩来又与他长谈，商议筹备文代会、保留民营报纸，以及接管上海后的文化工作。 书中记录了周恩来的要求：扩大团结范围，对于过去不问政治的人，甚至反对过他们的人，也要争取。凡是愿意留下、爱国、愿意为新中国工作的人，都要团结。 这段记述还有一个重要细节。夏衍在中注明，1978年文化部退还他的文物和笔记本时，他找到了当年的札记本，因而确认，他所记周恩来的指示“是确切无误的”。 1988年，《人民文学》刊出夏衍与他的前秘书李子云的对谈《文艺漫谈》。李子云提到夏衍向自己推荐张爱玲小说，夏说，希望张爱玲留在大陆，一是爱才，二是遵循周恩来“要团结一切可以团结的人”的方针。 再过五年，夏衍在署于1993年、为《大江东去——沈祖安人物论集》写的序文中，进一步回忆了周恩来在与他谈话时谈到的两个人名：刘海粟和张爱玲。他还说，周恩来在重庆时已经辗转读过《传奇》。 此文收入《夏洐全集》。 夏衍在此文中提到，他又托柯灵找到一本《传奇》，转送周恩来。 柯灵在《遥寄张爱玲》中记录，他去书库找《传奇》《流言》、寄往北京的经过，按他的记述，时间在夏衍1955年调任文化部之后。 此后夏衍留下张爱玲的过程，几位当事人也留下了记述。柯灵说，张爱玲参加文代会，是夏衍的指定。夏兼任上海电影剧本创作所所长时，想请张爱玲当编剧，因为有人反对，需要稍等。其佩在1988年的《也说张爱玲》中回忆了一次饭局，夏衍与张爱玲同在，饭局的起缘是夏衍托龚、唐劝张爱玲不要去香港。罗孚在《怅望卅秋一洒泪》中写到，1953年他带着唐大郎的一封信赴港，信是奉夏衍之意写的，希望张爱玲不要去美国，能回上海最好，不能回来，留在香港也好。 一句话背后，是几个人各自留下的记述。我把相关出处列在这里，供有兴趣的朋友继续查考。 三、致谢 这期节目的基础是《十八春》《小艾》的发掘，张爱玲以梁京为笔名、桑弧用化名发表的文章，桑弧与沈从文的交集，几乎完全依赖陈子善等大陆学者多年的搜寻和整理。 大陆学界很多高质量研究，如余斌的《张爱玲传》；张济顺的《远去的都市：1950年代的上海》，杨奎松对这一时期政治史的研究，我虽然没有直接在节目中使用，但阅读使之化为这期节目的背景。 港台学者同样做了大量工作，比如季季整理张子静口述的《我的姐姐张爱玲》，宋以朗对张爱玲与宋家通信的发掘，都为历史留下了宝贵材料。王德威先生的 论述也给了我很多启发。 海外学者中，旅美学者司马新对张爱玲在美国期间做了一手调研。毕克伟在《胜利的困境》中写到的文华公司历史，以及他对桑弧的采访是这期节目的重要参考。王晓珏对《秧歌》及其与《辽远的乡村》等电影关系的研究，为我的推断提供了学术印证。 张爱玲的这段历史，是由海内外学界长期共同发掘、逐渐丰富。我循着这些线索，阅读、查证，才有了这期节目，在这里一并感谢。我的个人阅读体会如有错漏之处，也欢迎指正。 节目原稿中涉及到桑弧的创作，唐大郎与石挥的内容，因时间与主题关系做了删节，他们都是很有价值的历史人物，值得有兴趣者另作论述。

# 李敦促塔吉克斯坦深化安全关系并保护中国公民
李强总理呼吁与塔吉克斯坦深化安全和情报合作，打击极端主义和分裂主义，并敦促采取强有力的措施保护中国公民。去年，五名中国公民在塔吉克斯坦被指控为非洲武装分子发动的袭击中被杀，随后发出了这一呼吁。

据官方通讯社新华社报道，中国总理李强周一呼吁与塔吉克斯坦深化安全和情报合作，打击北京认为的极端主义和分裂主义，并表示希望塔吉克斯坦采取“强有力的措施”保护中国公民。
李克强在会见塔吉克斯坦总统拉赫蒙时表示，两国要深化执法安全合作

# Li urges Tajikistan to deepen security ties and protect Chinese citizens

Premier Li Qiang has called for deeper security and intelligence cooperation with Tajikistan to combat extremism and separatism, urging strong measures to protect Chinese citizens. The appeal follows the killing of five Chinese nationals in Tajikistan last year in attacks blamed on militants from Af

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

Premier Li Qiang called on Monday for deeper security and intelligence cooperation with Tajikistan to fight what Beijing views as extremism and separatism, and said he hoped the country would take "strong measures" to protect Chinese citizens, state news agency Xinhua reported.

Li made the remarks during a meeting with Tajik President Emomali Rahmon, saying the two countries should deepen cooperation on law enforcement and security and strengthen intelligence exchanges and sharing, according to Xinhua.

China and Tajikistan should jointly fight the "three evil forces", a term Beijing uses to describe terrorism, separatism and extremism, and safeguard regional peace and stability, Li added.

China has long feared that violence in Central Asia could spill over into its far western region of Xinjiang, home to the mostly Muslim Uyghur people. Beijing says Uyghur militants were behind a string of past attacks in the region.

Late last year, five Chinese nationals were killed in Tajikistan in attacks that authorities said were launched from neighbouring Afghanistan.

Li is not the only high-profile foreign official visiting resource-rich Central Asia this week. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio travelled on Sunday to Uzbekistan, where Li had been before going to Tajikistan.

China, which shares a remote, mountainous border with Tajikistan, is a major investor in the country. Tajikistan, a former Soviet republic of about 11 million people with a secular government, has tense relations with the Taliban authorities in Afghanistan and has previously warned of drug smugglers and illicit gold miners working along the frontier.

The country endured a brutal civil war in the 1990s after the Soviet Union broke apart, during which Rahmon initially rose to power. Tajikistan remains closely aligned with Russia, which maintains a military base there.

2026年3月12日,当今西方最顶尖气场解读师朱迪斯．柯林斯（Judith Collins）,在一场深度公开访谈中，对当前全球三大关键领导人（川普、普京、[习近平](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B9%A0%E8%BF%91%E5%B9%B3)）气场进行了全面解读，尤其是对中共现任党魁习近平的一番断言举世皆惊！

那么朱迪斯是谁呢？朱迪斯（Judith），澳洲人，自幼具备着天眼透视人体**[气场](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%B0%94%E5%9C%BA)**辉光的能力，两三岁起，她看到每个人周身都环绕着流动的彩光，纯真与善良、虚情与假意、无伤大雅的白色谎言，甚至是深藏在心底的自私算计，全都化作一抹颜色，赤裸裸地暴露在她眼前。

大家好，我是自媒体“Edward文鸣”，今天咱们来分享朱迪斯对习近平、普京和[川普](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%B7%9D%E6%99%AE)三人气场走向和命运的惊人解读，还有，朱迪斯与生俱来的这种超常透视能力，是怎样揭示人体气场与心念相连的玄奥真相的，以及这种能力带给她的困扰、崩溃的人生传奇。

咱们先来看朱迪斯是怎样解读当今政局的：

[![Image 1](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2024/11-2/p3556881a508884777.jpg)](https://naturexcels.com/language/zh/)

**朱迪斯眼中的全球四大权力气场**

朱迪斯解读政局的方式极为独特。她会读取人体周围一整圈的气场，气场彻底穿透各色人等在聚光灯下的伪装”，看到他灵魂状态的实质。

首先映入眼帘的是俄罗斯强人普丁。主流媒体常将普丁塑造成一个咄咄逼人、企图重建沙俄帝国的野心家，但朱迪斯穿透其外壳后，却看见了一种令人唏嘘的能量图景——普丁的气场充满了沉重的“防御性惊恐”。他之所以在乌克兰战场上歇斯底里、拒不收手，根本不是因为他多么强大，而是为了“保护自己”。

在俄罗斯庞大而残酷的权力斗争中，普丁无时无刻不面临暗杀与内部政变的致命威胁；而在国门之外，他身背国际刑事法院的通缉令，天下之大已无处容身。他只能如同困兽一般，透过不断制造冲突与镇压来巩固自己脚下那块日渐缩小的方寸之地。这不是帝王的傲慢，而是绝路中毫无选择的自我保命。

谈及乌克兰时，朱迪斯指出，那里的人民虽然深陷战争之苦，但他们肩膀周围凝聚着一种为独立、反暴政而燃烧的正向力量。朱迪斯感叹道：世界上只要有脆弱与受压迫的人存在，就总会有自认强大的暴君试图奴役他们，然而暴政终会引来精神能量的反噬。

至于大洋彼岸的美国与总统川普，她直言川普在天意运转中扮演着一个极其特殊的角色——“催化剂”。无论世人对他是崇拜还是厌恶，川普的出现都以一种摧枯拉朽的能量，逼迫每一个人、每一个政党乃至每一个同盟国，不得不撕碎往日的伪装，重新拷问自己心中真正的价值底线。他打破了西方社会那种习以为常、自满沉沦的“岁月静好”，促使原本对立或散漫的力量在激荡中重新站队，彻底颠覆了二战以来形成的全球地缘平衡。

而在谈到中东时，朱迪斯对伊朗极权集团的判断更是毫不留情。她指出德黑兰的宗教寡头与其羽翼，本质上皆是“一丘之貉”。他们的气场冰冷而阴郁，根本不在乎普通百姓与青年学子的死活，整个权力机器运转的唯一目的，就是保障统治家族的特权与奢靡。这种对生命的漠视，注定了其在民众心中早已是行尸走肉。

**中南海党魁“反复无常”与末路惊魂**

然而，在朱迪斯这场访谈的所有段落中，最令人屏息的，莫过于她对中共党魁习近平的“死穴诊断”。朱迪斯说：中国的局势正处于空前未有的极度不稳定状态，而这一切动荡的核心源头，恰恰在于中南海现任最高掌权者自身的精神世界早已失衡。

朱迪斯指出，习近平的气场呈现出一种严重的“反复无常”与“病态焦虑”。他对自己苦心经营的权柄、领袖光环以及生死安危，有着刻骨铭心不安全感。正是这种内在的虚弱，导致其政策左支右绌、朝令夕改。

更惊人的是，朱迪斯断语：在未来的10个月内，他被身后或体制内部力量推翻的机率，相当之高！从3月12日这番预言公诸于世算起，2027年1月12日之前，当时习近平宿命的大限，距今只剩下最后短短！

朱迪斯在访谈中特别点出，这位领导人的**[健康状况](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%81%A5%E5%BA%B7%E7%8A%B6%E5%86%B5)**其实早已“非常不理想”，甚至可以说已到了全面崩坏的临界点。而在现实的公众视线中，这张用化妆与特权精心粉饰的健康画皮，近几个月来已经被各大国际场合的镜头无情戳破，其衰相之重，已是天下皆知、欲盖弥彰。

9月23日习近平访美，当客机舱门打开，现场仪仗队严阵以待，全世界的长焦镜头齐刷刷对准舷梯出口。然而，出现在众人眼前的并非一个大国领袖的昂扬步伐，而是一副令人心惊胆战的蹒跚老态——只见他在走下台阶时，整个人身体左右剧烈晃动，步伐僵硬滞重；他的右手死死握紧旁边冰冷的金属扶梯；而最触目惊心的，是他的左半身完全处于失控状态！

在清晰的现场高清特写中可以看见，彭丽媛，几乎用尽全力化身为他的“人肉枴杖”！短短舷梯之旅，两人走得如履薄冰、惊险万分，仿佛是一副随时可能栽倒在地的大病之相！

最刺眼的对比发生在两国元首会晤时演奏国歌的庄严时刻：

站在一旁的川普，面色红润、身姿挺拔，眼神中透露出强大的自信与从容；而转观旁边的习近平——当刺耳的中共国歌奏响之际，他却宛如一具被抽去灵魂的木偶，目光呆滞无神，一脸掩不住的晦气与生无可恋，那副表情仿佛这首伴随血雨腥风的党歌与他毫无瓜葛，甚至透露出一种大难临头的麻木与绝望。

说到这儿，咱们再来看看朱迪斯是怎样的自幼功能携带者：

**异能的孩子**

世界上有很多孩子，在6岁前天目是开的，能看到一些另外空间的生命。但是很多时候，孩子讲出来的时候，父母未必能相信，甚至还会因此斥责说孩子说谎，来打击孩子，导致孩子的特异功能被迫关闭。但是朱迪斯很幸运遇到的父母。

在朱迪斯的实证认知里，所谓气场（Aura），是一个人生命状态完完整整的能量全息呈现。它钜细靡遗地容纳了一个人的思想、情绪、暗室私欲，也镌刻着此生所见、所闻、所尝、所读的每一丝阅历，以及在人间与他人悲欢交集留下的所有印记。朱迪斯指出，人头部周围的光晕颜色，对应着其生命的特质：那些在商海打拼、开创企业的人，头顶的能量色块往往会凝聚并持续五至七年；而沉潜于医学与科学研究的学者，其探索未知的光泽甚至能稳定驻留长达十一年。

然而，朱迪斯这双能照见灵魂的“法眼”，并非成年后苦修的成果，而是从她两三岁牙牙学语时便与生俱来的本能。

朱迪斯两三岁时，她看到每个人周身都环绕着流动的彩光。四岁那年，家里的叔叔前来做客，众人谈笑风生之际，稚嫩的朱迪斯走上前去，伸出小手轻轻按在叔叔的肚子上，神色认真地说：“你病得很严重。”在场的成年人或许只当作童言无忌，甚至是一句无心的胡话；然而，47年后，这位叔叔因严重的肠癌不幸离世，病灶致命的位置，恰恰就是当年4岁小朱迪斯小手触碰之处。

不久之后，邻居家也发生了一桩变故。原本两家邻里关系融洽，日常谈笑热络，但有一段时间，邻居夫妇突然变得沉默寡言，进出低头，甚至不再与朱迪斯的父母打招呼。朱迪斯的母亲在院子里晾衣服时，满腹困惑与自责地对丈夫嘀咕：“难道是我们做错了什么，得罪了人家？为什么他们突然变得如此冷漠？”

站在一旁的朱迪斯转过小脸，对母亲说道：“妈妈，不是那样的。那个男人快要去世了，他很快就会离开这个世界。不是他们不愿意理我们，而是他们正被巨大的悲伤和担忧深深压垮了。”几天之后，邻居家的噩耗传来，印证了孩子的预言。

母亲为她购买了标准色卡，还常常奔走于当地的裁缝店与布料行，讨来五颜六色的布料边角料带回家。在厨房温暖的灯光下，母亲把一块块红、橙、黄、绿、青、蓝、紫的碎布铺在孩子面前，温柔地问道：“亲爱的，告诉妈妈，你今天在邻居阿姨头上看到的，究竟是哪一种质地的颜色？”朱迪斯指认，母亲便在一旁工整地做着笔记，为女儿建立了一套详实的“能量光色档案”。

然而，过早拥有洞察真相的眼睛，未必就是好事。大约在朱迪斯五岁时，她突然破解了一种特殊的颜色密码——“柠檬青绿色”（Lemon-lime green）。那是一种混浊的、酸涩的柠檬酸绿，每当有人撒谎、掩饰、自欺欺人时，气场中就会无可遁形地迸发出这种色块。

令五岁女孩震惊而绝望的是，她赫然发现，全世界每一个人的身上，或多或少都带着这种柠檬青绿色！无论是天真无邪的孩童被问及“你有没有偷拿饼干”时那句慌张的否认，还是成年人日常社交中虚情假意的奉承、无伤大雅的白色谎言，甚至是深藏在心底的自私算计，全都化作这抹青绿，赤裸裸地暴露在她眼前。

“五岁时，我就意识到：每个人都会撒谎。于是我开始不再信任任何人。”从6、7岁起，朱迪斯开始将自己重重封闭起来。到了10岁左右，小学的课间操场上孩子们追逐欢笑，唯有朱迪斯形单影只，她无法融入，更不知该如何与那些满身“柠檬青绿”的人建立纯粹的友谊。她成了一个活在喧嚣人间的无声旁观者，灵魂在万花筒般的能量洪流中精疲力竭。

到了14岁青春期，朱迪斯对眼前无休无止的“人体霓虹灯”彻底崩溃了。“我受够了这个世界，受够了看着每个人身上都五彩缤纷地晃动！”那不是视觉的享受，而是一场永无宁日的能量暴击。她感到自己的大脑快要被这些强行灌入的信息撕裂。

在一个平静的早晨，14岁的朱迪斯留下一张字条，离家出走了。

她沿着澳洲东部的海岸线一路搭便车北上，夜晚露宿在冰凉的海滩沙丘上，白天在澳洲莽莽丛林与海浪边漫步。饥饿难耐时，她就在天刚蒙蒙亮的清晨走进早开门的街边咖啡馆，主动向店主请求：“我帮你们扫地、擦桌子、洗碗，能换一顿早餐吗？”就这样，她一个人在荒野与海边漂泊了三个半星期，只为逃离人群、寻求一刻纯粹的空无与寂静。

3个半星期后，孩子被寻回了。父母决定让孩子远离学校环境在家静养。

父亲在自己经营的室内装修与装饰店里，为女儿安排了一份踏实的差事。在那里，朱迪斯每天接触的是木材的纹理、布艺的触感、钉枪的沉闷声响与手工艺的专注。

一直到了23岁，朱迪斯才终于在摸索中学会了如何“关闭”（turn off）这种能看透天地万物的气场视觉。她回忆说：“在那之前，我什至不知道这东西叫做‘气场’，我不知道它还有专有名词，它只是我随时随地被迫看见的现实。”

在学会自主控制这个“灵魂镜头”的焦距之后，朱迪斯才真正掌握了自己的生命主动权。当她需要帮助求助者时，她调动意念开启气场视觉，洞察对方的疾苦、心结、潜力与因果；而在日常过日子时，她便将其关闭，安享常人的平静与温馨。经过整整70年的实践与阅历沉淀，她成为了当今世界公认的顶尖气场宗师，著书立说，为无数迷茫的灵魂指引迷津。

好了，咱们再回到现实中来。

**最后三个月**

从今年3月12日朱迪斯在节目中公开给出“10个月大限”，到如今时局迈入深秋，历史的指针已经精确走过了七个月，指向了最后三个月的生死关口。这绝非巧合，而是天地人三才共振的必然轨迹。

在过去这七个月里，我们看见了太多前所未有的异象：长江流域的旱涝倒错、北方夏日飞雪、乃至北京紫禁城前大风拔木。更致命的是，10月5日晚间，在习近平的祖地陕西，一颗巨大的火流星突然点亮西安夜空，并伴随着刺眼的半空爆燃。

在中国传统的星象学里，这叫“**[巨星陨落](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%B7%A8%E6%98%9F%E9%99%A8%E8%90%BD)**”，古代星象学权威的《乙巳占》说：“流星者，天皇之使。”、“星大则事大而害深”。在中国古代的官方占星记录里，大型流星，特别是这种伴随着剧烈爆燃的火流星，绝大多数情况下都被解读为不祥之兆。古人认为天上的星辰，对应着人间的君王或者重臣。一颗巨大的火流星骤然划落并且爆炸，往往被视作重要将领、国家重臣，甚至是最高统治者生命走向终点的象征。

不仅如此，《乙巳占》里说：“色赤为旱为兵，色青为饥为忧。”这次西安火流星，带着明显的蓝绿色光芒，这对应的就是“青色”，预示着饥荒和社会的深深忧患。再加上这颗流星速度极快，最后还发生了爆燃，古人称之为“有芒角者及有声为怒”，这代表着上天震怒，预示着接下来可能出现战争、兵祸或者极其紧急的社会大动荡。

**(DEFENCE SECURITY ASIA) — China’s construction of a full-scale replica of a U.S. Navy Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer in the Taklamakan Desert marks a significant escalation in the realism and sophistication of the People’s Liberation Army’s anti-access and area-denial warfare preparations.**

**Commercial satellite imagery captured near Ruoqiang in Xinjiang Province reveals a highly detailed three-dimensional mock-up replicating the approximate 155-meter dimensions, superstructure geometry, and radar signature characteristics of a modern Arleigh Burke Flight IIA or Flight III destroyer.**

**The replica represents far more than a symbolic training aid because it directly supports the PLA Rocket Force’s evolving mission to neutralize U.S. naval power projection capabilities during a potential Taiwan Strait conflict.**

**The development emerges as [military](https://defencesecurityasia.com/en/china-us-destroyer-replica-desert-anti-ship-missile-testing/#) planners in Washington increasingly assess that any Chinese move against Taiwan would almost certainly involve attempts to delay, disrupt, or deter U.S. carrier strike group intervention in the Western Pacific battlespace.**

Teroka Pertahanan

**Unlike earlier two-dimensional ship outlines observed at the same desert range since 2021, the new structure incorporates radar reflectors, elevated superstructure simulations, and physical geometry intended to reproduce realistic radar cross-sections for advanced missile seeker testing.**

**The Taklamakan Desert range has already hosted mock-ups of Ford-class aircraft carriers, multiple destroyer silhouettes, and mobile rail-mounted maritime targets designed to simulate maneuvering warships under combat conditions.**

**Military analysts assess that the new replica is specifically optimized for validating anti-ship ballistic missiles such as the DF-21D and DF-26, alongside emerging hypersonic strike systems and AI-assisted targeting architectures.**

**The strategic objective behind these tests is not merely missile accuracy but the refinement of the entire anti-ship “kill chain,” including satellite detection, target identification, sensor fusion, terminal guidance, electronic warfare resistance, and battle damage assessment.**

**Arleigh Burke-class destroyers represent one of the most critical operational nodes within U.S. naval force posture because they provide Aegis ballistic missile defense, anti-submarine warfare, air defense coordination, and Tomahawk long-range strike capability.**

**In any Taiwan contingency, Burke destroyers would likely form the protective outer layer around U.S. carrier strike groups operating east of Taiwan or within the Philippine Sea to complicate PLA amphibious operations.**

**Although analysts caution that the development does not necessarily indicate an imminent invasion timeline, the replica underscores how deeply integrated Taiwan contingency planning has become within China’s broader military modernization and strategic deterrence doctrine.**

## **China’s Arleigh Burke Replica Signals a New Phase in PLA A2/AD Operational Maturity**

**The construction of a realistic U.S. destroyer target reflects the PLA’s transition from theoretical anti-access doctrine toward increasingly operationalized and technologically integrated anti-ship warfare preparation.**

**Earlier desert mock-ups relied heavily on flat visual outlines that primarily supported basic targeting calibration, whereas the new three-dimensional structure enables far more sophisticated radar, infrared, and terminal guidance validation under simulated combat conditions.**

**This shift is strategically important because modern naval warfare increasingly depends on multi-domain sensor fusion rather than simple visual acquisition or conventional ballistic targeting methodologies.**

**By reproducing the complex radar profile of an Arleigh Burke destroyer, the PLA can evaluate whether missile seekers can discriminate between operational combatants, electronic decoys, chaff clouds, and deceptive signature management systems during high-intensity conflict.**

**Such capability directly supports China’s anti-access and area-denial strategy designed to keep U.S. naval forces beyond effective intervention range during a Taiwan Strait contingency.**

**The DF-21D and DF-26 anti-ship ballistic missiles already represent core components of China’s regional deterrence architecture, with reported ranges capable of threatening U.S. carrier groups operating across the Western Pacific.**

**The addition of hypersonic glide vehicles and AI-assisted targeting algorithms could potentially compress U.S. reaction times while complicating existing missile defense interception windows.**

**The Taklamakan Desert range provides ideal testing conditions because the isolated environment allows live-fire experimentation without maritime traffic constraints or immediate foreign surveillance interference.**

# 中国是否正在建造一支无人机母舰舰队以扩大其海军影响力？

### 珠江上一艘 150 米长的船只的图像显示其特征与最近在上海下水的一艘更大的船只类似

发布时间：2026 年 10 月 19 日晚上 10:00 更新时间：2026 年 10 月 20 日上午 1:44

第二艘疑似设计用于发射和回收大型水下无人机的不寻常中国船只出现在广州，引发了人们对北京是否正在开发一支专业母舰舰队以将其水下作业扩展到沿海水域以外的质疑。
网上流传的图片显示，这艘较小的船只被拖曳在珠江上，与上个月在上海造船厂看到的一艘长约 200 米（660 英尺）的船只相似。推出。

两者的船尾都具有显着的垂直结构，海军分析人士认为，该结构可用于将大型水下无人机放入水中并回收它们。

如果被确认为军用母舰，这些船只可以使[中国人民解放军(PLA)海军](https://www.scmp.com/topics/chinas-navy?module=inline&pgtype=article)能够在远离中国港口的地方部署和回收大型无人水下航行器(UUV)，从而有可能扩大其在西太平洋(包括台湾以东水域)执行海底监视、海底测绘和其他军事任务的能力。

# Is China building a fleet of drone motherships to extend its naval reach?

### Images of a 150-metre vessel on the Pearl River show features resembling those of a larger ship recently launched in Shanghai

3-MIN READ 3-MIN

17

Listen

[![Image 1: Google News Preferred Icon](https://assets-v2.i-scmp.com/production/_next/static/media/icon-google.1b45eadd.png)Make SCMP preferred on Google](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=scmp.com)

Published: 10:00pm, 19 Oct 2026 Updated: 1:44am, 20 Oct 2026

A second unusual Chinese vessel suspected of being designed to launch and recover large underwater [drones](https://www.scmp.com/topics/drones?module=inline&pgtype=article) has appeared in Guangzhou, raising questions over whether Beijing is developing a fleet of specialised motherships to extend its undersea operations beyond coastal waters.

The smaller vessel, seen under tow on the Pearl River in images circulating online, resembles [a ship about 200 metres (660 feet) long seen at a Shanghai shipyard](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3368012/could-mystery-shanghai-vessel-be-mothership-chinas-underwater-drones?module=inline&pgtype=article) last month that has since been launched.

Both feature conspicuous vertical structures at the stern that naval analysts believe could be used to lower large underwater drones into the water and recover them.

If confirmed as military motherships, the vessels could enable the [People’s Liberation Army (PLA) Navy](https://www.scmp.com/topics/chinas-navy?module=inline&pgtype=article) to deploy and recover large uncrewed underwater vehicles (UUVs) far from Chinese ports, potentially expanding its ability to conduct undersea surveillance, seabed mapping and other military missions in the western Pacific, including waters east of Taiwan.

title: Taiwan coastguard wards off 16 mainland ships as Beijing turns up the pressure
zh_title: 北京加大施压 台湾海警拦截16艘大陆船只
summary: 台湾海岸警卫队表示，一天之内，16艘中国大陆船只驶入台湾自行定义的限制水域，并通过协调一致的多管齐下行动将其拦截，专家表示，这表明北京海上压力策略的转变。据海巡署称，这些船只包括 12 艘海岸警卫队和科考船，以及四艘渔船，周日在花莲以东、屏东以南、高雄西南部以及台湾控制的东沙群岛周围海域同时作业。 “CGA自始至终监控海事局势
content:
台湾海岸警卫队表示，一天之内，16艘中国大陆船只驶入台湾自行定义的限制水域，并通过协调一致的多管齐下行动将其拦截，专家表示，这表明北京海上压力策略的转变。

据海巡署称，这些船只包括 12 艘海岸警卫队和科考船，以及四艘渔船，周日在花莲以东、屏东以南、高雄西南部以及台湾控制的东沙群岛周围海域同时作业。

中国海警在周日的一份声明中表示，“中国海警在整个行动过程中监视了海上局势，并立即派遣海警船只前往前沿阵地，对大陆船只进行严密监视，并发布警告命令其离开。”

该机构将这些活动描述为“[混合战争](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3220645/chinese-general-calls-military-prepare-hybrid-modern-warfare?module=inline&pgtype=article)”，旨在扩大北京的管辖权主张。

它指责北京“名义上执法，实际上扩大权力”，以营造其对该海域行使管辖权的印象。

此次行动正值安全专家越来越担心北京越来越多地利用海岸警卫队、海上执法船和科考船在台湾周边施加压力，而不是主要依靠中国人民解放军。
02:55

台湾结束年度军演，包括为解放军海上封锁做准备

桃园国防大学解放军事务教授马振坤表示，北京今年的重点已逐渐从海军主导的灰色地带行动转向通过海岸警卫队、海上巡逻和研究船维护管辖权。

马云说：“对于北京来说，此类措施比传统的军事灰色地带行动能产生更具体的成果。”

他将这一做法描述为“离岛夺周边海域”的战略——逐步挤压台湾及其离岛周边海域，但又不引发彻底的军事冲突。

马英九表示，这种做法在南海已经很明显，而且在台湾以东的海域以及金门、马祖、东沙和台湾控制的南沙群岛太平岛周围的海域也越来越多地出现。金门又名金门。

他的评估大体呼应了国际战略研究所 10 月 8 日的分析，该研究所称，自 6 月以来，北京加强了台湾东部的执法、海上监视、渔业和研究活动。

这家总部位于伦敦的智库将中国大陆行为体的扩散描述为北京灰色地带战略的重大发展，可能旨在在台湾周围建立一个涉及军事和民事机构的更复杂的海洋治理体系。
活动的增加也引发了人们的疑问：台湾是否能够在不造成自身海岸警卫队资源紧张的情况下可持续地对船只做出反应。

美国退役海军四星上将、美国太平洋司令部前司令丹尼斯·布莱尔上周在台北举行的海上安全会议上发表视频讲话时表示，台湾不应自动跟踪每艘大陆船只或飞机。

相反，台北应该根据威胁程度分配有限的资源，保留运营能力

【原文 English Original】
Taiwan’s coastguard said it warded off 16 mainland Chinese vessels in one day after they sailed into the island’s self-defined restricted waters in a coordinated, multi-pronged operation that experts say points to a shift in Beijing’s maritime pressure tactics.

The vessels – 12 coastguard and research ships, as well as four fishing boats – operated simultaneously on Sunday in waters east of Hualien, south of Pingtung, southwest of Kaohsiung and around the Taiwan-controlled Dongsha Islands, according to the Coast Guard Administration (CGA).

“The CGA monitored the maritime situation throughout the operation and immediately dispatched coastguard vessels to forward positions, where they closely monitored the mainland vessels and broadcast warnings ordering them to leave,” it said in a statement on Sunday.

The agency described the activities as “[hybrid warfare](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3220645/chinese-general-calls-military-prepare-hybrid-modern-warfare?module=inline&pgtype=article)” intended to expand Beijing’s jurisdictional claims.

It accused Beijing of pursuing “law enforcement in name, expansion of authority in reality” to create the impression that it exercised jurisdiction over the waters.

The operation comes amid growing concern among security experts that Beijing is increasingly using coastguard, maritime law enforcement and research vessels to apply pressure around Taiwan, rather than relying predominantly on the People’s Liberation Army.

02:55

Taiwan concludes annual war games, including preparing for PLA sea blockade

Ma Chen-kun, a professor of PLA affairs at National Defence University in Taoyuan, said Beijing’s focus had gradually shifted this year from navy-led grey-zone operations towards asserting jurisdiction through coastguard, maritime patrol and research vessels.

“For Beijing, such measures produce more concrete results than conventional military grey-zone operations,” Ma said.

He described the approach as a strategy of “leaving the islands but taking away the surrounding seas” – gradually squeezing the waters around Taiwan and its outlying islands without provoking an outright military conflict.

Ma said the approach, already evident in the South China Sea, was increasingly being seen in waters east of Taiwan as well as around Quemoy, Matsu, Dongsha and the Taiwan-controlled Taiping Island in the South China Sea’s Spratly archipelago. Quemoy is also known as Kinmen.

His assessment broadly echoes an October 8 analysis by the International Institute for Strategic Studies, which said Beijing had stepped up law enforcement, maritime surveillance, fisheries and research activities east of Taiwan since June.

The London-based think tank described the proliferation of mainland Chinese actors as a significant development in Beijing’s grey-zone strategy, potentially aimed at establishing a more complex system of maritime governance around Taiwan involving military and civilian agencies.

The increased activity has also raised questions over whether Taiwan can sustainably respond vessel-for-vessel without straining its own coastguard resources.

Dennis Blair, a retired US Navy four-star admiral and former commander of the US Pacific Command, said in a video address to a maritime security conference in Taipei last week that Taiwan should not automatically shadow every mainland ship or aircraft.

Taipei should instead allocate its limited resources according to the level of threat, retain operational flexibility and strengthen maritime surveillance, law enforcement and self-defence capabilities, he said.

02:04

Philippines accuses China of firing a water cannon at its vessels for a second day

Taipei has increasingly looked to learn from the Philippines and its policy of “active transparency”, under which Manila has publicised confrontations with mainland Chinese vessels in the South China Sea.

Taiwan’s coastguard plans to send a vessel carrying about 100 officers and students to the Philippines next October, its first such visit in 53 years. Taipei also [donated](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3368788/why-taiwans-coastguard-vessel-transfer-philippines-has-sparked-double-outcry?module=inline&pgtype=article) a retired patrol vessel to Manila last month.

Taiwan’s National Security Council deputy secretary general Lii Wen has called for greater technological and maritime law enforcement cooperation between the two in areas including maritime domain awareness, unmanned systems and less-lethal weapons.

Sunday’s operation was the latest in a series of encounters this month. Taiwan’s coastguard said it had driven mainland coastguard vessels away from waters around Dongsha on 11 occasions this year, involving 14 vessel appearances before the latest operation.

Since the start of this month, it has warded off 29 mainland coastguard, research, survey and fishing vessel appearances, including 16 from Sunday.

In a more serious incident on October 1, a Taiwanese coastguard vessel [used a water cannon](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3369634/taiwan-coastguard-uses-water-cannons-warn-mainland-chinese-fishing-vessel?module=inline&pgtype=article) to drive away a mainland fishing boat that refused to leave restricted waters near the Dongsha Islands, prompting a strong protest from Beijing.

09:58

Will Batanes become the next South China Sea flashpoint?

For Ma, the broader significance lies in Beijing’s apparent effort to turn repeated peacetime activity into assertions of jurisdiction – pressure that remains below the threshold of armed conflict but could gradually reshape practices in waters surrounding Taiwan.

Blair warned that the threshold would change sharply if Beijing escalated pressure by intercepting or boarding commercial vessels, forcing them to change course or imposing an effective blockade.

Such actions, he said, would move beyond grey-zone coercion and amount to acts of war.

Beijing regards Taiwan as part of China to be reunited by force if necessary. Most countries, including the US, do not recognise Taiwan as an independent state, but Washington is opposed to any attempt to take the self-ruled island by force and is committed to supplying it with weapons.

# M1A2T tanks to roll into Taiwan's Lien Yung military drill next month

10/19/2026 02:11 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

A M1A2T Tank. CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 19 (CNA) American-made M1A2T Abrams tanks will participate in a major Taiwan military exercise for the second time, when Lien Yung drills begin next month, a military source told CNA on Monday.

The Army's 584th Armored Brigade, which operates the American-made tanks, has already transported them to the Joint Operations Training Base in Pingtung County for the upcoming Lien Yung drill (聯勇操演), scheduled for late November through December, according to the source.

During the month-long joint military exercise in southern Taiwan, the tanks will test combat coordination, said the source, who asked not to be named.

The M1A2T Abrams tanks were included in a major Taiwan military drill for the first time when the country held its annual Han Kuang exercises in August.

The nationwide Han Kuang exercises, which include live-fire drills, are Taiwan's major military exercise, while the Lien Yung drills are the second-largest.

Held in southern Taiwan, the Lien Yung exercises serve as a major test of coordination among the three branches of the country's armed forces -- the Army, Navy and Air Force -- in jointly repelling an invading enemy.

Conscripts serving their mandatory one-year military service will also participate in this year's Lien Yung drills, the source said.

Su Tzu-yun (蘇紫雲), director of the Division of Defense Strategy and Resources at the Institute for National Defense and Security Research (INDSR), told CNA on Monday that the M1A2T Abrams tanks are currently operated only by volunteer soldiers, not conscripts.

Su Tzu-yun, director of the Division of Defense Strategy and Resources at the Institute for National Defense and Security Research. CNA file photo

However, it is important for conscripts to participate in large-scale live-fire exercises such as the Lien Yung drill to receive more advanced training, Su added.

Under a deal approved by Washington in 2019, Taiwan has procured 108 M1A2T Abrams tanks from the United States at a cost of about US$1.45 billion (NT$40.5 billion).

Of the 108 Abrams tanks, 38 were commissioned by the Taiwan Army's 584th Armored Brigade in late October 2025, and 42 in April this year. The other 28 are still being tested and prepared for service.

For the second time, the Army will use the Abrams tanks in a major military drill, when the Lien Yung exercises get underway in southern Taiwan next month.

(By Matt Yu and Joseph Yeh)

title: 中国推无人机出口管控新规，北京意图一石多鸟？
