content:
星期一(10月19日)中国宣布出台无人机相关物项出口管制措施。新措施将于11月18日正式实施。分析人士表示，中国作为全球无人机的主要生产者，此时出台新规管控军民两用无人机出口，是希望达到一石多鸟的目的。

最新无人机出口管制措施规定，满足特定特性的物项未经许可不得出口，出口经营者应依照相关法规向国务院商务主管部门申请许可。新规限制范围涵盖十三大类物项，包括自然视距外可控飞行、最大续航时间达到或超过30分钟，或射/航程大于等于300公里等在内的无人机整机；专用发动机、无刷电机、碳纤维桨叶等核心零部件，以及相关通信设备及软件与技术等等。

中国商务部新闻发言人10月19日在回答记者提问时表示，此次措施涉及的无人机相关物项“具有明显的军民两用属性”，中方调整有关措施，“目的是维护国家安全和利益，履行防扩散等国际义务”。

**北京意欲一石多鸟**

对于中国在此时出台无人机出口管控新规，华盛顿智库“哈德逊研究所”(Hudson Institute)资深研究员许毓仁告诉美国之音(VOA),北京应该是希望能达到一石多鸟的目的。

许毓仁说：“(北京)既有加强军民两用技术管理、防止敏感技术流向冲突地区的考量，也具有应对美国科技封锁和供应链重组的战略意图。北京希望通过强化对关键零部件、材料及技术出口的监管，保留其在全球无人机产业链中的影响力，并将供应链优势转化为地缘政治筹码。”

加拿大曼尼托巴大学(University of Manitoba)防务与安全研究中心学者赖小刚也持类似的观点。他告诉美国之音, 无人机已经改变了现代战争的作战方式，其影响已经大大超出战术和战役领域，正在对国际政治产生越来越大的影响。

长期研究中共军事与财经历史的赖小刚指出，中国目前已经成为全球无人机的主要生产者，是俄乌双方和伊朗无人机生产的主要零配件供应商，无人机在俄乌战争和美伊战争中起到了举足轻重的作用，这是北京当局始料未及的。

赖小刚告诉美国之音，中国领导人习近平在俄乌战争问题上左右为难。他表示，虽然中国是俄乌战争的最大受益者，但“尽快停火最符合北京的长远利益。(北京)加强对无人机的出口管控，就是要提高对战局的影响力。”

另外，赖小刚强调，国际局势目前充满了不确定性，中国的社会和经济在滑入深谷，习近平“希望与美国和西方国家改善关系，不希望成为国际政治中的众矢之的”；因此，中国对国产无人机的生产与出口进行管控，就成为必然。

**或促进美台无人机合作**

美台在无人机领域的合作在2026年迎来密集发展。近期美国政府正加速推动包括国防装备、无人机、无人艇、半导体等领域供应链的“非红供应链”(Non-Red Supply Chain)建设。

在无人机领域，美国国防企业正越来越多地与台湾制造商建立合作，将美国的软件实力与台湾的硬件制造能力相结合，尝试在台湾打造排除了中国零部件的无人机产业联盟。

与此同时，台湾也在展示实现无人机供应链“非红”的决心，其措施包括在军购中严格查验“非红”供应链，未涉资讯安全的元件的供应链也在实现逐步“去红”。

另外，台湾立法院在8月27日通过了反对党国民党版本的《强化国防自主暨无人载具产业发展条例》，明确未来6年，将以每年大约400亿新台币(约合12.31亿美金)的规模，推动台湾的无人机产业发展。

前台湾立法委员许毓仁告诉美国之音，中国对无人机的出口管控很可能进一步加速美台无人机产业的合作。

许毓仁指出：“因为美国已将建立排除中国关键零部件的‘非红供应链’视为国防工业安全的重要目标。台湾拥有半导体、电子制造和精密零组件的产业优势，有潜力成为美国可信赖无人机供应链的重要节点，但双方仍须克服成本、产能、关键零部件替代及规模化生产等挑战。”

**新规恐影响未来无人机供应链**

当下，俄乌战争和美伊战争仍处于胶着状态中。无人机在两场战争中的使用，特别是俄乌战争中的使用，已让世界看清楚无人机如何彻底改变了现代战争的形态。

哈德逊研究所资深研究员许毓仁告诉美国之音，俄乌战争已经证明，无人机不仅是军事技术竞争，更是工业产能、供应链韧性和持续补给能力的竞争。

他指出，中国若进一步限制关键零部件出口，可能影响“交战各方无人机的生产成本、交付速度及战场消耗后的补充能力”。

许毓仁还强调：“长期而言，这将促使各国加快供应链区域化与本土化，未来战争的胜负不仅取决于谁拥有更先进的无人机，更取决于谁能够以更低成本、更快速度持续生产和补充无人机。”

title: 李燕銘：李強接班傳聞紛飛 習四大動作戒備
summary: 【大紀元2026年10月20日訊】中共五中全會前夕，中共政治局常委、國務院總理李強密集高調活動，引發外界猜測；有關李強接班等政治傳聞紛飛。 李強是中共黨魁習近平的前大管家；曾先後主政浙江、江蘇、上海，與江浙滬政商圈及新老上海幫勢力關聯密切。李強在中共二十大躍升為中共黨內二號人物；與此同時，習的一系列人事部署及清洗行動，顯示其對李強有著多重戒備、防範。圍繞李強在二十大竄升及如今的接班傳聞，背後隱現複雜、激烈的中共高層內鬥黑幕。 ## 五中全會前夕李強高調密集活動 據中共官方報導
content:
【大紀元2026年10月20日訊】中共五中全會前夕，中共政治局常委、國務院總理李強密集高調活動，引發外界猜測；有關李強接班等政治傳聞紛飛。

李強是中共黨魁習近平的前大管家；曾先後主政浙江、江蘇、上海，與江浙滬政商圈及新老上海幫勢力關聯密切。李強在中共二十大躍升為中共黨內二號人物；與此同時，習的一系列人事部署及清洗行動，顯示其對李強有著多重戒備、防範。圍繞李強在二十大竄升及如今的接班傳聞，背後隱現複雜、激烈的中共高層內鬥黑幕。

## 五中全會前夕李強高調密集活動

據中共官方報導，中共政治局常委李強2026年10月17日至18日正式訪問烏茲別克斯坦，與烏茲別克斯坦總理阿里波夫舉行會談，並會見了烏茲別克斯坦總統米爾濟約耶夫。

李強10月18日至20日正式訪問塔吉克斯坦，會見塔吉克斯坦總統拉赫蒙，同總理拉蘇爾佐達會談，並出席上海合作組織成員國政府首腦（總理）理事會第二十五次會議。

李強結束對塔吉克斯坦的行程後，10月20日至22日將赴俄羅斯，與俄羅斯總理米舒斯京共同舉行中俄總理第三十一次定期會晤。

另外，李強10月14日在廣州出席中國進出口商品交易會開幕式並發表主旨演講，並出席座談會；10月15日在中朝新鴨綠江大橋開通儀式上發表視頻致辭，在京會見來華進行國事訪問的博茨瓦納總統博科，在北京人民大會堂舉行儀式歡迎多哥部長會議主席福雷並舉行會談；10月16日主持召開國務院常務會議；10月17日上午在京出席世界傳統醫藥大會開幕式並致辭。

## 李強接班習近平？五中全會前傳聞紛飛

中共五中全會前夕，李強高調活動，引發外界關注。尤其2026年10月12日至13日全國衛生與健康大會在北京召開，中共央視現場視頻顯示，中共七常委入場時，中共黨魁習近平走在最前面，李強緊隨其後，而其他政治局常委則明顯落後數步；外界據此「座次細節」解讀，李強地位上升、甚至可能接班。

時評人蔣罔正2026年10月14日在X平台爆料，中共中央已經明確2027年中共二十一大，李強任國家主席、總書記；丁薛祥任國務院總理；習近平保留軍委主席，是否排常委第一名尚且不知。

蔣罔正10月15日又爆料，李強接班已成定局；10月16日又爆料，「習近平在2025年12月政治局會議就明確了李強（接班）幹五年」。

時評人蔡慎坤2026年10月16日在X平台發帖質疑，李強只比習近平小五歲多，兩人年齡相差無幾，根本談不上什麼代際交替優勢。習只要他仍然掌握最高權力，就不可能把權力交給一個與自己年齡相近的人。除非他在二十一大前因突發變故喪失執政能力，才可能出現非正常權力交接。然而，即便真發生這種情況，也輪不到李強。李強既缺乏獨立掌控全局的政治實力，也沒有打破現有權力格局的膽量和手腕。

蔡慎坤2026年10月17日又在X平台發帖稱，相較於五中全會所謂重大人事調整，習近平健康狀況才是決定未來權力走向的關鍵變量。以習近平過去十多年的政治整肅、權力集中程度及其個人性格來看，期待他主動放權、讓權乃至交權，恐怕很不現實。對於習近平來說，權力早已不只是政治地位的象徵，更與他個人身家性命緊密相連。習近平未來連任多久不在於願不願意交權，而在於他的身體還能夠支撐多久。

[延伸閱讀：分析：五中權力格局難變 習政治前途繫於兩人](https://www.epochtimes.com/b5/26/10/17/n14871657.htm)

蔣罔正2026年10月17日在X平台還爆料，「五中全會明確增補中共中央政治局常委、國務院總理李強擔任中央軍委副主席，排名在張升民之前。」但一個多月前，2026年8月27日，蔣罔正發帖稱，「【獨家內幕】李強接班軍委副主席？純屬無稽之談！」「李強擔任軍委副主席，根本不現實！習近平的政治底線非常明確，中共二十一大時，中央軍委主席的權杖他是絕對不會交出來的。」

與此同時，海外自媒體「內參」又出現另一種說法：李強可能不願意在二十一大之後繼續擔任國務院總理。因為李強這個總理實際上是「有責無權」，他不願意再繼續替習近平承擔經濟政策的政治責任。說得直白一點，就是不想繼續「背鍋」。

網絡還流傳中共二十一大常委人選的不同版本。蔡慎坤在10月13日的節目中轉述，有接近李希的人士透露，習近平可能考慮把國家主席的位置交給李希，自己繼續擔任中共中央總書記和中央軍委主席。

近期還流傳一份神祕的「七人應急小組」名單。這個小組據稱涉及中共最高權力出現突發變故時的應對安排。名單上的第一個人物是彭麗媛；其他六個人分別是蔡奇、丁薛祥、胡春華、石泰峰、張升民和李小鵬；而目前在政治局常委排名第二的李強竟然不在應急小組七人名單中。

## 李強與江浙滬政商圈及新老上海幫勢力關聯密切

李強1959年7月出生，現年67歲，浙江溫州瑞安人。習近平任浙江省委書記時，2004年11月，李強由溫州市委書記提拔為浙江省委祕書長，擔任習的大管家。習近平上台後，李強先後升任浙江省長、江蘇省委書記、上海市委書記。

中共前黨魁江澤民是江蘇人。新老上海幫大佬如韓正、丁薛祥分別是浙江人、江蘇人。李強先後主政浙江、江蘇、上海，與江浙滬政商圈及新老上海幫勢力關聯密切。

中共二十大上，習被曝與江派聯手「團滅」團派，新老上海幫勢力瓜分政治局常委席次。李強由政治局委員、上海市委書記躍升排名第二的政治局常委；無國務院任職經歷的李強隨後還黑馬出任國務院總理；大概率受到上海幫勢力的力挺乃至扶植。

在浙江長期任職期間，李強與溫州民營經濟打交道，並積極推動互聯網經濟如早期馬雲的阿里巴巴的發展。中共二十大前夕，馬雲阿里巴巴及螞蟻集團曾遭習當局整肅；馬雲被邊緣化並長期隱居海外。據路透社等媒體2023年3月報導，知情人士透露新任國務院總理李強從2022年底開始，通過商業夥伴等渠道勸說身在海外的馬雲返回中國。

## 習近平對李強的四重防範

李強作為習前大管家、習家軍之江新軍的代表人物，被認為是習的心腹。但中共二十大後，習的一系列人事安排及清洗動作，顯示其對李強並不完全信任，而是有著多重戒備、防範。

**其一，習在國務院安插心腹，幾乎架空李強。**

李強出任國務院總理後，第一副總理丁薛祥是習近平的前大內總管，分管發展改革、科技、財政、稅務等關鍵部委，並兼任中俄投資合作委員會中方主席、中俄能源合作委員會中方主席，負責中俄合作的機制性對話與落實。副總理何立峰是習的福建心腹舊部，分管金融、商務外資等領域，並負責主持對美國、歐洲的重大雙邊經貿談判與對話機制。其他兩名副總理，張國清是習上台後一路提拔重用的軍工系高官；劉國中是習心腹栗戰書的黑龍江舊部，據稱還與習弟習遠平關係密切。

國務委員中，王小洪兼任公安部長，是習的福建心腹舊部；諶貽琴是習心腹栗戰書、陳敏爾的貴州舊部、同僚；只有國務院祕書長吳政隆曾在江蘇官場與李強有交集。

**其二，習家軍大員陳吉寧、王浩接掌李強老巢上海與浙江。**

中共二十大上，北京市長陳吉寧升任政治局委員，並隨後接替李強出任上海市委書記。陳吉寧是習心腹陳希大力提拔的習家軍清華系大員，且與習心腹蔡奇在北京官場搭檔。

二十大前後，彭麗媛山東菏澤老鄉王浩2021年9月由陝西省委常委、西安市委書記調任浙江省委副書記、省長，並在2024年10月升任浙江省委書記。彭麗媛山東老鄉信長星2023年1月由青海省委書記調任江蘇省委書記。

李強在二十大升任政治局常委、國務院總理後，習部署無江浙滬背景的陳吉寧、王浩、信長星等習家軍清華系、山東幫大員接管上海、浙江、江蘇官場，防範江浙滬政商圈、上海幫勢力乃至李強的意味明顯。

**其三，習家軍大員清洗李強主政地浙江、江蘇、上海及其老家溫州官場。**

另外，二十大前後，習陝西渭南老鄉、福建省委常委、紀委書記李仰哲2022年10月調任上海市委常委、紀委書記；彭麗媛山東老鄉傅明先2022年10月調任浙江省委常委、紀委書記；彭麗媛山東老鄉張忠2023年7月由吉林省委常委、紀委書記調任江蘇省委常委、紀委書記。

近年來，浙江、江蘇、上海官場均持續被清洗，包括李強老家溫州、李強大管家吳政隆老家南京官員密集落馬。

其中，張忠2023年7月至2026年8月任江蘇省紀委書記三年期間，江蘇省紀委官網通報約380名官員落馬。2026年8月22日，張忠在中紀委六次全會上晉升中紀委常務委員、副書記。

李強曾長期主政浙江、江蘇、上海，與這三省市官場窩案脫不了干係。習家軍清華系、福建幫、山東幫、陝西幫大員清洗江派上海幫、江蘇幫勢力及江浙滬政商圈的同時，無疑也掌握了不少李強的把柄。

[延伸閱讀：李燕銘：李強舊部代理上海市長 背後內鬥激烈](https://www.epochtimes.com/b5/26/9/10/n14846818.htm)
[延伸閱讀：李燕銘：張忠清洗江蘇官場升中紀委 背景解析](https://www.epochtimes.com/b5/26/9/1/n14840992.htm)

**其四，李強就任總理後與美國最高層無任何正式會晤活動。**

李強2023年3月就任國務院總理以來，除了2023年9月在印度新德里出席二十國集團（G20）領導人峰會期間，在會場同與會的美國總統拜登（Joe Biden）進行了簡短交流之外，至今與美國總統、副總統、國務卿無任何正式會晤活動。

美國總統川普2026年5月13日至15日對中國進行國事訪問；這是川普在2017年11月訪華後時隔近九年再度訪華。川普此次訪華期間，排名第二的中共政治局常委、國務院總理李強未與川普有過單獨會見、會談。

而川普上次訪華期間，2017年11月9日上午，習近平同川普在人民大會堂舉行會談；11月9日下午，時任中共國務院總理李克強又在人民大會堂會見川普。

中共歷任黨魁都將對美外交視作頭等大事；而美國白宮最高層之前在胡錦濤、習近平上台前都與之有外交活動，近距離接觸、「考察」。

習近平上台前一年，2011年8月，時任美國副總統的拜登對中國進行了正式訪問，由時任中共國家副主席習近平全程陪同接待。

胡錦濤在中共十六大上台前，2002年2月在北京會見美國總統小布什，2002年4月下旬至5月上旬正式訪問美國，先後與時任美國總統小布什、副總統切尼、防長拉姆斯菲爾德會晤。

如按爆料所言，習近平如果早已決心讓李強接班，應該安排李強與美國最高層接觸；而不是在川普訪華期間，李強都不能循李克強舊例與川普會見。

《華爾街日報》2024年12月28日爆料稱，美國候任總統川普願意和習近平內核官員直接溝通，並點名要和中共政治局常委、中央書記處書記蔡奇直接溝通；但是中共卻無法接受。令人懷疑，深陷權力危機的習近平嚴防中南海高層人物單獨與美國白宮高層接觸。

[延伸閱讀：李燕銘：習不許蔡奇與川普團隊接觸？內幕解析](https://www.epochtimes.com/b5/25/1/1/n14403943.htm)

## 結語

中共黨魁習近平十八大上台前後至今，先後拿下傳為江派指定的接班人選薄熙來、孫政才。習近平在二十大打破慣例連任，之前入常乃至接班呼聲頗高的胡春華出局，陳敏爾仕途受阻；凸顯習對接班潛在人選的重點打壓。

中共二十大前後，習在上海、浙江、江蘇的一系列人事部署及清洗行動，顯示其將重點防範、清洗目標鎖定上海幫、江蘇幫勢力；尤其李強疑被禁止與美國最高層接觸，顯示習對潛在接班人選李強有著多重戒備、防範；這為李強未來仕途命運蒙上陰影。

習至今未明確接班人選，為中共高層政治帶來極大變數。年事已高、健康頻出狀況的習近平如果在二十一大繼續連任，勢將進一步加劇中共高層內鬥及習家軍內訌。

另一方面，在習健康危機及中國經濟危機日益加劇背景之下，不排除李強挾持江浙滬政商圈及上海幫、江蘇幫勢力「逼宮」，接班或部分接班習的可能性。

習即使卸任或部分交權給李強，預計也將部署大批習家軍心腹大員進入政治局及常委會，接掌黨政軍要職，制衡、架空李強，自己循江澤民模式做「太上皇」干政。李強到時在習與江派上海幫勢力的夾擊之下，也難有作為；中共高層各派混戰只會升級，並進一步激化中共政治經濟危機。

中共五中全會前夕，上海幫高官、已退休多年的原重慶市長黃奇帆被官宣調查。有爆料指，黃奇帆案與江澤民家族及江派各派系深度交織；江澤民時代的官員面臨全面審查。李強在這新一輪清洗行動中充當了何種角色？李強長期主政江浙滬期間與江澤民家族真實關係如何？出生於中國民營經濟重要發源地溫州的李強對自由市場經濟有著怎樣的認識？內心對中共獨裁政權的真實態度又如何？這些深層因素或是決定李強未來仕途命運的關鍵所在。

（大紀元2026年10月19日首發）

title: Ramaphosa’s GNU survived an ANC rebellion, but Joburg will test everything
summary: During those hectic days in the winter of 2024, when post-election coalitions were being stitched together at national and provincial levels, South African Communist Party General Secretary Solly Mapaila was running around like a nyaope boy
content:
During those hectic days in the winter of 2024, when post-election coalitions were being stitched together at national and provincial levels, South African Communist Party General Secretary Solly Mapaila was running around like a nyaope boy desperate to find a fellow addict to help him out with a fix.

The drug he was seeking was a common, intense hatred of the DA that would prevent the ANC leadership from making a deal with the blue party.

 Solly Mapaila (SACP General Secretary) briefs the media on the latest developments on elections and the question of dual membership at COSATU House on April 23, 2026, in Johannesburg, South Africa. (Photo by Gallo Images/Lubabalo Lesolle)

Mapaila was knocking on the door of every influential and semi-influential ANC leader he could find, rallying Cosatu and Sanco comrades to the cause and engaging with potential coalition partners such as the EFF and other parties.

It did not matter that he didn’t have the mandate to negotiate any deal, which was the sole purview of the ANC’s national leadership that had been elected at the national conference in December 2022. He was on public platforms railing against the inevitable.

At the time, the EFF, his preferred main coalition partner, was sensing the ANC’s vulnerability and making impossible demands. With less than 10% of the national vote, the EFF was demanding heavyweight portfolios, including finance.

Jacob Zuma’s party, which some in the ANC were advocating as a partner alongside the EFF, insisted that the ANC drop Cyril Ramaphosa as its presidential candidate.

ANC Secretary-General Fikile Mbalula. (Photo: Gallo Images / Brenton Geach)

While Mapaila and others were running around trying to achieve the impossible, ANC Secretary-General Fikile Mbalula’s official team was putting together a more realistic deal with willing partners. It was this putative deal, with the DA as the second-most important player in the 10-party Statement of Intent, that was driving the SACP mad.

It was bad because it was, in the SACP’s view, the construct of “right-wing, DA-led anti-ANC neoliberal forces”. The crux of the panic was that these forces were trying to stymie the aims of the National Democratic Revolution by trying to capture the ANC.

“The core of the DA-led neoliberal forces, highly supported by dominant sections of capital, mainly the white bourgeoisie whose roots can be traced to the era of colonial and apartheid oppression of the black majority, organised itself into the so-called multi-party charter.

“This grouping also received support from Western foundations,” the SACP said, as it went into conspiratorial overdrive.

The Multi-Party Charter had indeed initially been driven by the DA leadership, but had included leaders who were far from being John Steenhuisen’s running dogs.

But where Nats saw “a red under bed”, Mapaila sees a neoliberal conspiracy at every corner. Since he and his cohort failed to scupper the composition of the GNU, Mapaila has not stopped frothing at the mouth about it, which he has called the “highest form of betrayal of our people”, and has continued to mobilise against it within the ANC.

President Cyril Ramaphosa. (Photo: Luba Lesolle / Gallo Images)

This hook-up was never popular in ANC ranks, so Mapaila had plenty of ears listening to him and applauding his resistance campaign. The deal was deftly and bravely shepherded through by Ramaphosa and Mbalula, who endured much private and public abuse for their efforts.

That the GNU has survived this long is testament to the maturity of leaders of both parties and the reality that both need it badly. There have been several scares, the most notable being the brinkmanship over Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana’s Budget speech in 2025 when it was only read on the third attempt.

### Court challenges

Other testing scares have included the DA’s continued court challenges to contested legislation that the ANC cunningly rammed through in its dying days as the parliamentary majority, and were signed by Ramaphosa.

In addition, there are stark differences over foreign policy, which the DA believes should be developed as a GNU product, but which the ANC is hanging on to dearly because it knows that the blue guys (as well as some other more conservative members of the GNU) would want to interfere with some longstanding liberation movement standpoints.

The biggest challenge, however, was getting the GNU through the ANC’s National General Council (NGC) unscathed, the first time it had been formally tabled to the membership.

In the buildup to the December 2025 reflective conference that occurs between conferences, there was a lot of agitation for a revisitation of the GNU arrangement. The top seven leaders and other NEC operators calmed the anger and steered the conversation away from exiting the arrangement.

In its final declaration, the NGC deemed the pact an unavoidable “tactical intervention “that was necessary for national unity and stability, as well as containing the DA within the tent”.

### Politicking

That seemed to have temporarily muted the anti-GNU voices until the 2026 election time came around. Elections are about heat. In the heat of the current local government election campaign, the historical antipathy between the two rivals has deepened.

The DA, whose marathon election campaign has run for nearly 18 months, has spared nothing in its portrayal of the ANC’s immense failures at local government level and highlighting its own successes in the municipalities where it is in power.

For its part, the ANC has retreated to its age-old characterisation of the DA as a racist party that cares only about protecting white interests. These are normal barbs that the parties have traded for the longest time, but it would be difficult to persuade a Plutonian arriving on Planet Earth that these were coalition partners.

The thing is, the pressure is again growing within the ANC and its Tripartite Alliance partners to, as the cadres put it, “kick the DA out of the GNU”.

It does not seem to have dawned on many of them that the GNU is not theirs to kick anybody out of. They may belong to the 40% party, but this is an arrangement that was precipitated by the loss of outright power.

Cosatu president Zingiswa Losi (left) and first deputy president Mike Shingange (right) address delegates at the Cosatu 15th National Conference in Emperor’s Palace. (Photo: AFADWU / X)

At the conclusion of its congress last week, newly elected Cosatu General Secretary Zingiswa Losi read out a resolution that “affirmed …the rejection of a GNU inclusive of right-wing political parties and their neoliberal austerity agenda.”

Sunday World this week reported on a pre-congress document that asserted after the 2024 election “… the leadership of the ANC negotiated behind our backs as Alliance partners, making clandestine deals with the sworn enemy of workers and the poor, the DA. This is the DA that remains an anti-worker, anti-poor, and white supremacist organisation, funded by capital to pursue their interests.”

Then came the bombshell pronouncement from Mbalula himself, after the ANC won the Constitutional Court case against the IEC on the inclusion of candidates for which it had missed the deadline, that the ANC would review the DA’s participation in the GNU because the party had joined the matter as an amicus curiae.

Parliament is big enough to find other partners, Mbalula said, and “there’s nothing that binds us forever with the DA.”

ANC Youth League president Collen Malatji, who tries so hard to be a Julius Malema that he reduces himself to a Disney version of the real thing, also waded in and called for Ramaphosa to immediately fire all DA ministers.

Because of all this noise, there was some flutter about how the arrangement was under threat. The thing, though, is that strong opposition to the GNU within the ANC has never gone away.

### Ramaphosa, the GNU’s glue

Ramaphosa has never been anyone you accuse of being infected with the virus of leadership, but in the management of the GNU, this accusation has to stick. He has been excellent at holding things together, even as the DA sometimes behaved petulantly. Many in his party said he had put so much effort into the health of the GNU because it was a project of big capital, of which he is supposedly a loyal servant.

Amid all the flutter, Ramaphosa brushed away Mbalula’s comment by stating firmly that the reasons that got the GNU partners between the same sheets in 2024 still pertain, reminding all that “we are different parties with different policies, different ideologies, different histories…and we are in the main, contestants.”

Brushing away the anti-GNU sentiment might just be the easy part for the president of the ANC. In a few weeks’ time he will have to lead his party through negotiations over the governance of the metros, secondary cities and towns. Many are in precarious states or already in ICU, largely as a result of ANC misgovernance and corruption.

The ANC will be weaker in most of the municipalities where it will be negotiating coalitions, so it will be vulnerable to charlatans and opportunists. Provincial, regional and local leaders will most probably be keen to make deals with the chancers. For the sake of retaining power, the national bosses will probably give these leaders some leeway to make questionable deals.

### Johannesburg: The big test

However, the headache will be in the economic epicentres where total collapse cannot be risked. The Great, Big, Beautiful City of Johannesburg will be one of the biggest tests Ramaphosa faces since taking his second oath of office.

The nation’s economic engine has been teetering on the brink of financial and infrastructural collapse for some time, and as the now popular saying goes: If Joburg fails, SA pays. The past eight years of fluid politics at local government have taught us that local ANC networks – political, business and labour – do not like the idea of not being in power. More so in the metros. And more so in Johannesburg.

In 2024, the ANC’s Gauteng leadership defied Luthuli House and rejected a deal with the DA when the latter made demands that Panyaza Lesufi and his lieutenants deemed as untenable as the EFF’s demands at national level.

It was more than that, though. They simply saw working with the DA as a sell-out option. That has not changed. And if anything, attitudes have hardened. Most polls put the DA comfortably ahead of the ANC, while some give the black, green and gold a marginal lead. Whichever way you look at it, if the ANC wants to retain a segment of executive power, it will not be dictating terms.

DA mayoral candidate for the City of Johannesburg Helen Zille. (Photo: Brenton Geach / Gallo Images)

So, Ramaphosa has a dilemma. If the DA does emerge as the biggest party in the city, will he be able to compel his provincial and regional lords to accept a secondary role in its governance? Pretending to play second fiddle to Al Jama-ah in the past may have worked, but sharing power with an in-charge Helen Zille will be a whole different kettle of fish.

If the ANC narrowly snatches victory, will it be willing to replicate the national picture for the sake of “stability”? And if the provincial and regional lords dig in, is he willing to gamble his last year as ANC president on an unpopular coalition decision?

And, if the ANC chooses another path, which other significant forces can it turn to get over the 50-plus mark? There is ActionSA, the IFP and smaller players, but that will not be enough.

As leaders at the national level have pointed out, the blue pill is one they just might have to swallow, and deal with the consequences later. **DM**

title: Ethiopia: Airbus Projects Sixfold Growth in Ethiopia's Air Passenger Traffic Over Next 20 Years
summary: Addis Ababa — Airbus has forecast a sixfold rise in Ethiopia's air passenger traffic over the next 20 years, saying Ethiopian Airlines is well placed to turn Addis Ababa into one of Africa's leading aviation hubs. It cited Ethiopian Airline
content:
Addis Ababa — Airbus has forecast a sixfold rise in Ethiopia's air passenger traffic over the next 20 years, saying Ethiopian Airlines is well placed to turn Addis Ababa into one of Africa's leading aviation hubs.

It cited Ethiopian Airlines' expanding network, growing demand and planned airport infrastructure as key factors positioning Addis Ababa to become a leading aviation hub in Africa

Airbus Vice President for Market Analysis and Forecast Antonio Da Costa told ENA that Ethiopia has strong growth potential, with Ethiopian Airlines well positioned to capitalize on rising passenger numbers and expanding regional and international connectivity.

"We're obviously extremely proud to be a partner of Ethiopian Airlines," Da Costa said. "Ethiopian Airlines are our first A350 customer in Africa and have been a great customer of the 350 over the last 10 years."

Da Costa said the airline's established network, fleet capabilities and hub strategy would help it accommodate the projected increase in passenger traffic.

"We obviously see a very good and strong potential of growth in Ethiopia with over six times more passengers coming over the next 20 years," he said. "So we believe that Ethiopian Airlines is well placed to cover and to take advantage of that growth."

Airbus also projects that African air traffic will triple over the same period, creating opportunities for airlines and airports to expand capacity and strengthen connections across the continent and beyond.

Da Costa said Addis Ababa's role in African aviation would become increasingly significant as Ethiopia develops its planned airport infrastructure, including the new airport project in Bishoftu.

Ethiopia has described the Bishoftu airport project as the largest aviation infrastructure undertaking in Africa's history. Upon completion and full operation, the airport is expected to accommodate up to 110 million passengers annually and serve as Ethiopian Airlines' principal operating base.

"We expect that Addis Ababa and with the new airport to become more and more a central hub for the traffic in Africa," Da Costa said. "We expect that growth of trans-African traffic for the Ethiopian coverage will be increasing by about six times over the next 20 years."

Ethiopian Airlines became the first African operator of the Airbus A350 in 2016 and subsequently became the first African customer for the larger A350-1000, strengthening its position in the continent's long-haul aviation market.

Da Costa described Ethiopian Airlines as a historic African carrier and reaffirmed Airbus's commitment to supporting its expansion with modern, fuel-efficient aircraft suited to its growing operational needs.

"As we want to continue to grow with new aircraft, better aircraft, we're always open to hear from Ethiopian Airlines what their needs are," he said. "We will do our utmost to make sure that we can provide the best aircraft to serve the growing needs of the airline."

He noted that connecting passengers account for nearly two-thirds of Ethiopian Airlines' traffic, highlighting Addis Ababa's importance as a transfer point linking destinations across Africa with Europe, Asia, the Americas and other international markets.

"We're delighted that we have aircraft like the A350 that is capable of connecting Addis Ababa to effectively the whole world," Da Costa said. "By doing so, we believe that we're providing Ethiopian Airlines with the right tools to continue this strong growth."

He added that Airbus would continue working with Ethiopian Airlines to provide aircraft, technical support and operational solutions to help the carrier expand efficiently and sustainably as demand for air travel increases.

The projected growth would further strengthen Ethiopia's ambitions to consolidate its position as a major gateway for African aviation, while the planned airport infrastructure is expected to provide additional capacity to support the airline's long-term expansion.

title: Ethiopia: Alliance for Survival Rejects Rubio's Characterization of Ethiopia's Conflict As Separatist, Terr...
summary: Addis Abeba — The Ethiopian Peoples' Forces Alliance for Survival (Alliance for Survival), a coalition of armed and [political](https://addisstandard.com/alliance-for-survival-rejects-rubios-characterization-of-ethiopias-conflict-as-separat
content:
Addis Abeba — The Ethiopian Peoples' Forces Alliance for Survival (Alliance for Survival), a coalition of armed and [political](https://addisstandard.com/alliance-for-survival-rejects-rubios-characterization-of-ethiopias-conflict-as-separatist-terrorist/ "https://addisstandard.com/alliance-for-survival-rejects-rubios-characterization-of-ethiopias-conflict-as-separatist-terrorist/") groups opposing the federal government, has rejected remarks by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio characterizing aspects of Ethiopia's conflict as separatist and terrorist, calling on Washington to adopt what it described as a balanced approach to the conflict.

In a statement issued on 18 October, the alliance said its military operations were not driven by separatist objectives or intended to fragment the country. Instead, it described its actions as self-defense after what it called the government's rejection of efforts to achieve a peaceful resolution, including through the November 2022 Pretoria Agreement.

The alliance said its stated objective was to facilitate an inclusive democratic transition, restore peace and stability, and allow Ethiopians to determine the country's political future.

It also rejected the characterization of its attacks on government military installations as terrorism, arguing that such descriptions misrepresented the conflict. The alliance accused government forces of using more advanced weapons against both military targets and densely populated civilian areas in territories under its control. Addis Standard could not independently verify the allegations.

Follow us on [WhatsApp](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K "https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K") | [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/ "https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/") for the latest headlines

The statement warned that such characterizations could encourage the government to continue its military campaign and undermine efforts to resolve the conflict peacefully.

The alliance urged the United States to adopt what it called a balanced and constructive position to support a lasting peace in Ethiopia.

The statement follows Rubio's remarks on the conflict in Ethiopia during an interview with C-SPAN.

The Alliance for Survival brings together several armed and political groups opposed to the federal government, including the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF), the Oromo Liberation Army (OLA), the Amhara Fano National Movement (AFNM), and other groups from different regions. Its formation was announced in September amid renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia.

Rubio's remarks come amid continued clashes between federal government forces and armed groups affiliated with the Alliance for Survival across multiple fronts in northern Ethiopia and other parts of the country.

On 24 September 2026, Addis Standard reported that the European Union had expressed concern [over the formation of a new coalition of Ethiopian opposition](https://addisstandard.com/?p=59591 "https://addisstandard.com/?p=59591") and armed groups, warning of a deteriorating security situation in northern Ethiopia and its impact on civilians.

The EU said it was "deeply concerned by the rapidly deteriorating situation in Northern Ethiopia and its impact on the population," citing reports of military activity across multiple localities. It called for "immediate de-escalation" and urged the parties to recommit to the November 2022 Permanent Cessation of Hostilities Agreement, signed in Pretoria between the federal government and the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF).

#### Sign up for free AllAfrica Newsletters

Get the latest in African news delivered straight to your inbox

The EU stressed that differences between the parties could "only be resolved through dialogue and not military action" and called for compliance with international humanitarian law, emphasizing the obligation to protect civilians and safeguard the impartiality and independence of humanitarian operations.

The coalition, initially announced as the Ethiopian Peoples' Forces Coalition for Survival, was formally unveiled on 20 September in a statement read live [on Tigrai TV by Zemene Kassie](https://addisstandard.com/?p=59428 "https://addisstandard.com/?p=59428"), chairman of the Amhara Fano National Movement (AFNM). Seven opposition and armed groups declared a shared objective of removing the Prosperity Party-led government and establishing an inclusive transitional administration.

The coalition comprises the AFNM, the Oromo Liberation Army (OLA), the TPLF, the Ogaden National Liberation Front (ONLF), the Afar National Unity Revolutionary Front, the Benishangul Peoples' Liberation Movement, and the Gumuz Peoples' Democratic Movement.

The announcement followed months of reported efforts to coordinate opposition groups across regional and political lines. In August, Zemene said [agreements had been reached](https://addisstandard.com/fano-leader-says-armed-groups-have-formed-coalition-to-work-toward-fall-of-abiy-ahmed/ "https://addisstandard.com/fano-leader-says-armed-groups-have-formed-coalition-to-work-toward-fall-of-abiy-ahmed/") with several armed opposition groups to establish a broader alliance aimed at the "fall of Abiy Ahmed." The September announcement gave the emerging alignment a formal name and publicly stated its political objectives.

德语媒体：德国实在太虚伪 图像来源: Matthias Balk/dpa/picture alliance

（德国之声中文网）《法兰克福汇报》评论指出，与其抱怨中国的政府补贴以及汇率优势，德国提升自身竞争力才是当务之急。这篇题为《德国实在太虚伪》的评论写道：

“曾有人对这个国家赞不绝口，称之为世界出口冠军。也有人对这个国家提出批评，认为这里进口太少，贸易失衡过于严重。除了内需不振，这里的货币还被低估，这也使该国出口产品在国外变得更加便宜。出口给该国的汽车行业带来了巨大的收益，而政府对汽车行业的参与也明显超过其他行业。该国很多就业岗位都同汽车工业相关，这本身并不符合市场经济的教义。作为经济大国，这个国家对来自外界的批评一向置之不理，而是理直气壮地回应道；我们的汽车就是比竞争对手更胜一筹。

这个故事适用于二十一世纪00年代的德国，同样也适用于二十一世纪20年代的中华人民共和国。也正因为如此，德国政府表现出的截然不同的态度更为引人关注。上周的欧盟峰会之前，德国和法国政府联合呼吁欧盟委员会，把自由贸易搁置一旁，而应将欧盟内部市场的准入当作地缘政治武器。毕竟，现在德国汽车工业处境艰难，而廉价[中国电动车](https://dw.com/zh/%E4%BA%89%E5%A4%BA%E6%AC%A7%E6%B4%B2%E6%B6%88%E8%B4%B9%E8%80%85-%E5%B7%B4%E9%BB%8E%E8%BD%A6%E5%B1%95%E6%88%90%E4%B8%AD%E6%AC%A7%E8%BD%A6%E4%BC%81%E8%A7%92%E5%8A%9B%E5%9C%BA/a-79652085)的到来更是雪上加霜。汽油价格高企的当下，中国电动车受到了欧洲消费者的热捧。

从早年的重商主义，到今天的特朗普，自由贸易的所有反对者都喜欢重复这样的老腔调：出口者赢，进口者输。只是和以往不同的是，这一次陷入贸易失衡另一方的德国也加入了这个大合唱。在相当长的时期内，德国政府一直都在宣扬自由贸易，这其中汽车工业当然也功不可没，毕竟他们担心销售市场的流失。现在风向彻底发生了变化。亲雇主的德国经济研究所表示，2026年，德中贸易逆差有可能会超过一千亿欧元，而德国曾经的三大出口支柱更是首当其冲：[汽车](https://dw.com/zh/%E5%BE%B7%E5%9B%BD%E7%94%B5%E5%8A%A8%E8%BD%A6%E8%A1%A5%E8%B4%B4%E9%A6%96%E5%85%88%E6%83%A0%E5%8F%8A%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E5%93%81%E7%89%8C%E7%8E%AF%E5%A2%83%E9%83%A8%E7%9B%AE%E5%89%8D%E5%B9%B6%E6%97%A0%E8%BF%B9%E8%B1%A1/a-77608839)、电子和机械制造。”

法兰克福汇报：德国汽车工业处境艰难，廉价中国电动车的到来更是雪上加霜。图像来源: Jan Woitas/dpa/picture alliance

《法兰克福汇报》评论指出，构建[贸易壁垒](https://dw.com/zh/%E5%BE%B7%E8%AF%AD%E5%AA%92%E4%BD%93%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E7%94%B5%E5%8A%A8%E8%BD%A6%E7%BB%88%E5%B0%86%E8%BF%9B%E5%85%A5%E6%AC%A7%E6%B4%B2%E5%B8%82%E5%9C%BA/a-77774388)其实并不能为相关行业延长寿命，却会剥夺德国消费者自由选择以及获得性价比更优产品的权利：

“当然，[欧盟](https://dw.com/zh/%E6%AC%A7%E7%9B%9F/t-17452286)为了在贸易战中有备无患，设立反制工具，这本身无可厚非，例如应对中国再度限制稀土出口的情况。人为压低的汇率确实为中国带来了益处，中国也确实应当提升国内消费，这些都是毋庸置疑的。但是，偏偏德国以此为论据，要求实施[贸易壁垒](https://dw.com/zh/%E5%BE%B7%E8%AF%AD%E5%AA%92%E4%BD%93%E9%9A%BE%E4%BB%A5%E5%A5%8F%E6%95%88%E7%9A%84%E5%A8%81%E6%85%91%E6%AD%A6%E5%99%A8/a-79565894)，就显得有些虚伪了。

声称竞争对手的生存全凭政府补贴的说法，显然早已过时了。事实上，那些正在冲击世界市场的[中国新型企业](https://dw.com/zh/%E5%BE%B7%E8%AF%AD%E5%AA%92%E4%BD%93%E8%A5%BF%E6%96%B9%E5%BA%94%E5%BD%93%E5%90%91%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E5%AD%A6%E4%B9%A0%E8%B5%84%E6%9C%AC%E4%B8%BB%E4%B9%89/a-77150634)对低息国家贷款的依赖程度远远低于老企业。根据中国智库CF40的统计，新行业中政府补贴在盈利中的占比已经明显下降。或许，欧洲是时候接受这样一个事实了：一个每年培养出上百万工程师的国家，其产品注定更具创新性。德国为什么不从培养人才入手呢？”

## ”稀土自给自足只是一厢情愿的幻想“

西方各国已意识到在稀土等关键原材料领域对中国的高度依赖，于是乎，美国、英国和欧盟都相继推出了各自的稀土战略。不过，《新苏黎世报》评论认为，自给自足只是一厢情愿的幻想：

“我们因为自身的过错而陷入了危险的依赖。西方必须转变思想，才能吸引投资：民众必须接受为获取稀土而开矿和冶炼，政府必须减少那些阻碍投资的繁文缛节，而企业为了获得供货安全，则必须情愿支付更高的价格。

但尽管如此，[自给自足](https://dw.com/zh/%E6%BE%B3%E5%A4%A7%E5%88%A9%E4%BA%9A%E5%B0%8F%E9%95%87%E5%B0%86%E5%BB%BA%E6%88%90%E8%A5%BF%E6%96%B9%E9%92%AA%E4%BE%9B%E5%BA%94%E5%9F%BA%E7%9F%B3/a-78288297)也只能是幻想。咨询公司安永发布的一份调研显示，在2050年前实现同中国脱钩，需要累计付出23万亿美元的代价。相比之下，实现部分的自给自足更为重要，西方尤其应当提升自身竞争力，只有这样才能让中国重新依赖西方。无论是过去，还是将来，相互依赖都是避免冲突的最佳保障。”

title: 要闻分析 - 在俄导弹袭乌的轰炸中 俄中美“联盟”显形了?
summary: 周一19日凌晨俄罗斯发射多波导弹袭击基辅，至少造成1人死亡、8人受伤。乌克兰总统泽连斯基就此表示：虽然俄罗斯以弹道导弹攻击基辅及周边地区的能源设施，但乌方事前并未收到盟国的预警。所谓的盟国指的当然是美国 泽连斯基指出，俄罗斯19日向基辅及周边地区发射16枚弹道导弹，并向乌克兰各地出动了200架以上的无人机。法新社记者报道说：在首都基辅可以听到空袭警报与爆炸声。 乌克兰总统19日在社群媒体发文表示：俄罗斯再次发动弹道飞弹攻击，一整夜分多次袭击，而我们的伙伴又一次没有事先发出预警
content:
周一19日凌晨俄罗斯发射多波导弹袭击基辅，至少造成1人死亡、8人受伤。乌克兰总统泽连斯基就此表示：虽然俄罗斯以弹道导弹攻击基辅及周边地区的能源设施，但乌方事前并未收到盟国的预警。所谓的盟国指的当然是美国

泽连斯基指出，俄罗斯19日向基辅及周边地区发射16枚弹道导弹，并向乌克兰各地出动了200架以上的无人机。法新社记者报道说：在首都基辅可以听到空袭警报与爆炸声。

乌克兰总统19日在社群媒体发文表示：俄罗斯再次发动弹道飞弹攻击，一整夜分多次袭击，而我们的伙伴又一次没有事先发出预警。基辅方面上周就曾经指出，美国先前也未针对类似攻击发出预警，使居民几乎没有时间躲进避难设施。

但美国国务卿卢比奥19日稍早否认美国曾暂停与乌克兰分享情报。

美国总统特朗普近日数次就俄乌战争批评泽连斯基。他曾表示，美国已与俄罗斯达成协议，以放宽制裁换取俄国出口燃料。

特朗普18日在自家社群平台“真实社群”（Truth Social）发文称，他在推动俄乌和平谈判方面正取得“重大进展”，但泽连斯基既“不在乎”也“不希望结束这场战争”。

于是泽连斯基19日在贴文中反驳特朗普以上说法，他强调：“乌克兰从来就不想打这场战争，也一直欢迎合作伙伴为使战争有尊严地落幕所付出的一切努力。”

他还说：俄罗斯的回应，就是一次又一次的弹道导弹、见证者（Shahed）无人机与杀戮。

他补充道：“当对乌克兰的防空导弹供应受阻，俄罗斯却获得了制裁放宽或延后实施的待遇，很遗憾，这显示我们有些伙伴不愿正视现实。”

美国特朗普政府用断供防空导弹和星链不灵等方式逼迫乌克兰放弃袭击俄罗斯能源目标，就在双方矛盾公开化的节点上，普京在加大打击乌克兰的同时，又抛出外交武器，提议要在中国深圳亚太经合会峰会期间，与习近平和特朗普共商：如何在对俄罗斯有利的情形下结束俄乌战争？

一名前俄国情报官员向华尔街日报透露，普京是在10月9日与特朗普通话时提出的这个构想，当天的通话还促成了美俄柴油协议，让美国得以购买俄罗斯柴油，并协助俄方将柴油销往全球市场。

克里姆林宫发言人则证实这一消息属实，并且相关各方的确在讨论举行这类会晤的可能。虽然目前对于会晤本身及可能讨论的议程，尚无明确共识，“但3方都承认，举行这类会晤在理论上可行”。

报导还引述一名美方高层表示，特朗普虽尚未同意举行这场峰会，但特朗普希望兑现竞选承诺、结束俄乌战争，因此推测特朗普很可能对这项提议抱持开放态度。

据报俄方已透过外交管道向北京提出这项构想，中方则表明只要特朗普同意，中方不反对举行会晤。

报导还引述前俄国情报官员表示，普京过去就曾分别向特朗普和习近平提议举行3方峰会，不过这次提出时机正逢美俄关系回温，目前态势的天秤正朝有利俄国倾斜。

莫斯科盼促成美俄中3方对话，将欧洲排除在外；克里姆林宫认为，欧洲是阻碍俄乌战争结束的背后力量。

这名前俄国情报官员甚至表示，普京有意将可能的美俄中3国领袖会形塑成第二次雅尔塔会议，接此重新划分彼此的全球势力范围。华尔街日报认为如果这场峰会在排除欧洲与乌克兰参与下登场，等于开创罕见先例，势必引发欧洲各国高度警戒。

**同一天10月19日的另一条消息也令人生疑：**

自己发动对乌克兰战争快5年，需要习近平特朗普加持的普京现在试图扮演调解伊朗战事的角色，他派俄国外交部长拉夫罗夫19日抵达伊朗进行访问，这是中东战争爆发以来俄外长首度到访伊朗。

法新社报导，本月初，俄罗斯总统普京曾告诉伊朗总统裴泽斯基安（Masoud Pezeshkian），俄国准备为中东地区的战争调解工作贡献心力。

拉夫罗夫预计将与伊朗外交部长阿拉奇（Abbas Araghchi）会面，他表示，俄国的努力“旨在防止重返大规模战争”。目前伊朗与美国的谈判处于僵局状态。

最近特朗普公开展示对普京的友好和对乌克兰的背叛，已经引发舆论对特朗普动机的怀疑。特朗普逼迫泽连斯基单方面停止轰炸俄罗斯能源设施，说是为了降低油价，人们无法相信但找不到真实原因。

**部分答案现在显现了：其实是特朗普在与普京做交易，他对普京高抬贵手，普京则可以发挥对伊朗政权的影响力，最终让特朗普更体面地从海湾战争泥潭中脱身。**

**被牺牲的当然就是乌克兰，而能阻止这一切的最重要力量也只能来自美国内部。即将到来的中期选举重要性毋庸置疑。**

## 埃博拉疫情在非洲大陆继续扩散

在非洲大陆，由本迪布焦病毒（Ebola Bundibugyo）引发的第17轮埃博拉疫情仍在扩散。这是本台法广非洲组（RFI Afrique）在刚刚过去的周末两天里的法文报道关注焦点之一。在位于刚果民主共和国（RD Congo）西北部、与中非共和国(RCA)接壤地区，继南乌班吉省（Province du Sud-Ubangi）于一个月前发现首位确诊患者之后，邻近的北乌班吉省（Nord-Ubangi）现在成为该国第8个被本轮疫情波及的省份。当地至少已有2宗新的确诊病例，其中一人染病身亡。在东非国家肯尼亚(le Kenya)境内，内罗毕卫生当局于2026年10月18日星期天通报了该国第8宗埃博拉确诊病例，另有约130人遭隔离。这是法兰西24小时新闻频道（France 24）的一则最新法文消息。

[![Image 2: 法广制图 / 埃博拉：北乌班吉省（Nord-Ubangi）现已成为刚果（金）第8个被本轮疫情波及的省份。 RFI Montage / Ebola : l’épidémie s’étend au Nord-Ubangi, une 8ᵉ province de la République démocratique du Congo. (illustration)](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5c597ede-cbf6-11f1-b0a1-d1d2c32ebb87/w:1024/2026-10-19-l-FMM-Image-Afrique-RD-Congo-carte-des-provinces-archive-RFI.jpg) 法广制图 / 埃博拉：北乌班吉省（Nord-Ubangi）现已成为刚果（金）第8个被本轮疫情波及的省份。 RFI Montage / Ebola : l’épidémie s’étend au Nord-Ubangi, une 8ᵉ province de la République démocratique du Congo. (illustration) © ceni.cd / Montage RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/20261019-rfi%E6%B3%95%E5%BB%A3-%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-%E5%B0%BC%E5%8F%A4%E6%8B%89-%E5%9F%83%E5%8D%9A%E6%8B%89%E7%96%AB%E6%83%85%E5%9C%A8%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2%E5%A4%A7%E9%99%B8%E7%B9%BC%E7%BA%8C%E6%93%B4%E6%95%A3)
综合本台法广[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)组（RFI Afrique）和法兰西24小时新闻频道（France 24）刊出的多篇法文报道。来自东非地区的消息显示，[肯尼亚](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D/%E8%82%AF%E5%B0%BC%E4%BA%9A/)（le [Kenya](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/kenya/)）在2026年10月18日星期天又发现了一个埃博拉（Ebola）确诊病例。在此前一天，内罗毕卫生当局于2026年10月17日星期六对外通报新增4宗埃博拉确诊病例。自埃博拉-本迪布焦病毒（[Ebola Bundibugyo](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/en-bref/20260911-ebola-en-rdc-l-%C3%A9pid%C3%A9mie-s-%C3%A9tend-%C3%A0-une-7e-province-le-sud-ubangi-annonce-son-gouverneur)）于10月初在首都内罗毕首次出现以来，该国现有累计确诊病例8宗，其中1名患者死亡。

[![Image 3: Kenya imeimarisha uchunguzi katika mipaka yake na nchi jirani haswa kwenye mpaka wa Busia, Mji unaopakana na Uganda](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/02e7c6b6-cbf2-11f1-bdd4-6313a763b466/w:1024/2026-10-19-l-FMM-Image-Afrique-RD-Congo-Ebola-Reuters-archive-RFI.jpg) 存档图片 / 非洲 - 肯尼亚通报第8宗埃博拉确诊病例。 Image d'archive / Afrique - le Kenya : un huitième cas du virus Ebola a été recensé. (illustration) REUTERS - James Keyi / archive RFI](https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261019-kenya-un-huiti%C3%A8me-cas-du-virus-ebola-a-%C3%A9t%C3%A9-recens%C3%A9)
**--****肯尼亚保持门户开放但对相关的密切接触者执行隔离****--**

据内罗毕卫生当局在上周六时的介绍，[肯尼亚](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%97%9C%E9%8D%B5%E8%A9%9E/%E8%82%AF%E5%B0%BC%E4%BA%9E/)新增的这几名患者中，有一名男性是首宗确诊病例的家属。其余3名新增患者均为曾照护过这名首例病例的医护人员，他们目前已被隔离。肯尼亚首宗埃博拉确诊患者是一名肯尼亚籍男子。他于两周前的10月3日从刚果民主共和国返回，在抵达该国首都后48小时内死亡。内罗毕当局的通报显示，这四人“出现发热症状”后，即被隔离，随之才被检测出阳性。肯尼亚卫生部在一份声明中试图安抚公众，表示这对公众构成的风险较低。

[![Image 4: Format adapté 1920 x 1080](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/22f2c334-4d85-11f1-b190-005056a90284/w:1024/2026-05-11-l-FMM-archive-Afrique-Kenya-carte-du-pays-Data-RFI.jpg) 存档地图 / 非洲：肯尼亚及其首都内罗毕（Nairobi）。 carte archive / Afrique : Kenya et sa capitale: Nairobi. © FMM](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/kenya/)
本台法广[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)组（RFI Afrique）的同一法文报道说，目前没有证据表明埃博拉病毒已在社区内发生传播。在已确认的130名接触者中，共有128人已被隔离。该部补充称，肯尼亚目前一切如常，在旅行、贸易或公共集会方面均未实施任何限制措施。

**--****埃博拉病毒在刚果（金）与中非共和国边境地带扩散****--**

另外，本台法广[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%97%9C%E9%8D%B5%E8%A9%9E/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)组（RFI Afrique）于2026年10月17日星期六曾刊出另一篇法文报道介绍说，在第17轮埃博拉(Ebola)疫情发源地[刚果民主共和国](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D/%E5%88%9A%E6%9E%9C-%E9%87%91/)（la[RD Congo](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/rdc/)），位于该国西北部与[中非共和国](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%97%9C%E9%8D%B5%E8%A9%9E/%E4%B8%AD%E9%9D%9E%E5%85%B1%E5%92%8C%E5%9C%8B/)（RCA - [République Centrafricaine](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/centrafrique/)）接壤的北乌班吉省（[Nord-Ubangi](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261017-rdc-deux-cas-d-ebola-enregistr%C3%A9s-dans-la-province-du-nord-ubangi)）又发现了新的确诊病例。当地新确诊的两宗埃博拉病例里，有一人已经死亡。这两宗病例均位于Wapinda卫生区。这是邻近[中非共和国](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D/%E4%B8%AD%E9%9D%9E%E5%85%B1%E5%92%8C%E5%9B%BD/)边境的一个矿业城镇。

[![Image 5: La localisation de la province du Sud-Ubangi, en RDC.](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/613e10ee-aded-11f1-bd38-005056a90284/w:1024/FR-MAP-RDC-SUD-UBANGI-0-00-05-00.png) La localisation de la province du Sud-Ubangi, en RDC. © Studio FMM](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/en-bref/20260911-ebola-en-rdc-l-%C3%A9pid%C3%A9mie-s-%C3%A9tend-%C3%A0-une-7e-province-le-sud-ubangi-annonce-son-gouverneur)
据知情的消息渠道透露，这些病例被认为与邻省[南乌班吉省](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/20260912-rfi%E6%B3%95%E5%BB%A3-%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-%E5%B0%BC%E5%8F%A4%E6%8B%89-%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2-%E5%9F%83%E5%8D%9A%E6%8B%89%E6%94%BB%E5%85%A5%E5%89%9B%E6%9E%9C-%E9%87%91-%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%83%E7%9C%81)（[Sud-Ubangi](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/en-bref/20260911-ebola-en-rdc-l-%C3%A9pid%C3%A9mie-s-%C3%A9tend-%C3%A0-une-7e-province-le-sud-ubangi-annonce-son-gouverneur)）此前记录的确诊患者有关。一名男子曾于9月初，从刚果（金）乔波省（Tshopo）省城基桑加尼（Kisangani）出发、沿刚果河乘船旅行途中发病。相关部门已确定了曾与这名已故男性确诊患者有过接触的相关人员。

**-- 刚果（金）当局沿途追查确诊患者密切接触人的行踪****--**

同一消息渠道告诉本台法广[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)组（RFI Afrique）：“这些接触者搭乘摩托车（à moto）前往北乌班吉省（Nord-Ubangi），因此有关方面已预料到这个地区可能会出现确诊病例。”

[![Image 6: RFI Data / RD Congo : carte du pays et sa capitale Kinshasa + des grandes villes. (Format adapté : 1920 x 1080)](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/85d072c0-7edc-11f1-bcf5-005056bfb2b6/w:1024/2027-12-07-D-FMM-archive-Afrique-RD-Congo.jpg) 存档地图 / 非洲 - 刚果（金）及其首都金沙萨（Kinshasa） carte archive / Afrique - RD Congo : carte du pays et sa capitale Kinshasa. (illustration) © carte archive RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/rdc/)
本台法广非洲组（RFI Afrique）的这则消息最后告知，[刚果（金）](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%97%9C%E9%8D%B5%E8%A9%9E/%E5%89%9B%E6%9E%9C-%E9%87%91/)当局已经派出了一支由七名专家组成的应对小组。他们的目标是追踪并隔离有高风险（haut risque）的接触者，以防疫情在刚果民主共和国（RD Congo）境内的北乌班吉省（Nord-Ubangi）进一步扩散。

# Taiwan Railway to ban political advertising in stations from 2027

10/19/2026 05:18 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 19 (CNA) State-owned Taiwan Railway Corp. (TR) on Monday said it would ban political advertisements in its stations with effect from next year, following criticism that such ads violated administrative neutrality.

The issue stems from a Threads post last week, in which a user shared photos of a campaign poster for Kuomintang (KMT) Yunlin County magistrate candidate Chang Chia-chun (張嘉郡) displayed next to ticket gates at Douliu Railway Station.

The user noted that TR prohibits the rental of station facilities for "political activities" such as campaign rallies. They argued that the ban likely also applied to political advertising, but was not being enforced.

In a statement on Monday, Taiwan Railway said that according to interpretations by the Central Election Commission and Ministry of Civil Service, advertising spaces at TR stations leased to third parties are considered commercial leases, and do not violate administrative neutrality regulations.

A caricature of ruling Democratic Progressive Party's Keelung mayoral candidate Tong Tzu-wei is displayed inside the Keelung Station on Monday. Photo courtesy of a local reader for illustrative purposes

The railway added that it exercised oversight by requiring the fair treatment of candidates from all political parties, and limits the size of such advertisements.

However, "out of consideration for public perception and a commitment to administrative neutrality," the company said, it had decided to discontinue political and election-related ad space rentals in its stations from Jan. 1, 2027.

Political advertisements already posted will not be affected by new policy, it added.

Taiwan's 2026 local elections will be held on Nov. 28.

(By Yu Hsiao-han and Matthew Mazzetta)

title: 一文看懂：美中俄或举行乌克兰问题会谈 大国外交能否推动战争终结？
summary: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)星期一(10月19日)针对美中俄三方可能就乌克兰战争举行高层会谈表示，“只要我能做任何事来结束战争，我都会去做。”特朗普总统也在回答美国之音中文部记者提问时表示，他会与中国国家主席习近平商谈乌克兰问题。 与此同时，国务卿马尔科·卢比奥(Marco Rubio)星期一表示，目前尚未最终确定会谈细节，有关会谈可能在11月举行的亚太经合组织(APEC)峰会期间进行。 这场潜在会谈的背后，是三个大国不同的战略考量，以及乌克兰在持续战争
content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)星期一(10月19日)针对美中俄三方可能就乌克兰战争举行高层会谈表示，“只要我能做任何事来结束战争，我都会去做。”特朗普总统也在回答美国之音中文部记者提问时表示，他会与中国国家主席习近平商谈乌克兰问题。

与此同时，国务卿马尔科·卢比奥(Marco Rubio)星期一表示，目前尚未最终确定会谈细节，有关会谈可能在11月举行的亚太经合组织(APEC)峰会期间进行。

这场潜在会谈的背后，是三个大国不同的战略考量，以及乌克兰在持续战争压力下面临的艰难抉择。若会谈成行，能否推动俄乌战争走向结束？当乌克兰的未来成为大国谈判议题时，基辅又将面临怎样的处境？

**美国：推动停火，同时控制战争风险**

特朗普总统星期一在白宫玫瑰园签署了一项聚焦女性健康的行政命令，在签署仪式结束后面对记者询问时，他表示，愿意做任何事帮助结束乌克兰战争。

“我对俄罗斯和乌克兰的唯一希望就是他们停止这场愚蠢的战争。无论有人在场与否，只要我能做任何事情来结束战争，我都会去做。”特朗普说。

当美国之音中文部记者黄耀毅询问特朗普总统，是否会与中国领导人习近平谈乌克兰问题时，特朗普给予一个肯定的答案。

“我会的。不过，到目前为止，我认为他(习近平)在乌克兰问题上一直非常公平。他并没有过多介入，对俄罗斯方面也是如此。他们的介入程度远没有达到本来可以达到的程度，我对此表示赞赏。他们知道我对此表示赞赏。”

星期一稍早，国务卿马尔科·卢比奥(Marco Rubio)在访问乌兹别克斯坦期间说，美国将尽一切努力达成解决方案。“在过去近两年时间里，我们多次进行接触，试图促成或推动这场战争的结束；我认为，如果有可能，总统愿意采取任何他能做的事情来帮助结束这场战争。我们将继续寻找这样做的机会。”他说。

特朗普政府可能试图利用其对乌克兰的长期支持，以及与俄罗斯直接沟通的渠道，推动双方达成停火或政治协议。与中国展开沟通，也有助于美国探索更广泛的外交解决路径。

然而，如何平衡尽快结束战争与维护乌克兰安全，是美国面临的核心难题。

如果美国过于强调迅速达成协议，乌克兰可能被迫接受不利的领土安排，或者在缺乏可靠安全保障的情况下停火。近期美国取消部分对俄罗斯能源的制裁，也引发基辅对华盛顿是否会继续对莫斯科施压的担忧。

**俄罗斯：将战场成果转化为政治利益**

对俄罗斯而言，与美国直接讨论乌克兰问题，有助于莫斯科争取将战场上的既得利益转化为外交成果。

自2022年全面入侵乌克兰以来，俄罗斯一直试图巩固对乌克兰部分领土的控制，并要求西方重视其安全诉求。莫斯科希望未来的安排能够涉及领土问题、乌克兰的军事与外交方向，北约扩大，以及涉俄制裁。

与美国和中国领导人举行会谈，也能提升俄罗斯的国际地位，表明莫斯科仍是国际安全事务无法绕开的参与者。

但俄罗斯面临的难题是，如何在不作出重大让步的情况下结束战争。若停火无法满足其核心诉求，莫斯科可能缺乏妥协动力；而战争持续带来的军事和经济消耗，也使其必须权衡继续作战的成本。

**中国：主张政治解决，争取外交主动权**

中国一直主张通过对话谈判解决乌克兰危机，强调尊重各国主权和领土完整，同时重视各方合理安全关切。

中国与俄罗斯保持密切的政治和经济关系，也与欧洲及乌克兰维持外交联系。

对中国而言，参与三方会谈既可能为政治解决提供新的沟通平台，也有助于提升中国在欧洲安全事务和全球外交中的影响力。乌克兰战争持续影响能源、粮食、贸易及大国关系，北京也有动力推动局势降温。

不过，中国的角色面临争议。美国及部分西方国家批评中国与俄罗斯的经济和工业联系有助于俄罗斯维持战争能力，北京则否认支持俄罗斯的军事行动，并强调政治解决。

中国外交部发言人毛宁星期一被记者问到可能的三方会谈时回答说：“这个问题目前我没有可以提供的信息。”

**乌克兰：战争当事方，却面临话语权受限**

对乌克兰而言，最大的担忧是，三个大国讨论乌克兰的未来，却未必充分考虑乌克兰自身的诉求。

经过多年战争，乌克兰面临人员伤亡、基础设施受损和经济压力。随着冬季临近，能源设施及供电、供暖保障也成为现实挑战。与此同时，乌克兰的防御能力仍高度依赖美国等西方国家的军事、情报和经济支持。

基辅面临两难：接受以现有战线为基础的停火，可能意味着俄罗斯继续控制部分乌克兰领土；拒绝不利条件，则可能让战争继续消耗国家资源。

更重要的是，即使达成停火，乌克兰仍需要可靠的长期安全保障，以防俄罗斯未来再次发动进攻。

因此，乌克兰希望确保自己能够直接参与谈判，并坚持任何和平协议都必须考虑国家主权、领土完整和未来安全。欧洲国家的参与同样重要，因为欧洲既是乌克兰的重要支持者，也是战争长期影响的直接承担者。

title: Book Club: On Courage by Julia Angwin and Ami Fields-Meyer, Sun, Oct 25, 2026, 4:00 PM   | Meetup
summary: We are reading _On Courage: How to Be a Dissident in an Age of Fear_ by Julia Angwin and Ami Fields-Meyer for our October book club meeting. The meeting will be held at the We Are Family Community Center located on the second floor at 3265
content:
We are reading _On Courage: How to Be a Dissident in an Age of Fear_ by Julia Angwin and Ami Fields-Meyer for our October book club meeting.

The meeting will be held at the We Are Family Community Center located on the second floor at 3265 N. Carolina Ave in North Charleston. [Click here for directions](https://lowcountryhumanists.org/waf-directions/).

After the discussion, participants will have an opportunity to continue the conversation informally at Rebel Taqueria.
_Thanks to the generosity of our donors, SHL has funds available to ensure everyone feels welcome and able to participate. If you would like to participate in dining with us after book club but the cost presents a challenge, please email us at [shl@lowcountryhumanists.org,](http://shl@lowcountryhumanists.org,/) and we can discreetly arrange to cover your costs._

**About the Book:**
 The United States is only the latest country to face a leader who wields fear as a weapon, punishes political enemies, disappears people off the street, and undermines free and fair elections. Today nearly three out of four people on earth live under authoritarianism, the highest rate since the late 1970s.

But even under repressive conditions, each of us holds the power to help defeat autocrats. Based on their acclaimed The New Yorker essay “So You Want to Be a Dissident?,” veteran reporter Julia Angwin and political strategist Ami Fields-Meyer give us a captivating – and profoundly hopeful – guide to courage in an age of fear.

Meet a student from Hong Kong who risked everything for democracy. A mom in a working-class neighborhood of Caracas who broke with the political movement that raised her. Cairo twentysomethings who staged a gutsy stunt to help bring down a dictator. A mild-mannered immigrant fighting to save a landmark U.S. civil rights law. People throughout the United States and across five continents who faced serious risks for dissenting in their workplace, their community, or their country. _On Courage_ is the story of how they did it anyway – and how you can do it, too.

Blending rich, previously untold narratives with history, spirituality, and movement research, Angwin and Fields-Meyer deliver a highly accessible book full of practical lessons – an inspiring resource for anyone, anywhere, who feel the walls of history closing in on them. _On Courage_ is a roadmap to political courage and a powerful case for how taking personal risks can help save the free world.

title: Recovering from Religion Support Group Meeting - South Carolina Chapter, Wed, Oct 28, 2026, 6:30 PM   | Meetup
summary: The South Carolina Chapter Recovering from Religion support group will meet the fourth Wednesday or each month at 6pm Eastern. **This meeting will be held in-person at the We Are Family community room located at 3265 North Carolina Avenue,
content:
The South Carolina Chapter Recovering from Religion support group will meet the fourth Wednesday or each month at 6pm Eastern. **This meeting will be held in-person at the We Are Family community room located at 3265 North Carolina Avenue, Suite 202 in North Charleston.** Attendees are welcome to share, but may also decide to remain anonymous if they so choose.

Light refreshments will be provided. Please contact one of the event hosts if you have any questions or concerns ahead of the meeting.

The primary focus of a Recovering from Religion support group is to provide ongoing support to individuals as they let go of their religious beliefs. This transitional period is an ongoing process that can result in a range of emotions, as well as a ripple effect of consequences throughout an individual’s life. As such, the support meetings are safe and anonymous places to express these doubts, fears, and experiences without biased feedback or proselytizing.
 We are here to help each other through this journey.

There is no cost to attend this support group but, if you feel so inclined, donations can be made at [www.recoveringfromreligion.org/donate](http://www.recoveringfromreligion.org/donate)

If you'd like to provide confidential feedback for this meeting, click here [https://forms.gle/yhC7frShmyrRS56G7](https://forms.gle/yhC7frShmyrRS56G7)

If you find you need to talk with someone before the next support meeting, RfR has a hotline and online chat for that express purpose. Call [844-368-2848](http://tel:+18443682848/) to speak with someone. To chat online, go to [www.recoveringfromreligion.org](http://www.recoveringfromreligion.org/) and click on the green chat bubble in the lower left corner of the site.

If you are in need of professional help, we can recommend the Secular Therapy Project to provide options to connect with a professional therapist. All therapists have been thoroughly vetted by our organization and offer only evidence-based and non-religious treatment. Connect with them at [www.seculartherapy.org.](http://www.seculartherapy.org./)

Like what RfR does? Why not volunteer! There are quite a few options. Head over to [RfR Volunteer Form](https://www.recoveringfromreligion.org/volunteer) for more info.

content:
## Details

**Thursday, November 5, 7 pm (Doors open at 6:45 for socializing)**
**Sierra Club presents: Designing and Building for a Sustainable Future**
**April Magill, Principal Architect and Executive Director, Root Down Designs**
**College of Charleston Rita Hollings Science Center Auditorium, 58 Coming Street (corner of George)**
**Free and open to the public. Also on Zoom, please register here:**
[https://us02web.zoom.us/meeting/register/5tI7iy7tTe-6P0SPlsU_mA](https://us02web.zoom.us/meeting/register/5tI7iy7tTe-6P0SPlsU_mA)
 The latest research makes one thing clear: addressing climate change on a global scale requires us to rethink the built environment. Buildings contribute significantly to global warming—not only through how we heat and cool them, but through the materials we use to construct them.
 Healthy, breathable buildings made from bio-based, plant-derived materials offer a powerful path toward a carbon-negative future—one that supports the health of both our planet and the people who inhabit it.
 Come learn how April and the Root Down team are pioneering this movement across the Southeast and beyond through progressive architecture, hands-on building workshops, and educational classes that are transforming the way we think about—and build—the places we call home.
 April Magill is a leading voice and pioneer in climate-smart, healthy, and sustainable building. She is the founder and owner of Charleston-based Root Down Designs, as well as the founder and executive director of a nonprofit advancing healthy, affordable housing for disadvantaged communities. As an educator and adjunct professor at the American College of the Building Arts, April teaches sustainable building practices and materials and has led numerous community workshops. She is also a sought-after national speaker on bio-based, carbon-negative building materials.
 Sierra Club mission statement: To explore, enjoy, and protect the wild places of the earth

**6:00 - 7:00 pm (EST) AND 7:15 - 8:15 pm (EST), weekly on Monday in the HEALING room at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd, The Mezzanine Suite 228 in Mt. Pleasant. We have a NEW dedicated space for private WellBEing sessions in the HEALING room at bliss available M-SU 8AM-8PM. We have implemented an in-house scheduling calendar that Practitioners may reference to determine an available mutually beneficial time if the recommended time below is not convenient for you.**

**This is a private 1-hour session. Please RSVP directly to the Practitioner to book the session time and then go to [givetobliss.com](http://givetobliss.com/) to make a $33 donation via VENMO (no fees), PayPal or credit card. Thank you!**

**Reiki** is a Japanese energy healing technique developed in the early 1900’s by Mikao Usui to stimulate health and vitality through channeling life force energy. While promoting a deep state of relaxation, Reiki therapy may reduce stress, anxiety, and pain through gentle touch and transferring of energy. The practitioner delivers this energy through their hands to assist in improving the recipients biofield flow and balance on the physical, emotional, mental, and spiritual levels. By having a tranquil effect on the mind and body, Reiki promotes healing and restoration while having a favorable influence on the parasympathetic and autonomic nervous systems.

**Access Bars** was developed by Gary Douglas as a set of tools and processes applied to facilitate more consciousness. As a restorative modality, Access Bars involves the practitioner connecting with 32 points on participants head through gentle touch. This contact facilitates the release of negative energetic thought forms, ideas, beliefs, emotions, and considerations that create barriers. As energetic blockages are discharged, a rebalancing occurs making room for improved thought patterns. Results may include a more peaceful mind, relaxed body, improved outlook, stress relief, more energy, and feeling replenished. Measurements of electrical activity of the brain conducted after an Access Bars treatment were shown to have literally calmed brain activity down.

**Facilitator: Lisa Ann Helmly,MS,RDN,LDN, [lisa@lisahelmly.com**](http://lisa@lisahelmly.com**/)

*   Holy Fire III/Karuna Reiki Master
*   Certified Kundalini Reiki Practitioner
*   Certified Access Bars Practitioner
*   Passionate about inspiring people to optimize their health and wellbeing.
*   Small changes yield big results.

As a Low Country Native, Lisa is enthused to share complimentary integrated healing and restorative modalities to promote optimal health and well-being. Holding a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration equipped Lisa to gain experience in the corporate environment, flip residential housing properties, and continue managing her rental property business. Completing a Master of Science in Nutrition as a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist prepared Lisa for working in the medical sector assisting patients with a variety of illnesses, disease states, and conditions. During this time to the present, Lisa pursued further studies in alternative and integrative health practices attaining multiple credentials. While working in these areas, Lisa continued serving in her roles as a mother, daughter, sister, and friend.

**Sounds Productive Right? Does Being More Productive Support Health and Well-Being?**

“Getting busier does not necessarily make you better…affectively managing your stress does!”

You really didn’t think all of that activity was done perfectly with complete ease and grace, did you? Of course not. As Lisa was stressed out creating elevated levels of cortisol and adrenaline, this lack of balance was in opposition to a positive state of health and well-being. How ironic is that behavior? Lisa more fully understands how stress and being out of balance can have a negative impact on the mind and body. Sometimes the vehicle that drives a person to do, may eventually run them over. Hypothetically speaking, imagine being in a hit and run accident driven by yourself in your very own car. Can you relate now? The coping mechanism of burning the candle at both ends is comfortable because it is familiar. However, the candle may eventually burn out.
 If there is one commonality that we all have in this human experience, it’s managing our own life stressors. Add a dose or two of trauma along the way and what do you get…**Amplified Stress with Triggers.** The well-being sessions are offered here for interested participants to explore complementary and integrative approaches on processing and managing stress to ultimately feel and function better. You are invited to take this peaceful exploration on optimizing your own health and happiness.

summary: **6:00 – 7:00 pm (EST), on the 1st & 3rd Monday at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd in Mt. Pleasant, in the Mat Class Mezzanine.** Explore exotic, sacred Belly dance at bliss, embrace the beauty of your unique shape, have fun, and meet other
content:
**6:00 – 7:00 pm (EST), on the 1st & 3rd Monday at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd in Mt. Pleasant, in the Mat Class Mezzanine.**

Explore exotic, sacred Belly dance at bliss, embrace the beauty of your unique shape, have fun, and meet other adventurous Participants who aren’t afraid to let it roll. Wear comfy clothes. We have plenty of hip shawls to share.

The first five minutes is generally a stretch and warm up of the muscles. Then we explore the way that the different parts of the body express itself with movement… the head, chest, arms, midsection, stomach, hips and of course the legs. Then we will combine these movements with mini combinations and practice simple choreography that everyone can do using authentic music from Egypt, Turkey and other middle eastern countries.

Many styles of Middle Eastern dance will be highlighted including Egyptian, Turkish, Folkloric and Moroccan. We will also introduce many props used in Middle Eastern dance including: the veil, zil, sword, cane and silk fans. This class is facilitated by a seasoned dancer and performer who lives to share her art.

**Facilitator: Karen Inella, [shaktiselenebd@icloud.com**](http://shaktiselenebd@icloud.com**/)

Shakti Selene Shakti started belly dancing at the local YMCA in the South side of Chicago at the age of 16. Her teacher was Jasmine who was a muse of Eddie Kocheck. When she turned 18, she studied Egyptian Cabaret. Performances were made in the Chicago Art Institute where she attended college. She performed at private parties in Chicago Phoenix and Denver. She taught her skills wherever she danced. Her textile business led her to Turkey. Shakti fell in love with Istanbul. She eventually had a house and a dance studio close to the Blue Mosque. Her contacts led to many teaching opportunities, performances and development of a belly dance certification program from Istanbul Dreams. Through them she danced at corporate events, restaurants and taught different styles of belly dance.

Performances: Orient house Istanbul, Hilton Nile Cairo Egypt, Nile. Cruise ship On the Nile, Riads in Morocco, Singapore, taught a Tribal fusion seminar with Hafla, Samras Middle Eastern Dance event, Aegean Odessey Cruise Ship in the Greek islands, Eilot Israel evening local entertainment, Camel contracts, Cafe Paradiso, Taste of India

Dance companies: Ancient Echoes Belly Dance, Charleston Hula dancers, Allegro dance company, Charleston Black Sea dancers, Founding member of Palmetto Oasis

Teaching: Habibi Dance studio, Creative Spark, bliss Spiritual Co-op, Summerville YMCA

Productions: Moon over Morocco 13 years
 Styles of dance: Turkish Cabaret, Roman Havarsi Skirt, American Tribal, Fusion styles, Roman Havarsi, Bollywood, Khaligi, Saidi

Proficient in: Veil, Zil, Tambourine, Egyptian Wings, Silk and Feather Fans, Cane and Sticks.

Added interests: Celebrity chef specializing in Vegan Indian Food,
 Tarot card reader.

# Stop Canceling Plans — Why Hiding at Home Is Ruining Your Vibe

[![Image 7: Photo of the user Feel The Vibe ](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/member/3/a/e/4/thumb_325395076.jpeg?w=96) ![Image 8: Badge for Feel The Vibe ](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/next/images/avatar/super-organizer.webp?w=48) Hosted by Feel The Vibe . and jadahearl Feel The Vibe . is a Super Organizer](https://www.meetup.com/feel-the-vibe-meetup/events/317046502/attendees/)

[![Image 9: Photo of Feel The Vibe group](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/event/c/e/1/2/event_529732754.jpeg?w=3840) ### Feel The Vibe](https://www.meetup.com/feel-the-vibe-meetup/)

## Details

You know the feeling. Thirty minutes before you’re supposed to leave, you type out “so sorry, something came up” and hit send. And for a second, it’s incredible. The couch gets softer. Your shoulders drop. You did it. You’re safe.

That relief doesn’t last long. By tomorrow it’s quietly turned into something else. A slightly smaller world. One more Saturday spent exactly where you started. A calendar that’s getting emptier every time you choose the couch over the door.

Here’s the part nobody tells you: that relief isn’t proof you made the right call. It’s just your brain rewarding you for dodging something uncomfortable, with zero regard for how the isolation compounds later.

You don’t need to fix this by forcing yourself through every single plan from now on. You just need one rule that makes showing up feel possible again. Something like, go for twenty minutes, and if it’s still too much, you’re allowed to leave. Most of the time, the dread fades faster than expected, and the twenty minutes turns into the whole night without you even noticing.

This Online Meetup is for anyone who’s been canceling more than showing up lately. We’re talking about the relief trap, why the version of tonight in your head is almost always worse than the real thing, and how to rebuild a little trust with yourself, one small, low stakes plan at a time.

Come for twenty minutes. See what happens.

content: 巴黎的示威活动在过去一个月中升级。 (路透社：Abdul Saboor) 抗议活动席卷欧洲，数十万人在欧洲大陆的数十个城市走上街头。 最初的示威活动始于上个月在法国，此后，骚乱已蔓延至六个国家。 虽然存在一些共同的抱怨（特别是生活成本），但问题也会因地点不同而有显著差异。 巴黎和里尔部分地区已宣布宵禁，因为一些集会演变为暴力，导致数百人被捕，并造成商店和公共建筑的广泛破坏。 现在，分析师警告称，不满情绪可能在接下来的几周内在更多国家蔓延。 以下是您需要了解的内容。 人们为何抗议？ 示威活动可以追溯到 9 月 17 日，当时巴黎东南部一所高中的教师因人员短缺问题而抗议。 随后学生也加入进来，骚乱并未花多长时间就蔓延到全国其他学校。 最初关于教育的问题已经扩大，涵盖了普遍的生活成本问题和公共部门的削减。 法国的集会变得越来越暴力，周末数万人走上街头，遍布全国。 在某些地区，商店被洗劫，历史建筑被破坏甚至纵火。 抗议者在法国各地的城市与防暴警察发生冲突，并袭击政府大楼。 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在周日晚上的电视讲话中谴责了“无节制的暴力”，并将责任归咎于激进左翼破坏者，他们劫持了一场拥有合理担忧的运动。 在法国抗议活动开始的同时，马德里的人们也开始示威，因为一家投资公司强行将一位居住了 70 年的老人的租金提高了 230%，并将其赶出了家。 马里卡门·阿巴斯卡尔，87 岁，在被强制从公寓中移走后两周死于医院。 骚乱已经蔓延，现在多个国家的集会正在进行。以下是首次示威活动发生的时间和地点： 这张地图显示了抗议活动规模最大的地区。 我们是如何走到这一步的？ 法国拥有欧元区第二大经济体。但政府正面临高债务、巨额预算赤字和不断上升的借贷成本。 今年，它将花费比国防或教育更多的钱来偿还债务。 虽然学校和教学资源的状态在法国一直是焦点（特别是点燃了最初的集会），但大陆各地吸引人们走上街头的问题不止一个。 大多数问题都与生活成本上升有关。以下是概述： 示威活动的影响实际上取决于您身在何处。 在法国，巴黎的官员周一鼓励其地区 counterparts 实施宵禁。与此同时，西班牙正面临 11 月 29 日的突然选举，这是首相佩德罗·桑切斯在住房改革（旨在遏制公众抗议）被立法者拒绝后不久宣布的。 阿尔巴尼亚的问题与西欧略有不同。政府腐败是吸引人们要求改变首都地拉那局势的主要原因之一，那里有政客被指控使用狡猾的手段批准与特朗普家族相关的豪华沿海开发项目。 马德里抗议者在本月初发出他们的声音。 (路透社：Violeta Santos Moura) 接下来可能发生什么？ 在法国，政府已举行危机会议，巴黎和里尔部分地区宣布宵禁。这是在抗议者承诺在未来几天升级行动之后。 该国距离总统选举不到六个月，各政党互相指责煽动暴力。 例如，极右翼政治领袖玛丽娜·勒庞将责任完全归咎于政府，称法国处于“暴力与无助之间，甚至被挟持”。 事实上，欧洲正面临一些专家所称的“超级选举周期”，这可能加剧紧张局势，因为多个国家将在未来 12 个月内进行选举。 与此同时，阿尔巴尼亚总理埃迪·拉马承诺留任，尽管面临辞职呼吁，因此那些已经使警察陷入困境的抗议活动可能会再次爆发。 意大利、葡萄牙和比利时的政府都谴责了日益增长的暴力行为，并未提供任何让步。 过去几周，希腊、奥地利、爱尔兰和德国也记录了较小的示威活动。

title: Hong Kong hairy crab shops struggle as more shoppers head north
zh_title: 随着越来越多的购物者北上，香港大闸蟹店陷入困境
summary: 香港 由于跨境购物和网上竞争，香港传统大闸蟹店的生意面临 10% 至 20% 的下降，铜锣湾一家零售商报告订单下降和游客减少。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 19 日 18:16 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 Hong香港历史悠久的大闸蟹店正面临跨境采购和网上购物日益激烈的竞争，铜锣湾零售商之一
content:
香港
由于跨境购物和网上竞争，香港传统大闸蟹店的生意面临 10% 至 20% 的下降，铜锣湾一家零售商报告订单下降和游客减少。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 19 日 18:16 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港历史悠久的大闸蟹店正面临来自跨境购买和网上购物的日益激烈的竞争，铜锣湾的一家零售商报告今年的业务下降了 10% 至 20%。

《英文虎报》的姊妹刊物《星岛头条》走访了两家传统大闸蟹店，发现随着时令美食重返市场，销量参差不齐。一家店的老板表示，今年新顾客很少，主要靠老顾客，生意比去年同期下降了10%至20%。

她表示，体型较小、价格更实惠的螃蟹销量下降了 20% 至 30%，部分原因是经济压力、网上购物以及大陆购买大闸蟹的趋势日益增长。往年旺季，有顾客订购了1000多只螃蟹作为礼物。但她表示，今年的订单数量和规模均有所下降。
她还指出，过去在离开香港之前购买螃蟹的酒店客人和游客已基本消失。十一月通常是生意最繁忙的月份，她说她有些担心销售情况。

然而，对五至六两或以上的中型螃蟹的需求保持稳定，而对较大螃蟹的订单则略有增加。重阳节前夕，该店增加了9至10两螃蟹的订单，以满足顾客寻求更丰盛的时令大餐的需求。

与此同时，另一家已经经营了50至60年的商店的老板表示，货源充足，价格与往年相似，而且质量也有所提高。他表示，该店的业务基本保持稳定，部分原因是在线销售约占其收入的 30% 至 40%。他说，虽然团体聚会的大订单已不再常见，但购买螃蟹在家吃的顾客的小订单却有所增加。

尽管越来越多的香港人前往内地购买大闸蟹，但他警告说，质量并不总是有保证。他说，香港出售的大闸蟹质量普遍较好。他补充说，大多数顾客更喜欢在购买前亲自检查螃蟹，只有在对零售商产生信心后才转向网上购买。

Hong Kong
Traditional hairy crab shops in Hong Kong face a 10 to 20 per cent drop in business due to cross-border shopping and online competition, with one Causeway Bay retailer reporting declining orders and fewer tourists.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

19 Oct 2026 at 18:16 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's long-established hairy crab shops are facing growing competition from cross-border purchases and online shopping, with one Causeway Bay retailer reporting a 10 to 20 per cent drop in business this year.

A visit by Sing Tao Headline, a sister publication of The Standard, to two traditional hairy crab shops found mixed sales as the seasonal delicacy returned to the market. The owner of one shop said it had attracted few new customers this year and was relying mainly on regulars, with business down 10 to 20 per cent from the same period last year.

She said sales of smaller, more affordable crabs had fallen by 20 to 30 per cent, partly due to economic pressures, online shopping and the growing trend of buying hairy crabs on the mainland. In previous peak seasons, some customers had ordered more than 1,000 crabs as gifts. But both the quantity and size of orders had declined this year, she said.

She also noted that hotel guests and tourists who used to buy crabs before leaving Hong Kong had largely disappeared. November is usually the busiest month for the business, and she said she was somewhat concerned about sales.

However, demand for medium-sized crabs weighing five to six taels or more remained stable, while orders for larger crabs had edged up. Ahead of the Chung Yeung Festival, the shop increased orders for crabs weighing nine to 10 taels to meet demand from customers seeking a more substantial seasonal feast.

Meanwhile, the owner of another shop, which has been operating for 50 to 60 years, said supplies were plentiful and prices were similar to previous years, while quality had also improved. He said the shop's business had remained broadly stable, partly because online sales accounted for around 30 to 40 per cent of its revenue. While large orders for group gatherings had become less common, smaller orders from customers buying crabs to eat at home had increased, he said.

Although more Hongkongers were heading to the mainland to buy hairy crabs, he cautioned that quality was not always guaranteed. He said hairy crabs sold in Hong Kong were generally of better quality. He added that most customers preferred to inspect crabs in person before buying, switching to online purchases only after they had developed confidence in a retailer.

title: HKBU hosts first AI-TEM 2026 conference on responsible AI communication

content:
香港
香港浸会大学于 10 月 16 日至 18 日举行首届 AI-TEM 2026 会议，聚集了 200 多名国际学者，讨论人工智能的伦理挑战。该活动与波士顿大学、高丽大学和维也纳大学合作，重点关注扩大响应

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 19 日 22:12 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港浸会大学（HKBU）于10月16日至18日主办首届AI-TEM 2026：人工智能、科技与新兴媒体国际会议，云集了200多名国际学者、教师和研究生。该活动由波士顿大学、高丽大学和维也纳大学合作举办，主题是“扩展负责任的人工智能通信”。

演讲者和与会者讨论了人工智能带来的伦理挑战，包括隐藏的不平等、不平衡的采用和新形式的排斥。演讲和辩论的重点是传播研究如何帮助建立一个更具包容性和对社会有益的未来。香港浸会大学传理学院院长钟布在会议开幕式上表示：“人工智能的未来不仅仅是技术的问题，更是人类的问题。工程师可以告诉我们算法有多高效，但只有传播学者才能解释社会为何存在。
波士顿大学的 James E. Katz 强调了国际合作的重要性，并指出四所大学的目标是在快速变化的人工智能和媒体领域促进探究自由和独立思想。此次活动邀请了香港大学的 Michael Chau Chiu-lung、波士顿大学的 Yang Sung-Un、维也纳大学的 Jörg Matthes、智利天主教大学的 Ingrid Bachmann 和高丽大学的 Jennifer Ihm 等顶尖学者发表主题演讲，提供有关人工智能、传播和新兴媒体的全球视角。

一个亮点是互动会议，将来自当地几所中学的学生与国际学者联系起来。学生们就人工智能的伦理影响、其在日常生活中的作用以及对就业市场的未来影响进行了讨论，将年轻人的声音带入有关负责任人工智能的全球辩论中。会议还包括研究论文展示和三场专门小组会议。

会议结束时，香港浸会大学、波士顿大学、高丽大学和维也纳大学承诺继续合作并倡导以人为本、对社会负责的人工智能通信研究。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong Baptist University held the inaugural AI-TEM 2026 conference from October 16 to 18, gathering over 200 international scholars to discuss ethical challenges of AI. The event, in partnership with Boston University, Korea University, and the University of Vienna, focused on extending responsi

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

19 Oct 2026 at 22:12 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU) hosted the first AI-TEM 2026: AI, Technology & Emerging Media international conference from October 16 to 18, gathering more than 200 international scholars, faculty, and graduate students. The event, organized in partnership with Boston University, Korea University, and the University of Vienna, focused on the theme of 'Extending Responsible AI Communication'.

Speakers and participants discussed ethical challenges posed by AI, including hidden inequalities, uneven adoption, and new forms of exclusion. Presentations and debates centered on how communication research can help build a more inclusive and socially beneficial future. Zhong Bu, Dean of HKBU's School of Communication, opened the conference by stating: 'The future of AI isn't just about technology, it is a human question. Engineers can tell us how efficient an algorithm can be, but only communication scholars can explain why society exists as it does.'

James E. Katz of Boston University highlighted the importance of international collaboration, noting that the four universities aim to promote freedom of inquiry and independent thought in the rapidly changing field of AI and media. The event featured keynote presentations from leading academics including Michael Chau Chiu-lung from the University of Hong Kong, Yang Sung-Un from Boston University, Jörg Matthes from the University of Vienna, Ingrid Bachmann from the Pontifical Catholic University of Chile, and Jennifer Ihm from Korea University, offering global perspectives on AI, communication, and emerging media.

A highlight was an interactive session connecting students from several local secondary schools with international scholars. Students engaged in discussions on AI's ethical implications, its role in daily life, and future implications for the job market, bringing youth voices into the global debate on responsible AI. The conference also included research paper presentations and three specialized panel sessions.

The conference concluded with HKBU, Boston University, Korea University and the University of Vienna pledging to continue their collaboration and champion research into human-centered, socially responsible AI communication.

# Hong Kong digital office to boost overnight staffing for 1823 hotline after monkey report complaint

Hong Kong's Digital Policy Office will study increasing resources and overnight staff for the 1823 hotline after a caller reporting a dying monkey was not answered. The office says the call was diverted to voicemail because all operators were busy.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 19 Oct 2026 at 22:52 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20digital%20office%20to%20boost%20overnight%20staffing%20for%201823%20hotline%20after%20monkey%20report%20complaint%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-digital-office-to-boost-overnight-staffing-for-182-47bbfa "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-digital-office-to-boost-overnight-staffing-for-182-47bbfa&text=Hong%20Kong%20digital%20office%20to%20boost%20overnight%20staffing%20for%201823%20hotline%20after%20monkey%20report%20complaint "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-digital-office-to-boost-overnight-staffing-for-182-47bbfa "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-digital-office-to-boost-overnight-staffing-for-182-47bbfa&text=Hong%20Kong%20digital%20office%20to%20boost%20overnight%20staffing%20for%201823%20hotline%20after%20monkey%20report%20complaint "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20digital%20office%20to%20boost%20overnight%20staffing%20for%201823%20hotline%20after%20monkey%20report%20complaint&body=Hong%20Kong%20digital%20office%20to%20boost%20overnight%20staffing%20for%201823%20hotline%20after%20monkey%20report%20complaint%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-digital-office-to-boost-overnight-staffing-for-182-47bbfa "Email")

Hong Kong's Digital Policy Office has said it will study increasing resources and adding overnight staff to improve the 1823 government hotline after a caller reporting a dying monkey was not answered. The office responded after media reports said a citizen tried to report a dying monkey in Sham Shui Po but could not get through to a 1823 operator.

In a social media post, the Digital Policy Office said that according to 1823 system records, a citizen called the hotline at 1:56 am on 19 October to report a dying monkey on a hillside opposite the China Petroleum station at 338 Tai Po Road in Sham Shui Po. A 1823 customer service officer recorded the case and immediately referred it to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department. Because it was an urgent case, the officer also telephoned the department's duty officer to handle it.

The Digital Policy Office also said another citizen called the hotline around 1 am on the same day. At that time, all duty operators were handling other calls, so the incoming call was diverted to voicemail. The caller did not leave a message, so operators could not follow up on that case.

The office said the incident showed there was room for improvement in 1823 services. It said it would review the situation and study further increasing resources, including adding more overnight staff to improve the hotline.
