content: 茉莉花评论 文 / 孔灵犀 西班牙人上街要求降租金、停止驱逐。限租能压低房租，可它多不出一套房，而西班牙缺的正是房子。纽约强制搬人要经法院，文中所引的中国两条规则讲提前通知：护着租客，和找得到房，是两回事。 10月3日，西班牙马德里、瓦伦西亚等城市举行了约50场住房游行，西班牙政府说，光是马德里就有约7万人上街。前一天，议会以178票对172票、184票对166票，否决了政府为平息抗议提出的两项法令，里面有把2028年前到期的租约延长两年。抗议者要求降租金、停止驱逐。可是，限租、延长租约这些办法，到底帮得了谁？ 我的看法是：限租能压低租金，短期内对已经住进去的人尤其有用，一些地方的新租约也设了上限；可限租多不出一套房，还在找房的年轻人租不租得到房，还要看新房建得够不够。纽约和中国正好可以对照：纽约有争议、没和解的驱逐案要由法官裁决，房东胜诉后签发驱逐令，中国下文的两条规则写的是提前通知；可在纽约，法律护着租客，租房照样难。 西班牙央行在2025年年报里算过：2021年到2025年，西班牙新建成的住房比新增的家庭少了约75万套。光是2025年，新增家庭就有24万户，新建成的住房只有9.2万套，缺口还在扩大。房子不够，租金就往上走：房产网站Idealista的统计显示，今年9月底，在西班牙租房每平方米要15.1欧元，比一年前贵5.6%。 央行把限租的好处和代价都说了：限租在短期内特别能减轻已签租约的租户的负担；可要是长期实行，房东的实际收入下降，投资出租房的劲头跟着下降，新出租的房子会比不限租时少。 纽约：强制搬人要经法院，空房却极少 纽约的法律尊重租客的权利：按规矩，把租客赶出门的只能是执行官或者警长，别人动手赶人，就是非法驱逐。纽约州的“正当理由驱逐”法（Good Cause Eviction）2024年4月20日生效，受这部法律保护的房子，房东没有正当理由不能结束租约，这部法律靠法院执行。美国宪法第十四修正案写着，各州不经正当法律程序，不得剥夺任何人的生命、自由或财产。在我看来，纽约这套先审后搬的程序，就是这条原则落在租房上的样子：租客的话要听，房东的诉求也要先由法官裁决。 一个驱逐案是这样走的：房东先向法院递交诉状，写明起诉的理由；案子先分到调解庭，法官要房东和租客谈着解决。租客的答辩，是向法院陈述抗辩理由和反诉；开庭日期可能改期；双方还可以提动议，请求法院采取某项行动。进入开庭审理的，双方当庭举证，由法官作出决定；房东胜诉的，法院判决房东有权让租客搬走，法官再签发驱逐令。房东雇执行官执行驱逐令的，执行官由市长任命；动手之前，接到驱逐令的官员还要至少提前14天书面通知租客。美国广播公司纽约台（ABC7）2024年11月的调查发现，纽约市的驱逐案平均要两年；房东们说，驱逐令至少要六个月才能执行。前者算整个案子，后者只是最后一步。案子拖成几年，部分原因是疫情以来法院积案多、资源有限，不全是程序要花的时间。ABC7报道的一位布朗克斯区房东，当了几十年护士，在法院打赢了官司，又等了一年多才等到法官签发驱逐令，到报道时还在等执行官去执行。这套程序两边都护着：租客不会被人直接赶出门，房东的权利也要经法官裁定、由官员落实；代价是慢，房东要等。 可在纽约找房一样难。纽约市住房保护与发展局2024年3月6日在市议会作证时说，2023年全市出租房的净空置率只有1.41%，供给跟不上需求。 中国：这两条规则靠提前通知保护租客 《民法典》第七百三十条规定，租期没有约定或者约定不明确，依据第五百一十条的规定仍不能确定的，视为不定期租赁，双方都可以随时解除合同，只要在合理期限之前通知对方。也就是说，依法算作不定期租赁的，房东在合理期限之前通知租客，就能解除合同，这一条没有要求房东说明理由，也没有要求房东先到法院起诉。2025年9月15日起施行的《住房租赁条例》加了一层保护：房东依法解除合同，要通知租客，给租客留出搬走的合理时间，不得用暴力、威胁或者其他非法方式逼租客解约、搬走。这两条保护租客的办法是提前通知和留出搬家时间，条文里没有先走法庭程序这一环，纽约那样要经法院裁决的程序，在这两条规则里找不到对应的东西。 三地比起来，西班牙和纽约相同的是缺房：西班牙新建成的住房赶不上新增的家庭，纽约空房极少。不同的是法律怎么护着租客：纽约靠法院走完程序，中国的这两条规则靠提前通知，西班牙连延长租约的法令都没通过。落到租房的人身上：在纽约，住进去的租客住得稳，想新租一套房的人却很难找到；在中国，依法算作不定期租赁的租客，房东在合理期限之前通知就能解除合同。 支持限租的人也有证据。西班牙央行说，加泰罗尼亚等地被定为住房紧张区的城镇，新租约的租金设了上限；央行引用的一项2023年的研究发现，加泰罗尼亚2020年到2021年的限租让租金下降了4%到6%，短期内没有减少出租房。我同意，限租能把租金压下来；可压低租金和多出房子是两回事，2025年西班牙新建成的住房，仍然赶不上新增的家庭。还在找房的年轻人要的，不只是一份便宜些的租约，而是先签得到一份租约。 所以我的答案是：限租帮得上已经住进去的人，可它补不上缺的房子；还在找房的年轻人租不租得到房，很大程度上要看新房建得够不够。对美国来说，要紧的是守住这套两边都护着的程序，同时多盖房，让空房多起来。 纽约的驱逐案，2024年的调查显示平均要两年；2023年全市出租房的净空置率，只有1.41%。法院的程序保得住已经住进去的人，保不住还在找房的人。 # 香港边境高峰时段出发航班激增 9 倍

# Hong Kong border sees 9-fold surge in departures during peak hour

Hong Kong's Lo Wu border crossing saw a peak of 9,728 departures in one hour on 18 October, up nearly nine times from previous periods. The government activated contingency plans to manage the sudden surge.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 18 Oct 2026 at 17:12 HKT · 1 min read

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20border%20sees%209-fold%20surge%20in%20departures%20during%20peak%20hour%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-border-sees-9-fold-surge-in-departures-during-peak-cd3bd0 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-border-sees-9-fold-surge-in-departures-during-peak-cd3bd0&text=Hong%20Kong%20border%20sees%209-fold%20surge%20in%20departures%20during%20peak%20hour "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-border-sees-9-fold-surge-in-departures-during-peak-cd3bd0 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-border-sees-9-fold-surge-in-departures-during-peak-cd3bd0&text=Hong%20Kong%20border%20sees%209-fold%20surge%20in%20departures%20during%20peak%20hour "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20border%20sees%209-fold%20surge%20in%20departures%20during%20peak%20hour&body=Hong%20Kong%20border%20sees%209-fold%20surge%20in%20departures%20during%20peak%20hour%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-border-sees-9-fold-surge-in-departures-during-peak-cd3bd0 "Email")

Hong Kong’s Security Bureau reported a significant surge in northbound travellers at the Lo Wu (Huanggang) border crossing on Saturday 18 October. From around 11 am, the number of people leaving Hong Kong via the crossing rose sharply. Between noon and 2 pm, about 19,000 travellers departed for the mainland, an increase of more than eight times compared with the same period in the past.

The busiest hour was between 1 pm and 2 pm, when 9,728 people crossed the border, up nearly nine times from previous periods. The bureau said that during the peak, the queuing time for passengers on Level 2 was 30 to 45 minutes, while on Level 5 – the departure hall – wait times stayed under 30 minutes.

By around 2 pm, the peak began to ease. The crowd-control measures on Level 2 were lifted at 2:10 pm, and by 2:40 pm the waiting time at the Level 5 departure hall had dropped to less than 15 minutes.

The Immigration Department immediately opened all clearance channels and counters on Level 5 to speed up the flow of people. It also worked with the Police Force to implement crowd-diversion and control measures.

According to the Security Bureau, large-scale drills had been conducted earlier. When the sudden increase in travellers occurred, contingency plans were activated promptly and overall operations ran smoothly. The bureau said it will continue to work with the Immigration Department, the Police Force and other relevant agencies to monitor the situation at border crossings and adjust measures as needed to ensure smooth clearance and public services.

The Immigration Department has also published real-time waiting-time information via the “Port of Entry” platform. It advised travellers to plan their journeys in advance and consider using other border crossings.

title: Calls mount to expel Chinese ambassador
summary: **(UPDATE)**CALLS to expel Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan mounted over the weekend as anger grew over Chinese Embassy remarks daring lawmakers to declare the envoy persona non grata. Former Surigao del Norte representative and governor Robert
content:
**(UPDATE)**CALLS to expel Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan mounted over the weekend as anger grew over Chinese Embassy remarks daring lawmakers to declare the envoy persona non grata.

Former Surigao del Norte representative and governor Robert Ace Barbers on Saturday called on Jing to leave the Philippines immediately and criticized the Chinese Embassy remarks.

“He should go back to China immediately,” Barbers told The Manila Times.

*   [Chinese embassy to lawmakers on threat vs ambassador: Do it](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/18/news/chinese-embassy-to-lawmakers-on-threat-vs-ambassador-do-it/2448124)

Barbers also mocked Jing’s declaration that China “loves peace,” citing years of confrontations in the West Philippine Sea, including water cannon attacks on Filipino vessels, the use of machetes against Filipino soldiers, and the ramming of Philippine ships.

Barbers said he was “totally charmed and disarmed” by the ambassador’s “sweet remarks,” questioning whether Filipinos should feel reassured by China’s claims of peaceful intentions despite its actions at sea.

He accused the envoy of abusing Philippine hospitality and challenging the country’s sovereignty, warning Filipinos against accepting what he described as China’s provocative posture.

Barbers also took aim at lawmakers he accused of remaining silent over Jing’s remarks, referring to them as “DDS” (die-hard Duterte supporters) and “Tsina-tors.”

“I am also not surprised that the DDS and the Tsina-tors are firmly exercising their constitutionally guaranteed right to remain silent in the face of this most blatant and in-your-face challenge of sovereignty,” he said.

*   ![Image 1: Even Marcos wouldn’t want Chinese envoy expelled](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/18/1265078.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Even Marcos wouldn’t want Chinese envoy expelled](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/19/opinion/columns/even-marcos-wouldnt-want-chinese-envoy-expelled/2448203)

The controversy began after remarks by Jing were reported, where he asserted that China could “easily win" against the Philippines if it chose to “use force” in the West Philippine Sea but would not do so because “we love peace.”

President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., Coast Guard officials, and lawmakers viewed the comment as a direct, undiplomatic threat against the country.

Sen. Risa Hontiveros said merely summoning the ambassador was insufficient and demanded a formal apology, raising the possibility of declaring him persona non grata.

In response to lawmakers considering his expulsion, the Chinese Embassy in Manila posted a sharp rebuttal on social media:

*   ![Image 2: OFW arrested at NAIA for estafa](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/18/1265067.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[OFW arrested at NAIA for estafa](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/19/news/ofw-arrested-at-naia-for-estafa/2448191)

“Some senators and House representatives are talking about declaring the Chinese ambassador persona non grata. Is this threat or coercion? But anyway, just do it. Otherwise, STOP BLUFFING.

The public-dare-stoked lawmakers' anger. Akbayan Rep. Perci Cendaña condemned the taunt as disrespectful and arrogant behavior from a foreign envoy, citing it as the breaking point to formally demand his immediate deportation.

“An arrogant, obnoxious visitor. How long are we going to tolerate this? This Chinese ambassador should be sent home,” Cendaña said in a social media post.

Sen. Francis Pangilinan said: “By way of diplomatic language, you can please easily leave Manila and go back to China.”

*   ![Image 3: SC asked to stop courts from blocking wage orders](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/18/1265081.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[SC asked to stop courts from blocking wage orders](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/19/news/sc-asked-to-stop-courts-from-blocking-wage-orders/2448206)

Hontiveros said the Chinese envoy’s statement was meant to intimidate.

“An ambassador who threatens his host country has crossed a line,” she said.

Following Marcos’ announcement that he intends to meet with Quan, the Chinese Embassy said Quan welcomes the opportunity to speak with the president.

“Ambassador Jing looks forward to exchanging views on certain important and sensitive issues with the president. Especially how to prevent some individuals from pushing bilateral relations into a dangerous situation,” the embassy said.

The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) previously warned that declaring a diplomat persona non grata is an "option of last resort" that carries heavy diplomatic and reciprocal consequences.

“It also carries tremendous implications moving forward, such as reciprocal action or other countermeasures in other areas,” the DFA said.

**MANILA, Philippines —**The Chinese Embassy in Manila on Sunday dared lawmakers to act on their threat to declare China's Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan persona non grata, saying it has grown tired of such repeated warnings.

"Some anti-China politicians talked about declaring the Chinese ambassador persona non grata. Over the past 30 years, anti-China forces have been repeatedly doing the same thing to threaten our embassy. We are fed up with these old and low tricks," the embassy said in a statement on Facebook.

"If they really want to do something, do it quickly and immediately please," it added.

The embassy said that it would not welcome lawmakers calling for the ouster of the ambassador to China.

"While diplomacy is based on reciprocity, we will not welcome them to China. Simple and fair enough," it said.

title: 消费电子产品：中国为何正在超越西方

content:
据德国之声报道，中国企业正在走向领先地位。GoPro 曾经是运动相机的代名词。2015 年，该公司售出了约 660 万台相机，市场份额超过 70%。然而，如今这家昔日的行业先驱却在为生存而苦苦挣扎。原因在于来自中国的竞争。GoPro 最大的竞争对手是大疆（DJI）和影石创新（Insta360），它们分别于 2019 年和 2021 年进入运动相机市场。如今，全球智能手持相机的销售额中，超过 90% 来自这两家企业。

经常使用运动相机记录摩托车骑行过程的亚历山大·汉内曼（Alexander Hannemann）表示，大约两年前，他从 GoPro 转用了 Insta360。他说：“画质比 GoPro 好得多。即使我加速行驶，以每小时 80 公里的速度过弯，画面依然很好。”

GoPro 并非个例。自 2010 年前后以来，许多中国品牌已经在众多科技领域超越了西方行业领军企业，智能电视和扫地机器人就是其中的例子。

“中国产品仍然价格实惠，”加拿大企业家克里斯·佩雷拉（Chris Pereira）表示。他也是一位作家，在中国积累了超过 20 年的经验。“但与此同时，这些产品的质量也相当高。”佩雷拉补充说，这种价格与质量兼具的优势，使全球消费者购买的科技产品中，超过一半来自中国。

去年，全球售出的电动汽车中，近三分之二来自比亚迪（BYD）、小鹏汽车（Xpeng）及其他中国汽车制造商。这些企业已经将特斯拉等老牌厂商甩在身后。在扫地机器人领域，中国品牌也占据了全球市场的主导地位。美国昔日的行业先驱 iRobot，如今正面临激烈的竞争，难以与之抗衡。

佩雷拉通过自己的咨询公司 iMpact，帮助中国企业拓展海外市场。他认为，中国企业的成功主要归功于以下几个因素：深圳、杭州和上海等城市的国内市场竞争异常激烈；供应链高度整合；企业文化强调“凡事皆有可能”，能够迅速创新并作出反应。

中国的其他竞争优势还包括前所未有的工业自动化水平、人工智能（AI）在制造业中的战略性应用、监管机构较高的响应速度，以及相对低廉的劳动力成本。这些因素共同降低了生产成本，并使中国企业能够以比世界上最发达经济体更快的速度推出创新产品。

乔伊·程在 20 多年前移居美国攻读博士学位，因此同时熟悉美国消费者市场和中国制造业。他的创业公司总部设在美国，但几乎所有产品都在深圳生产。深圳是全球大量消费电子硬件产品的制造中心。

他说：“对于降低成本和加快产品开发而言，深圳的供应链几乎不可或缺。尤其是对初创企业来说，你必须迅速把产品推向消费者，否则就会被市场淘汰。”

尽管消费者越来越多地选择中国企业的产品，但对中国品牌的疑虑依然存在。一项近期公布的调查显示，超过 90% 的欧洲消费者表示，在数据安全问题上，他们不信任中国企业。与此同时，约 80% 的受访者也不信任美国企业。德国消费者的不信任程度尤其高。

德国旅游博主娜丁（Nadine）也使用大疆和影石创新的产品，但她表示，自己不会在家中使用亚洲品牌的产品。她说：“我的扫地机器人来自一家德国公司，原因就在于数据可以按照德国的相关法规进行处理。毕竟，制造商可以直接访问设备的摄像头。”她所指的是一些扫地机器人的摄像头和音频数据遭到黑客入侵的事件。

佩雷拉认为，希望进入海外市场的中国企业必须付出额外的努力来赢得消费者信任。他说：“由于缺乏信任，它们必须在产品和价格方面具备特别强的竞争力，才能让消费者选择自己。”他认为，中国企业可以通过在海外建立实体业务来缩小信任差距。例如，比亚迪计划在匈牙利开设其首家欧洲乘用车工厂，预计将在今年投入运营。

中国企业强调，它们遵守欧盟的数据保护规定。然而，美国和中国的国家安全法律在某些情况下可能要求企业向政府部门提供数据。

德国有关部门表示，对于欧洲服务器上的数据是否会被传输到国外，目前能够实施的监管仍然有限。除了数据安全问题，中国消费电子企业还因涉嫌间谍活动及其他安全风险而受到批评。近期，相关争议尤其集中在电动汽车等联网产品上。

出于安全担忧、贸易逆差以及中国企业影响力不断扩大的考虑，美国和其他一些西方国家已经对中国进口商品及企业实施关税和严格限制，并将部分企业列入黑名单。7 月底，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）政府禁止进口非美国生产的人形机器人。

中国机器人制造商 Primebot 的一名代表向德国之声（DW）表示，所有中国电子设备制造商都可能受到相关政策的影响。他说：“我们可能会尝试与一家美国本土企业合作。另一种解决办法是在美国建厂。”与此同时，欧洲各国及欧盟也正在考虑对中国企业进一步加征关税。

佩雷拉预计，关税将加速中国企业的两大发展趋势：将生产制造环节转移到海外；更加注重高端产品，与西方领先品牌展开直接竞争。

他强调：“中国政府和企业都明白，制造业必须在一定程度上转移到目标市场所在国。一方面，这是为了降低出口面临的障碍；另一方面，也是为了在当地建立信任。”他进一步解释说：“一旦关税抵消了低端市场的价格优势，企业就只能依靠高端市场的利润空间。因此，中国品牌将越来越多地与西方老牌企业直接竞争，而对于这些西方品牌来说，消费者信任是一个核心因素。”

随着中国的经济影响力不断增强，西方企业正努力维持自身的竞争优势。卡兹·默钱特（Kaz Merchant）在一家位于英国、从事 IT 硬件进出口业务的公司工作。他认为，尤其是规模较小的企业，必须找到适合自己的地理市场或细分市场。他说：“它们需要找到一个独特的产品优势，针对某个特定地区，而中国企业在这个地区可能还不具备相应的优势。或者，它们必须与中国企业建立合作伙伴关系。”

佩雷拉认为，欧洲需要解决的一个重要问题，是提高监管机构的响应速度。他说：“中国的监管机构会迅速、明确地告诉企业哪些事情可以做。正是这种高效率，让企业能够不断发展，并在海外市场取得成功。”他进一步指出：“如果企业必须等待数周才能得到答复，就会失去客户。”

# Typhoon Champi sea warning possible Wednesday night: CWA

10/18/2026 08:42 PM

Graphic: CWA

Taipei, Oct. 18 (CNA) A sea warning for Typhoon Champi could be issued as early as Wednesday night, possibly followed by a land warning on Thursday, as the storm approaches Taiwan, the Central Weather Administration (CWA) said Sunday.

CWA forecaster Liu Pei-teng (劉沛滕) said the typhoon is expected to have its greatest impact on Taiwan on Friday and Saturday, bringing heavy rain to central and northern Taiwan and to Yilan and Hualien counties in the east.

As of 2 p.m. Sunday, Champi was about 2,470 kilometers east-southeast of Eluanbi, Taiwan's southernmost tip, moving west-northwest at 20 kilometers per hour (kph).

It had maximum sustained winds of 191 kph and a storm radius of 200 km, according to CWA data.

Liu said current forecasts suggest Champi will maintain its strength as it heads toward waters northeast of Taiwan. A sea warning could be issued as early as Wednesday night or Thursday morning, followed by a land warning as early as Thursday night or Friday, he said.

Some forecast models suggest Champi could make landfall in eastern Taiwan, Liu said, but its track remains uncertain because the strength of the Pacific high-pressure system could affect its path.

If the high-pressure system weakens sooner than expected, Champi could turn north before approaching Taiwan. If the system strengthens, the typhoon could take a more southerly track or pass through the Bashi Channel, between Taiwan and the Philippines, he said.

International forecast models continue to show divergent tracks, and Tuesday will be key in determining whether Champi turns north, Liu added.

Ahead of the typhoon, the weather will remain relatively stable on Monday and Tuesday, with mostly cloudy to sunny skies across Taiwan, according to the CWA.

Brief, isolated showers are possible along the Keelung coast, in northeastern and southeastern Taiwan, and on the Hengchun Peninsula, the CWA said.

(By Chang Hsiung-feng and Lee Hsin-Yin)

## Details

**[Wake Up Together](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/community)**[](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/community)is an online meditation community that was established in 2020 by Trina Truong and partners. Our mission is to help support individuals in maintaining a solid meditation practice through practicing in an accessible and open-minded community. We meet every day, virtually. While we are rooted in the Vipassana-Insight tradition, our approach is also inclusive to all Buddhist meditation practices such as anapanasati (mindfulness of the breath), Metta (loving-kindness), body scans, Zen, ton glen, and others.

The space that our meditators come to know is one that expresses itself as welcoming and embodying all views and interpretations of spirituality.

We hold the commitment to remain humble and vulnerable in our role as the door openers to the individual's inner journey. We aspire to shape the experience for participants to experience serenity, clear-seeing and profound understanding of the mind, and the [no] self through the practices, the guidance, the teachings, and the reflections offered in group sharing.

To solidify this spiritual aspiration is to make a commitment to sit in community with a predetermined frequency or as often as you can.
 We welcome you to join our beloved community!
**[Register to Join](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdJF26i6aTbMKLzw53MiwlehbsGaJG5qmVBPQEWwQ6WCOirKg/viewform)**

These guided meditations are offered daily and given freely. There
 are no up-front fees. Wake Up Together is 100% donation based,
 relying on your support and generosity.

_China is ramping up its presence around Taiwan, in a pattern that Taipei said is designed to ‘alter the status quo’._

[![Image 2](https://www.aljazeera.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/2017-06-08T131939Z_1189275883_RC11B0FE7F20_RTRMADP_3_GULF-QATAR-JAZEERA-1714943623.jpg?resize=96%2C96&quality=80)](https://www.aljazeera.com/author/al_jazeera_staff_150119130629458)

By [Al Jazeera Staff](https://www.aljazeera.com/author/al_jazeera_staff_150119130629458) and AFP

Published On 18 Oct 2026 18 Oct 2026

Taiwan has confronted and driven away 16 Chinese coastguard, research and fishing vessels that it said were involved in simultaneous “maritime harassment” operations.

An “unusually large” number of Chinese vessels took part in coordinated operations around Taiwan’s main island and Pratas (also known as Dongsha), a disputed island to the southwest, the Taiwanese coastguard said in a statement on Sunday.

## Recommended Stories

list of 3 items
*   list 1 of 3[Taiwan Coast Guard confronts Chinese fishing boats in Dongsha waters](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/10/2/aje-onl-nf_taiwan-coast-guard-fires-water-cannon-on-chinese-021026)
*   list 2 of 3[Taiwan president says defence spending boost aims to ‘deter war’](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/10/taiwan-president-says-defence-spending-boost-aims-to-deter-war)
*   list 3 of 3[China sanctions Paraguay, Belize ministers over Taiwan ties](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/12/china-sanctions-paraguay-belize-ministers-over-taiwan-ties)

end of list
The Chinese vessels included four fishing boats, which engaged in “simultaneous operations’ that the coastguard described as “hybrid warfare”.

Taiwan’s coastguard said its vessels took “forceful action immediately to effectively neutralise the threats” and accused Beijing of “attempting to unilaterally alter the status quo” in the Taiwan Strait and give the “false impression of jurisdiction”.

Some of the vessels reportedly entered Taiwan’s restricted waters.

## Intensified maritime pressure

Beijing claims Taiwan and Pratas as part of its territory and asserts jurisdiction over the surrounding waters, which Taipei rejects. China has long threatened to use force to regain control of Taiwan.

In an incident on October 1 , Taiwan’s coastguard fired water cannon at a Chinese recreational fishing vessel near Pratas island between Taiwan and mainland China that Beijing claims.

China has intensified its maritime pressure on Taiwan in recent months. Beijing deployed a record 244 coastguard, scientific research and other ships around Taiwan’s main island in July, Taiwanese official data show, compared with just 58 in the same month last year.

 Advertisement

In the first 21 days of August, 152 vessels were detected; most were from the Chinese Coastguard, but fishing boats and research vessels were also involved.

China also deploys warships around Taiwan on a near-daily basis, but those are counted separately.

summary: 香港 在居民和环保人士强烈反对后，香港旅游发展局承诺检讨在太平山顶安装装饰灯饰的计划。在发布更新计划之前，董事会将进行更广泛的磋商并评估所有建议。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 18 日 21:03 HKT · 2 分钟阅读《香港报》旅游发展局（旅发局）承诺进行更广泛的公众咨询并审查其计划
content:
香港
在遭到居民和环保人士强烈反对后，香港旅游发展局承诺检讨在太平山顶安装装饰灯饰的计划。在发布更新计划之前，董事会将进行更广泛的磋商并评估所有建议。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 18 日 21:03 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

鉴于当地居民和环保人士日益关注，香港旅游发展局（旅发局）承诺进行更广泛的公众咨询，并审查在太平山顶安装装饰照明的计划。

旅游局在一份官方声明中表示，在采取行动之前，他们仍然致力于平衡可持续旅游业、保护自然环境和满足附近居民的需求。

该倡议旨在沿着热门的卢吉路和哈勒克路步行道的选定部分安装小型低眩光照明装置。景观增强计划与即将到来的香港冬季节的新灯光和声音表演一起推出，作为传统“幻彩咏香江”壮观的现代替代品，以提高城市的夜间经济吸引力。
在开发过程中，董事会征求了多个利益相关者和监管部门的反馈。四月，代表们向中西区民政事务专员和当区区议员介绍创意概念。该委员会于5月5日、9月2日和9月24日向附近住户直接发出书面通知，让社区了解施工时间表和临时交通安排。它还于5月19日和8月5日召开了两次跨部门会议，以协调安全、物流和基础设施法规。

项目参数共咨询了十个公共机构，包括渔农自然护理署、消防处、民政事务总署、香港警务处、路政署、地政总署、康乐及文化事务署、运输署、土木工程拓展署及水务署。
根据最初的提案，低眩光灯设计为每天晚上 7 点至 10 点按受控时间表运行，所有装置均远离住宅区，以保护当地隐私。该试验项目最初计划运行 12 个月的试点阶段。为了最大限度地减少生态足迹，该委员会聘请了注册树艺师和相关部门来监督环境安全。安装的每个方面——包括选择合适的树木、悬挂方法、保护性缓冲、承重限制和物理附着技术——都需要专业树艺师的正式签字，他们还负责对树木的健康状况进行例行的后续检查。

认识到公众和居民反馈的强烈程度，旅游局确认将仔细评估所有建议，审查总体运营安排，并在稍后发布更新计划。

The Hong Kong Tourism Board has pledged to review its plan to install decorative lighting on the Peak after strong opposition from residents and environmentalists. The board will hold wider consultations and assess all suggestions before publishing updated plans.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

18 Oct 2026 at 21:03 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB) has pledged to carry out wider public consultations and review its plans to install decorative lighting on the Peak, following mounting concerns from local residents and environmental advocates.

In an official statement, the tourism authority said it remained committed to balancing sustainable tourism, protecting the natural environment and addressing the needs of neighbourhood residents before moving forward.

The initiative sought to place small, low-glare light installations along selected portions of the popular Lugard Road and Harlech Road walking trails. The scenic enhancement was scheduled to launch alongside a new light and sound show for the upcoming Hong Kong WinterFest, acting as a modern replacement for the traditional "A Symphony of Lights" spectacular to boost the city's night-time economic appeal.

During the developmental process, the board sought feedback from multiple stakeholders and regulatory departments. In April, representatives introduced the creative concepts to the District Officer (Central and Western) and local district councilors. The board sent direct written notices to nearby households on 5 May, 2 September and 24 September to keep the community informed of construction timelines and temporary traffic arrangements. It also convened two cross-departmental meetings on 19 May and 5 August to coordinate safety, logistics and infrastructure regulations.

A total of ten public bodies were consulted on the project parameters, including the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department, the Fire Services Department, the Home Affairs Department, the Hong Kong Police Force, the Highways Department, the Lands Department, the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, the Transport Department, the Civil Engineering and Development Department, and the Water Supplies Department.

Under the original proposal, the low-glare lights were designed to operate on a controlled schedule from 7pm to 10pm daily, with all installations positioned away from residential properties to safeguard local privacy. The trial project was initially intended to run for a pilot phase of 12 months. To minimise the ecological footprint, the board engaged registered arborists and relevant departments to oversee environmental safety. Every aspect of the installation—including the selection of appropriate trees, hanging methods, protective cushioning, weight-bearing limits, and physical attachment techniques—required formal sign-off from professional arborists, who were also tasked with conducting routine follow-up inspections on the trees' health.

Recognising the intensity of public and resident feedback, the tourism board confirmed that it will carefully assess all suggestions, review the overall operational arrangements, and publish updated plans at a later date.

# Hong Kong finds 74 more buildings with lifts lacking door frame parts, total at 152

Hong Kong's Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said 74 more private buildings have lifts installed by Taijin without door frame components, raising the total to 152. About 180 buildings remain to be inspected, with the number expected to rise.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

Hong Kong's Electrical and Mechanical Services Department (EMSD) has announced that, in addition to two previously reported public housing estates, 74 more private buildings have lifts installed by Taijin without door frame components, bringing the total number of affected buildings to 152.

The EMSD launched inspections of lifts installed by Taijin across the city after discovering that lifts replaced by the company lacked door frame components. The department said about 180 buildings with lifts installed by Taijin have yet to be inspected, and it expects the number of non-compliant cases to rise further.

The department will prioritise inspections of lift works carried out by Taijin, while gradually checking projects by other registered lift contractors. According to the EMSD, it has also asked all registered contractors to review similar lift works conducted over the past decade.

title: World Food Day: Hundreds of protesters march to Parliament
summary: On Friday, 16 October 2026, hundreds of protesters marched to Parliament, calling for climate action and food sovereignty. The march took place in Cape Town on World Food Day and was organised by civil society organisations, such as the Cli
content:
On Friday, 16 October 2026, hundreds of protesters marched to Parliament, calling for climate action and food sovereignty. The march took place in Cape Town on World Food Day and was organised by civil society organisations, such as the Climate Justice Charter Movement (CJCM) and South African Food Sovereignty Campaign (SAFSC). However, the organisers were joined by multiple other civil society organisations, such as the Women on Farms Project, EcoMaties, the Cooperative and Policy Alternative Centre and Sovereign Agroecology and Food Empowerment. Protesters marched from Hanover Street in District Six to Parliament, where speeches were delivered by various civil society representatives. A memorandum was handed to parliamentary representatives, mainly calling on the government to place the country on a climate emergency footing, immediately ban harmful pesticides and adopt activists’ proposed legislation and policy documents on food sovereignty, according to SAFSC national coordinator Qhawekazi Mahlalela. “Today we bring our voices here to Parliament with a call for a fundamental transformation of our food system. We call on the government to put people before corporate profits, to support agroecology and to transition away from industrial agriculture and to recognise the role of communities in building those food systems that sustain life,” Mahlalela said during her speech outside Parliament. ### Food sovereignty and systems According to Mahlalela, the proposed food sovereignty legislation and policy are “twin documents” developed from 2015–2024 by SAFSC and CJCM activists in collaboration with allied civil society organisations and activists. These documents are intended to be guides for community organisers on the ground to solve food system and climate justice challenges, Mahlalela said. They equip organisers with knowledge of their rights but are also being used as a training tool for activists. Mahlalela added that the documents address multiple food-justice elements, such as growers’ rights regarding water, seeds, markets and finance. They imagine community-centred food systems, and food policy from a food-sovereignty perspective, she said. However, the government had failed to engage the CJCM and SAFSC when they brought the documents before Parliament in 2018 and again in 2024. This was one of the CJCM and SAFSC’s main grievances that led them to protest, Mahlalela said. ### Protesters’ grievances on World Food Day During her speech, CJCM co-chair Jessica Ngwenya highlighted the CJCM and SAFSC’s grievances about the government’s failure to engage with the activists on the proposed legislation and policy documents. The government had also failed to adopt the Climate Justice Charter, which the CJCM handed to Parliament in 2020 with the support of nearly 300 organisations, she said. According to Mahalela, the charter was developed in conjunction with communities and maps out food sovereignty, eco-mobility and rights of nature, as well as how these alternatives should help SA exit and survive the climate crisis. Ngwenya added that the government had failed to convene an emergency parliamentary sitting in 2018 to debate the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change’s Global Warming of 1.5°C report, missing an opportunity to prepare the country for worsening climate extremes and save lives. Activists march to Parliament on World Food Day on 16 October 2026. They are urging the government to declare a climate emergency ahead of the looming El Niño and to shift from reactive crisis management to a proactive, society-driven transition. (Photo: Misha Jordaan / Gallo Images) “We must ask ourselves: ‘What does it mean to mark this day in a country where so many people are going hungry? What does it mean to mark this day in a country where our food prices are constantly rising, but our salaries, our employment rates are not rising?’. “Hunger is not an inevitable crisis in this country. It is a result of a food system that puts profit before people and treats food as a commodity rather than a basic human right,” Mahalela said. She added that SA’s land, resources and power are concentrated in the hands of a few, while SA’s people should have the power to control their own food in a food-sovereignty system. In this system land, water, oceans, biodiversity and indigenous knowledge must be protected, she said. Small-scale farmers, farmworkers, fishers and community producers must be empowered and food production must be rooted in agroecology and dignity for all, she said. “It is high time. For too long our poor, small-scale farmers and impoverished communities have been entrapped in poverty. And we say enough is enough,” said Wendy Roebeck, a member of the CJCM. Seasonal farmworker Engela van Schalkwyk shared her experiences with the crowd. She detailed how her minimum wage pay is insufficient to support her until the end of the month. “Our people do the work on the farms, but the owners get big shares in the money from the grapes they export. They get the big pay, because of our people,” she said. According to Van Schalkwyk, the government should support farmworkers to build their own farms, noting that the workers have the skill, but not the resources. Activists and allied groups demanding food sovereignty march to Parliament on World Food Day. (Photo: Misha Jordaan / Gallo Images) CJCM co-chair Vishwas Satgar told the crowd that the country is facing a catastrophe, claiming that it is not prepared for the 1.5°C global warming overshoot nor the fact that the country is heating at twice the global average. “El Niño is coming. The last El Niño collapsed our food system; food prices went up. We are hungry. We are here to tell the government today, ‘Prepare the country for El Niño’,” he said. According to Satgar, the country’s lack of preparation for El Niño is a failure of leadership. “Wake up! The climate emergency is here!” Satgar chanted along with the crowd. ### Climate action and accelerating a just transition Near the end of the protest, Ngwenya read an open letter to the government. The organisations invited the government to place South Africa on a climate emergency footing and accelerate a just transition from below by supporting existing community activities, Ngwenya said. The CJCM and SAFSC had two broad demands; the first was for the government to end hunger by adopting food sovereignty. (Graphic: Iman Allie) The second was for the government to place the country on a climate emergency footing immediately. According to Ngwenya, these calls were endorsed by 220 other organisations.
](https://cdn.dailymaverick.co.za/i/3x9epS6xiQL4UyEgkkueUimK68c=/200x100/smart/filters:strip_exif()/file/attachments/orphans/Iman-WFDMarch1_660548.jpg) (Graphic: Iman Allie) ### Government representatives respond The memorandum was handed to the procedural adviser at Parliament, Perran Hahndiek. Addressing the crowd, Hahndiek said the memorandum would be lodged with National Assembly Speaker Thoko Didiza. Also present during the reading of the memorandum was the chief of staff in the Ministry of Finance, Mfuneko Toyana. Toyana said the SAFSC and CJCM’s message would be passed to the Minister of Finance and the National Treasury. Toyana added that the National Treasury has made funds available to address the effects of El Niño and that these developments would be announced on Wednesday, 21 October 2026, during the Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement. Western Cape Department of Water and Sanitation head Ntombizanele Bila-Mupariwa said she would deliver the protest’s message to the MEC and added that the MEC had already submitted a proposal with interventions to address the challenges of El Niño. Dissatisfied with the representatives’ responses, Satgar incited a chant once the final representative had finished speaking. “It’s not enough! It’s not enough! It’s not enough!” Satgar and the crowd chanted. **DM**

title: 贝森特：我今春曾要求欧洲盟友与我们一道，对中印实施次级关税但遭拒绝
summary: 美国总统特朗普周五（16日）签署了一份行政令，豁免多项涉俄制裁措施。更早时，特朗普9日在“真相社交”发文称，他与俄罗斯总统普京进行了一次“非常成功”的讨论：“双方同意，俄罗斯将立即向美国及全球市场供应超过30万吨柴油，并在11月再供应50万吨，随后立即再供应100万吨。此外，根据俄罗斯炼油厂的状况，俄方还将在短时间内供应300万吨柴油”。 发表时间： 18/10/2026 - 17:48 更改时间： 18/10/2026 - 17:51 14 分钟 浏览时间 在周日的访谈节目
content:
美国总统特朗普周五（16日）签署了一份行政令，豁免多项涉俄制裁措施。更早时，特朗普9日在“真相社交”发文称，他与俄罗斯总统普京进行了一次“非常成功”的讨论：“双方同意，俄罗斯将立即向美国及全球市场供应超过30万吨柴油，并在11月再供应50万吨，随后立即再供应100万吨。此外，根据俄罗斯炼油厂的状况，俄方还将在短时间内供应300万吨柴油”。

发表时间： 18/10/2026 - 17:48 更改时间： 18/10/2026 - 17:51

14 分钟 浏览时间

在周日的访谈节目中，当被美国全国广播公司（NBC）节目主持人韦尔克（Kristen Welker）问道，“特朗普总统签署了一项行政令，豁免了针对俄罗斯的制裁。我刚刚就此事与泽连斯基总统进行了交谈，他告诉我，此举是对普京的重大支持。为什么总统要奖赏一位入侵了乌克兰的独裁者？”

美国财政部长贝森特（Scott Bessent）回答说：“特朗普总统已明确表示，他希望杀戮能够停止。所谓的《格雷厄姆法》赋予了总统一定的灵活性，给予他60天的时间来评估局势。让我们看看实际情况究竟如何：欧洲人向俄罗斯和普京提供的资金，甚至超过了他们给予乌克兰的援助。他们仍在持续大量吞咽俄罗斯的能源”。

贝森特续称，“以（俄罗斯）亚马尔（液化天然气）设施为例，今年前6个月，该设施共发出了140批货物，其中136批运往了欧洲——具体包括前往比利时、西班牙、法国和荷兰，总价值超过80亿美元。因此，今年春天，我曾要求我们的欧洲盟友与我们一道，对中国和印度实施次级关税，但他们拒绝了。那么，为什么美国要独自承担这些负担呢？特朗普总统或许会与我们的欧洲伙伴进行沟通。美国为什么要独自行动呢？”

去年1月，贝森特在对其美国财长任命的提名听证会上曾对拜登政府的制裁政策提出过批评，并将乌克兰战争形容为自己一生中所见过的最大悲剧之一，贝森特当时说：“我认为，制裁力度不够。我认为，上一届政府是担心在大选期间导致美国国内能源价格上涨”。

就自己过去的发言，贝森特说：“首先，制裁力度实际上是翻了一倍。拜登政府在2025年1月即将卸任之际，采取了极其大胆的举措，将制裁力度增加了一倍。而我们并没有撤销这些制裁。特朗普总统对俄罗斯最大的两家能源公司——俄罗斯石油公司和卢克石油公司——实施了制裁，这对俄罗斯能源行业造成了灾难性一击。因此，在对俄制裁问题上，没有人比特朗普总统更强硬”。

贝森特续称：“周五并没有解除任何制裁。没有任何制裁被解除。（依照《格雷厄姆法》）我们设立了一个为期60天的观察期，以便审视局势发展。唯一被解除的是针对柴油的禁止贸易令。我想指出的是，英国早在5月份就豁免了其针对由俄罗斯原油提炼的柴油及航空燃油的禁运措施。那么，世界其他国家对此为何没有表现出愤慨呢？”

贝森特说：“要知道，泽连斯基总统并未批评他的欧洲伙伴。在那次采访中，他显得有些没有头绪。欧洲人正在为俄罗斯的战争机器提供资金。（2025年）美国从俄罗斯进口了价值40亿美元的产品，其中18亿美元是化肥。而欧洲人的进口额则是这一数字的十倍以上”。2025年，欧盟从俄罗斯的商品进口总额为279亿欧元，较2021年战前水平大幅下降了约90%，并非贝森特口中美国进口额的“十倍以上”。

当被主持人问道，“说到泽连斯基总统，他表示如果美国站在俄罗斯一边，乌克兰将无法获胜。一些共和党参议员认为，此举正是起到了这样的作用。那么，总统这是站在了俄罗斯一边吗？”

贝森特给予否认，并称：“再说一次，这是一种虚假的二元化。美国提供了什么？美国提供了情报。还有‘星链’；我们还允许北约成员国购买美国的武器装备，并将其转售给乌克兰。当泽连斯基总统请求提供‘爱国者’防空系统时——要知道，北约及其欧洲成员国手中拥有很多‘爱国者’系统，为什么他们迟迟不愿提供这些系统呢？德国又在哪里？为什么不给乌克兰提供‘爱国者’系统呢？”

此外，美国能源部长赖特（Chris Wright）周日在接受美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）节目采访中说：“首先，我们需要明确一点：针对俄罗斯的主要制裁措施依然全部有效。俄罗斯主要出口的产品是石油。我们不仅对俄罗斯石油实施了制裁，而且这些制裁的收紧力度前所未有——我们制裁了他们最大的石油企业。目前，俄罗斯几乎所有的石油都只能流向中国，而且是以折扣价出售，交付周期也拖得很长。因此，特朗普总统仅针对柴油出口放宽了制裁。过去一个多月里，俄罗斯唯一无法出口的产品是什么？就是柴油，因为他们自己也缺柴油”。

赖特续称：“全球范围内都面临柴油短缺，而特朗普总统正不遗余力地寻求各种途径，以减轻美国民众的成本负担。因此，如果俄罗斯能向市场额外供应并出口柴油，这将惠及美国消费者，乃至全世界。但要实现这一点，俄罗斯必须缓和与乌克兰的冲突，或者达成能源停火。他正在施加的压力，既会让美国消费者受益，也有助于推动俄乌战争走向和平”。

当稍后被主持人问道：“我想回到我最初提出的那个问题，即关于《格雷厄姆法》以及针对俄罗斯的经济制裁——这与您刚才提到的柴油协议是两码事。总统为什么要那样做（豁免制裁）？”

赖特说道：“《格雷厄姆法》并非关于对俄罗斯实施经济制裁，而是针对与俄罗斯有贸易往来的国家实施经济制裁。其中有两个具有实质意义的国家，即中国和印度。我们正在与中国就这一冲突（俄乌战争）以及我们（美中）之间的长期贸易关系进行探讨。他（特朗普）并没有终止《格雷厄姆法》规定的制裁，只是暂时暂停了这些制裁的执行”。

当被问及特朗普为何这样做时，赖特说：“这是因为当前这场冲突局势复杂多变；而这些权力依然掌握在他手中，以便在适当时机予以启用”。

content:
中新社布拉格10月18日电 台湾最新的国际航空公司星宇航空周日表示，从10月1日起，该航空公司将其台北-布拉格直飞航班从8月份开通时的每周三班增加到每周四班。

加上中华航空每周三班的台北-布拉格航班，此次扩建为旅客提供了台湾与捷克首都之间的每日直达航班选择。

华航于2023年开通布拉格航线，并于4月增至每周三班。

星宇航空于8月1日开通布拉格航线，作为其首个欧洲目的地，成为第二家直飞捷克首都的台湾航空公司。

星宇航空发言人梁文龙表示，该航线8月客座率为82%，尽管欧洲旅游淡季，但在捷克经台湾飞往日本的旅客的帮助下，预计11月客座率将保持在80%以上。

梁表示，预计直航不仅能促进双向旅游，还能促进涉及台湾半导体供应链的投资和商业合作。

据捷克旅游局统计，2026年前8个月，台湾赴捷克游客人数达10.88万人次，同比增长5.9%。仅8月份，入境游客人数同比增长21.1%，达到15,900人。

此次扩张也正值台湾半导体供应商继台积电在德国德累斯顿的项目之后增加对中欧的投资。
其中包括TaMiCo Technology Taiwan Ltd.，该公司计划在靠近德国边境的捷克拉贝河畔乌斯季地区建造一家半导体元件清洗和表面处理工厂。

布拉格仍然是首选目的地，主要景点包括 14 世纪的查理大桥、老城广场、天文钟和佩特任缆车。

为了推广这条路线，Starlux 任命流行偶像蔡依林为品牌大使，为其热门歌曲《布拉格广场》制作新版本。

该航空公司还部署了两架空客 A350-1000 喷气客机，涂上由日本艺术家 Hajime Sorayama 创作的特殊“Sorayama Gold”和“Sorayama Silver”涂装，并于 10 月 1 日推出了从办理登机手续到机上设施的全面“AIRSORAYAMA”主题航班。

梁说，艺术主题飞机也带动了其他航线的高载客率，东京清晨航班的平均载客率约为 90%，凤凰城航班的表现也继续强劲。

（蒋明彦、高伊芙撰）

Enditem/sfj

【原文 English Original】
Prague, Oct. 18 (CNA) Starlux Airlines, Taiwan's newest international carrier, has increased its Taipei-Prague service to four nonstop flights a week from Oct. 1, up from three when the route was launched in August, the airline said Sunday.

Together with China Airlines' three weekly Taipei-Prague services, the expansion gives travelers a daily nonstop option between Taiwan and the Czech capital.

China Airlines launched its Prague route in 2023 and increased it to three weekly flights in April.

Starlux inaugurated its Prague route on Aug. 1 as its first European destination, becoming the second Taiwanese carrier to fly direct to the Czech capital.

Starlux spokesperson Walter Liang (梁文龍) said the route's passenger load factor was 82 percent in August and is expected to stay above 80 percent in November despite the low season for European travel, helped by Czech travelers flying to Japan via Taiwan.

Liang said the direct service is expected to boost not only two-way tourism but also investment and business cooperation involving Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain.

According to CzechTourism, Taiwanese visitor arrivals in Czechia reached 108,800 in the first eight months of 2026, up 5.9 percent from a year earlier. In August alone, arrivals rose 21.1 percent year on year to 15,900.

The expansion also comes as Taiwanese semiconductor suppliers increase investments in Central Europe following Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.'s project in Dresden, Germany.

They include TaMiCo Technology Taiwan Ltd., which plans to build a plant for cleaning and surface-treating semiconductor components in the Czech region of Ústí nad Labem, near the German border.

Prague remains a top destination, with major attractions including the 14th-century Charles Bridge, Old Town Square, the Astronomical Clock, and the Petřín Funicular cable car.

To promote the route, Starlux named pop icon Jolin Tsai (蔡依林) as brand ambassador to produce a new version of her hit song "Prague Square."

The airline also deployed two Airbus A350-1000 jetliners in special "Sorayama Gold" and "Sorayama Silver" liveries created with Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama, and on Oct. 1 launched fully "AIRSORAYAMA"-themed flights, from check-in to onboard amenities.

Liang said the art-themed aircraft have also driven high load factors on other routes, with early-morning Tokyo flights averaging around 90 percent and Phoenix services continuing to perform strongly.

(By Jiang Ming-yan and Evelyn Kao)

Enditem/sfj

title: 一段借位视频，为什么换来5年不准来台？
summary: 茉莉花深度报道 文 / 陈书昀 两岸事务撰稿人 台大一名王姓大陆交换生在赖清德出席的活动上借位拍下“手捏赖总统头”的视频，配上统一标签发到抖音，10月16日被移民署驱逐出境、5年内不许申请来台。依据是许可办法里一句“违背对等尊严原则之不当行为”；内政部自己的处理原则，对第一次违背对等尊严定的却是2年。 原始文件 网页 大陆地区人民进入台湾地区许可办法（全国法规资料库） law.moj.gov.tw 打开 PDF 大陆地区人民申请进入台湾地区不予许可期间处理原则（移民署） im
content: 茉莉花深度报道 文 / 陈书昀 两岸事务撰稿人 台大一名王姓大陆交换生在赖清德出席的活动上借位拍下“手捏赖总统头”的视频，配上统一标签发到抖音，10月16日被移民署驱逐出境、5年内不许申请来台。依据是许可办法里一句“违背对等尊严原则之不当行为”；内政部自己的处理原则，对第一次违背对等尊严定的却是2年。 原始文件 网页 大陆地区人民进入台湾地区许可办法（全国法规资料库） law.moj.gov.tw 打开 PDF 大陆地区人民申请进入台湾地区不予许可期间处理原则（移民署） immigration.gov.tw · PDF 下载 网页 移民署新闻稿（2026年10月16日） immigration.gov.tw 打开 要点 移民署依许可办法第12条第1项第15款“违背对等尊严原则之不当行为”驱逐这名陆生，管制5年，是这一款的最重年限。 内政部处理原则对第一次违背对等尊严定的是2年，再次才是5年；称“中国台湾”的梁姓游客被管制2年。 2025年梁文杰说，政府对言论很限缩，但只要涉及宣扬武力统一台湾就不允许；这次移民署的理由是违背对等尊严和引发社会纷扰。 北京用刑法：杨智渊被判9年，李延贺被判3年，22条意见最重可判死刑。 我们的分析 大陆人士在台湾靠一纸行政许可，移民署凭一句“违背对等尊严”就能收回，罚几年也由移民署决定，不必先经法院。 10月12日，总统赖清德到台湾大学出席“台湾桥梁计划”闭幕式并致词，一名王姓大陆交换生在现场侧录，用借位制造出“手捏赖总统头”的画面，配上「小小赖清德拿下」「#两岸统一#台湾是中国不可分割的一部分」等文字发到抖音。10月16日，移民署废止这名学生的入境许可、将其驱逐出境，5年内不许申请来台，这名学生当天下午3时离开台湾。一段借位视频，为什么能让一名交换生几天之内被驱逐、5年不准再来？ 答案在于这名学生入境靠的是一纸行政许可：《大陆地区人民进入台湾地区许可办法》里一句「從事違背對等尊嚴原則之不當行為」，就让移民署可以自己认定、废止许可、驱逐出境，不必先经法院，罚几年也由移民署决定。这次给的5年，在内政部自己的处理原则里是再次违背对等尊严才用的年限，第一次是2年。台湾的处分比北京用刑法判台湾人坐牢轻得多，但什么话算违背对等尊严、该罚几年，都由行政机关自己决定。 一句条文，移民署认定 这部办法第12条第1项列了二十四款可以不予许可、撤销或废止许可的情形，第15款就是上面那一句；第14条规定，有这一款情形的不予许可期间是1年至5年。这一款只有这一句，没有说明什么样的行为算违背对等尊严。移民署说，这次是调查后会商教育部和陆委会等机关，认定这名学生的不当行为违背对等尊严原则并引发社会纷扰。不服这类处分要先提诉愿，对诉愿决定不服才能向行政法院起诉，处分原则上照样执行；法院即使审查，也在驱逐之后。 罚多重，内政部另有《大陆地区人民申请进入台湾地区不予许可期间处理原则》：第2点第5款规定，从事违背对等尊严原则的不当行为，2年不予许可申请来台，再次从事才是5年。一名梁姓中国人在小红书的来台旅游影片里称呼「中國台灣」，并在文字前方加上五星红旗，移民署以「曾有違背對等尊嚴言行」为由不予许可其来台观光2年，梁男提起诉愿，被行政院驳回；据中央社报道，梁男说，曾打电话问移民署“违背对等尊严言行”指的是什么，移民署不肯说，要梁男自己回想（未经证实）。这一次给的却是5年。《联合报》报道，这名学生的行为被认为以「管制最重年限」为宜；移民署的说明既没有提到这名学生此前有违背对等尊严的纪录，也没有说明为什么给5年。 从“武统”到“对等尊严” 2025年陆配因言论被驱逐时，政府划的线比这窄。陆委会副主委兼发言人梁文杰2025年3月13日说，政府对这类言论的管制「很限縮」，但「只要涉及宣揚武力統一台灣，這個就是不允許」，理由是联合国公约禁止鼓吹战争的宣传。陆配刘振亚在抖音开设“亚亚在台湾”频道，被移民署以「有危害國家安全或社會安定之虞」废止依亲居留、5年内不许再申请；台北高等行政法院3月21日驳回刘振亚停止执行的声请，认定其以抖音散布「支持中國大陸武力統一中華民國」，有鼓吹战争宣传的事实。 这一次，移民署的理由里没有武统。联合新闻网的“新闻眼”专栏批评，移民署没有说明照片或留言违背了什么对等尊严、引发了哪些社会纷扰。从“宣扬武力统一”到“违背对等尊严”，会被处罚的言论宽了很多。2019年也有大陆人士因政治言行在台湾受罚，走的却是刑事程序：就读国立清华大学的大陆学生刘蕾9月30日毁损校内连侬墙上的反送中海报，新竹地方法院以毁损他人物品罪判处罚金新台币6000元；同年10月，大陆游客李绍东在台大撕毁连侬墙海报，获缓起诉后被移民署强制出境、5年内不得入境。 北京罚台湾人，用的是刑法 台湾的处分是送走、限制再来，北京处罚台湾人的言行用的是刑法。2024年6月21日，最高人民法院等五部门公布惩治“台独”顽固分子的22条意见：犯分裂国家罪的首要分子或罪行重大的，对国家和人民危害特别严重、情节特别恶劣的，可以判处死刑；顽固宣扬“台独”分裂主张的，以煽动分裂国家罪定罪。温州市中级人民法院2024年8月26日以分裂国家罪判处台湾居民杨智渊有期徒刑9年；上海市第一中级人民法院2025年2月17日以煽动分裂国家罪判处八旗文化总编辑李延贺（外界称“富察”）有期徒刑3年。国台办发言人朱凤莲2025年4月30日还说，民进党当局所谓“对等尊严”，就是企图改变两岸同属一中这个历史和法理事实。到《联合报》和《世界日报》发稿时，国台办和大陆教育部都没有就这次驱逐回应。 表：两岸怎样处罚对方的人的言行——杨智渊（台湾居民）：依据 分裂国家罪，由谁决定 温州市中级人民法院，2024年8月，结果 有期徒刑9年；李延贺（八旗文化总编辑）：依据 煽动分裂国家罪，由谁决定 上海市第一中级人民法院，2025年2月，结果 有期徒刑3年；刘振亚（陆配“亚亚”）：依据 有危害国家安全或社会安定之虞，由谁决定 移民署，2025年3月，结果 废止依亲居留，5年内不许再申请；梁姓中国游客：依据 曾有违背对等尊严言行，由谁决定 移民署，结果 2年不予许可来台观光；王姓大陆交换生：依据 违背对等尊严原则并引发社会纷扰，由谁决定 移民署，2026年10月，结果 驱逐出境，5年内不许申请来台。 受影响的是两岸仅剩的学生往来。教育部统计，105学年度来台的大陆学生有4万1981人，其中研修生3万2648人；大陆教育部2020年4月暂停毕业生赴台升读后，114学年度正式修读学位的陆生只剩1081人。移民署统计的大陆研修生入境，2024年为2,296人次，2025年为3,551人次，今年前2个月为1,200人次。海基会秘书长罗文嘉说，陆生来台交换是「仅存的、少有的往来」。 表：正式修读学位的陆生从九千多人减到1,081人——105学年度（2016—2017）：正式修读学位的陆生（人） 9,327；106学年度（2017—2018）：正式修读学位的陆生（人） 9,462；113学年度（2024—2025）：正式修读学位的陆生（人） 1,556；114学年度（2025—2026）：正式修读学位的陆生（人） 1,081。 我们的立场 联合国《世界人权宣言》第十九条写明「人人有权享有主张和发表意见的自由」，《中华民国宪法》第11条规定「人民有言論、講學、著作及出版之自由」。我们支持言论自由，包括许多人反感的言论；这名学生因为一段借位视频和几个标签被驱逐、5年内不能再来台湾，我们对此表示同情。台湾对言论的处罚远比北京轻，正因为台湾保障言论自由，什么话会被罚、罚多重，更应该由条文写清楚、由法院把关，而不是由移民署逐案认定。 不同看法和接下来看什么 不同意这个判断的人，最有力的理由是这段视频不只是嘲讽。民进党立委陈培瑜说，这些言论涉及国家元首人身安全与威吓意味，「國安底線不容退讓」；陆委会主委邱垂正2025年3月25日说过，矮化、消灭中华民国的言论「已不屬於言論自由層次」。我们同意，威胁总统人身安全的话不受言论自由保护，台湾的处分也比北京轻得多；但移民署给出的理由不是恐吓，如果真是恐吓，台湾有刑法和法院可以处理。这名学生的道歉声明说「本人並沒有任何明確的希望造成人身傷害的計畫」；FTNN新闻网报道，这名学生事后对原发文者说，相关标签应该是抖音平台加上去的（未经证实），移民署则认定是这名学生标注的。 如果检方以恐吓危害安全罪对这名学生立案，或移民署说明这名学生此前已有违背对等尊严的纪录，那么这次的5年依据的是实际的危险或再犯，本文的判断就错了。 接下来看两件事。第一，内政部或陆委会若公布“违背对等尊严”的认定标准，或修改许可办法的这一款，说明政府承认这条线需要写清楚，来台的大陆人士可以事先知道什么话会被罚；若没有，说明下一次仍由移民署逐案认定。我们判断，到2026年12月31日，内政部不会修改这一款，也不会公布认定标准。移民署在这次处分后说，会持续强化跨机关合作和违法违规事件的处理，民进党立委陈培瑜也说，国安底线不容退让。 第二，移民署统计的2027年1月至2月大陆研修生入境人次若低于2026年同期的1,200人次，说明这次驱逐和两岸对立正在压缩仅剩的交换；若不低于，说明一次驱逐没有改变交换的规模。我们判断，2027年1月至2月的大陆研修生入境人次不会低于1,200人次。北京停了学位生，交换却没有停，研修生入境从2024年到2025年还在增加。 一段借位视频能让一名交换生几天之内被驱逐、5年不准再来，是因为大陆人士在台湾的去留取决于一纸行政许可，移民署凭一句“违背对等尊严”就能收回，罚几年也由移民署决定。2019年毁损连侬墙海报的大陆学生，由法院判了罚金；2026年拍了一段借位视频的大陆交换生，被移民署驱逐、管制5年，而这5年在内政部自己的处理原则里本是再犯才用的年限。 茉莉花深度报道独立调研、撰写。 参考报道：联合报（10月12日） · 中央社（10月16日） · 中央通讯社（台湾）（10月16日）

# Chung Yeung Festival spending steady as Hongkongers honour ancestors

Hong Kong residents marked Chung Yeung Festival with visits to cemeteries and columbaria, noting stable costs for traditional offerings despite a modest rise in roast meat prices. Spending ranged from tens to several hundred dollars, which many described as reasonable.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 18 Oct 2026 at 17:53 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Chung%20Yeung%20Festival%20spending%20steady%20as%20Hongkongers%20honour%20ancestors%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Chung-Yeung-Festival-spending-steady-as-Hongkongers-honour-a-97fa1f "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Chung-Yeung-Festival-spending-steady-as-Hongkongers-honour-a-97fa1f&text=Chung%20Yeung%20Festival%20spending%20steady%20as%20Hongkongers%20honour%20ancestors "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Chung-Yeung-Festival-spending-steady-as-Hongkongers-honour-a-97fa1f "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Chung-Yeung-Festival-spending-steady-as-Hongkongers-honour-a-97fa1f&text=Chung%20Yeung%20Festival%20spending%20steady%20as%20Hongkongers%20honour%20ancestors "X")[](mailto:?subject=Chung%20Yeung%20Festival%20spending%20steady%20as%20Hongkongers%20honour%20ancestors&body=Chung%20Yeung%20Festival%20spending%20steady%20as%20Hongkongers%20honour%20ancestors%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Chung-Yeung-Festival-spending-steady-as-Hongkongers-honour-a-97fa1f "Email")

Hong Kong residents visited cemeteries and columbaria across the city on Chung Yeung Festival to pay tribute to their ancestors, with many noting that the cost of traditional offerings remained stable compared with previous years.

At the Shek Mun Columbarium and Memorial Garden, which opened in September last year, crowds gathered carrying fresh flowers, roast meats, and paper effigies. Although some grave-sweepers noted a modest uptick of around 20 per cent in the price of roast meats due to the holiday, overall expenditures ranged from tens to several hundred dollars, a level residents widely described as reasonable.

"The gesture is what matters most," said a resident surnamed Ip, who spent dozens of dollars on incense, roasted pork, fruit, and drinks to pay respects to her late family members. Another resident surnamed Cheung, who spent between HK$200 and HK$300 on offerings, observed that crowd-control measures and foot traffic at the facility remained orderly and manageable despite the holiday turnout.

title: Joburg mayoral candidate Tlaleng Mofokeng on grief and a vision
summary: When [Dr Tlaleng Mofokeng](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-08-16-fresh-face-bold-policies-eff-s-dr-tlaleng-mofokeng-outlines-her-vision-for-joburg/) was approached about becoming the Economic Freedom Fighters’ mayoral candidate
content:
When [Dr Tlaleng Mofokeng](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-08-16-fresh-face-bold-policies-eff-s-dr-tlaleng-mofokeng-outlines-her-vision-for-joburg/) was approached about becoming the Economic Freedom Fighters’ mayoral candidate for Johannesburg, her husband was the first person she told. He encouraged her to make herself available, telling her that after years of fighting for other people’s rights around the world, she should bring that fight to the city they called home.

That was one of their last conversations before her husband died on 10 July, leaving the 44-year-old medical doctor and human rights activist to navigate the demands of an election campaign while grieving his death and adjusting to life as a single parent.

For a brief period, Mofokeng questioned whether she could or should continue, but ultimately decided the reasons she agreed to stand had not changed. “I would feel like I’m letting myself down if I didn’t do this because the reasons why I said ‘yes’ are still the same and still existed even after he had passed away,” she said.

Mofokeng enters Johannesburg’s mayoral contest with an extensive career in medicine, international health policy and human rights advocacy, including serving as the United Nations Special Rapporteur on the right to health. Although this is her first attempt at elected office, she has helped develop the EFF’s election manifestos since the party’s early years.

She hopes to bring a different approach to the Johannesburg Metro, a municipality beset by political instability, failing infrastructure and deteriorating services, and argues that the City’s leadership has lost sight of the people it is supposed to serve.

Dr Tlaleng Mofokeng at Milk Bar in Parkmore, Johannesburg, on 6 October 2026. (Photo: Our City News / Alaister Russell)

At the centre of her candidacy is the belief that dignity, care and empathy should shape how Johannesburg is governed, especially when decisions affect residents who already struggle to access essential services or have little influence over the institutions that deliver them.

“Why I always talk about dignity in my candidacy is precisely because dignity has been eroded from all of us, for so long,” Mofokeng said.

Mofokeng says her activism began during her childhood in QwaQwa and has remained central to her work as a doctor and international human rights advocate, describing herself as an activist first and a doctor second.

### It’s personal

Her commitment to Johannesburg is also personal. Sitting at Milk Bar at George Lea Park in Sandton, while rushing between meetings recently, she described having moved to Johannesburg as a young doctor and remembers travelling through popular and familiar taxi routes and public space, feeling safer in the city that many residents now fear entering.

She recalls a city where people worked hard, embraced its cultural life and found opportunities despite their circumstances, and she believes much of that determination remains even as the infrastructure supporting it has deteriorated.

“I think that’s where our disappointment comes from... Our passion and our drive is not matched by processes and resources and infrastructure that works to meet us somewhere,” she said.

Mofokeng’s proposals combine the EFF’s commitments to insourcing municipal services and expanding access to basic infrastructure with a greater emphasis on how residents participate in decisions affecting their communities.

She wants ward-based people’s assemblies, technical oversight teams to scrutinise infrastructure spending and a one-stop municipal service centre where entrepreneurs and informal traders can get help with permits, registration and compliance.

Rather than relying primarily on punitive enforcement, she argues that municipal officials should help residents understand and comply with regulations, while giving communities greater insight into how budgets are allocated.

### Migration

Mofokeng is also critical of politicians who exploit frustration over migration, arguing that failures in government planning, immigration administration and service delivery have contributed to tensions between communities. The exploitation of these tensions for political gain was on display again recently in Soweto and in Durban, which led to public violence following misinformation about a [Constitutional Court ruling](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-10-13-what-the-constitutional-court-judgment-on-asylum-actually-said/) on asylum laws.

Joburg mayoral candidate Dr Tlaleng Mofokeng speaks to Our City News. (Photo: Our City News / Alaister Russell)

“It can’t be that 5% of the population is the one that’s causing all of the queues in the clinics or causing all of the queues in the schools,” she said, rejecting the suggestion that migrants are responsible for Johannesburg’s wider problems.

Her approach raises questions about financing and implementation, as the City continues to battle collapsing infrastructure and reduced revenue collection, while the EFF proposes employing more municipal workers, reducing outsourcing and expanding services – all of which would require significant administrative changes and investment.

Mofokeng believes the municipality can recover resources through better management, reduced waste and stronger negotiations with the national government. But coalition politics could further complicate those ambitions, particularly where the EFF’s opposition to privatisation conflicts with the priorities of potential governing partners. Mofokeng, however, refuses to exclude parties from pre-election negotiations, arguing that a mayor must represent residents regardless of how they voted.

### Wider concerns

Her concerns extend beyond municipal finances and infrastructure to the conditions in which people live, including the fear of violence that restricts women’s freedom and the disappearance of public spaces where children can play. She also advocates for renewed investment in Johannesburg’s theatres, cultural institutions and recreational facilities.

“We work hard in Johannesburg, but we also come here to play and to dream, and to be creative. And I think it’s very important to not neglect that,” she said.

For Mofokeng, the mayoralty is a chance to change how the municipality functions rather than build another political career. “I don’t want to be a mayor for too long. I want to be a mayor, achieve things, change systems. But this is not a new career move for me,” she said.

EFF mayoral candidate for Johannesburg Dr Tlaleng Mofokeng believes the mayoralty is a chance to change how the municipality functions. (Photo: OUR CITY NEWS / Alaister Russell)

Her decision to continue campaigning despite her husband’s death has also brought the importance of community support into sharper focus. She spoke about the friends and family who have helped her manage the responsibilities of parenthood while allowing her the space to grieve.

“Grief is also its own thing. It comes in its own time and it comes in waves,” she said.

Despite the financial and political challenges ahead, Mofokeng remains committed to her vision for Johannesburg, drawing encouragement from her final conversation with her husband and the words that helped convince her to stand. **DM**

_This interview is part of an ongoing series by Our City News featuring key mayoral candidates contesting the City of Johannesburg in the local government elections._

title: Tshwane needs better freight rail to become SA’s automotive capital
summary: There was a blue, oval-shaped void on the show floor at SA Auto Week 2026 in Durban this week. Ford Motor Company Africa’s president, Neale Hill, was on the speakers’ list, but it had no representation as a brand with a stand. Into this vac
content:
There was a blue, oval-shaped void on the show floor at SA Auto Week 2026 in Durban this week. Ford Motor Company Africa’s president, Neale Hill, was on the speakers’ list, but it had no representation as a brand with a stand.

Into this vacuum stepped Chery, latest tenant of the Nissan factory in Rosslyn, Pretoria, and its neighbour in the not-so-special automotive economic zone, BMW.

The Eastern Cape can say what it wants, but Gauteng hosts 200 automotive component firms alongside major assembly plants, and generates 34.4% of South Africa’s total GDP. And Pretoria serves as the country’s central hub for automotive research, development and technical skills, making a powerful case for it serving as the strategic inland platform for vehicle assembly and export into broader African markets.

Tony Liu, chief executive of Chery SA, says that as a new investor coming to the country, the company is in it for the long run. “We are here in South Africa for the people and are also becoming a South African citizen. So, we are part of the economy, part of this country’s economic development.”

But there are barriers that all businesses and even citizens fully understand, and Liu knows he will have to grapple with them. “Infrastructure-cost competitiveness, including water and electricity – those are basic things. Logistics cost – that is also going to be adding a lot of weight onto our competitiveness across Africa and even globally,” he tells Daily Maverick.

BMW’s Rosslyn plant exports most of its production volume. Operating far inland from coastal export ports creates structural logistics vulnerabilities that require reliable rail infrastructure and stable municipal grid connections.

“It’s the wrong place, to be honest, because we export 96% of our volume… So that’s always been an issue, and our biggest challenges have been logistics,” admits Peter van Binsbergen, chairperson and chief executive of BMW Group SA.

### The Transnet curse

One of the benefits of moving into Rosslyn is that a railway line runs by it, but this has not always been the benefit it should have been.

“We’ve had a lot of logistics challenges in the time when Transnet was shaky,” says Van Binsbergen. “Post-Covid, when railway lines and power cables were being stolen, we had a lot of problems getting our cars and our parts in and out of Rosslyn. So we even brought in containers via Mozambique and things like that.

“We have a rail line that comes right to our siding at the vehicle distribution centre, but that rail line has just been notoriously unstable.”

Chery SA chief executive Tony Liu. (Photo: Supplied / Chery South Africa)

So, Daily Maverick was not surprised to spot both Van Binsbergen and Liu in conversation with Transnet group CEO Michelle Phillips on day two of the conference.

“We managed to clear up ... as the motor industry meeting with Transnet that we want to actually put more on rail instead of on trucks,” the BMW chief disclosed. “Trucks are not our wish… But you need to balance your line so that it’s full going down to the port and full coming back. Having Chery in Rosslyn might, or will, give us a bit more muscle to balance that line a bit better.”

### Special zone, special treatment

One Pretoria carmaker that also has a railway line running right by it, Ford, was actually promised improved logistics when it sank R15-billion into Silverton.

“There has been progress in the broader rail reform process, including the rail access framework and onboarding of private operators, as well as some progress at ports,” Ford wrote in reply to questions. “However, rail is one part of an interconnected logistics value chain, and the entire ecosystem needs to operate in unison.

“For Ford, the key issue is how this translates into reliable, commercially viable services that support automotive manufacturing and exports.

“This requires a rail system that runs on time, has suitable rolling stock, and provides dependable connections between manufacturing hubs and ports so that incoming goods and export vehicles reach their destinations on schedule, and support our wider business operations.

Neale Hill, president of Ford Motor Company in Africa, at a function on 10 April 2024 when the Nelson Mandela Foundation recognised the company as a Legacy Champion, the highest tier of donors to the foundation. (Photo: Supplied)

“Access agreements and reform milestones are important, but the real measure will be dependable operational services across the logistics chain.”

Ford’s castle is in the heart of the Tshwane Automotive Special Economic Zone (Tasez), an empire that spans 162.6ha in Silverton and holds pride of place as Africa’s first automotive city. It is backed by direct funding and a multi-
tiered government partnership between the De­­partment of Trade, Industry and Com­petition, the Gauteng provincial gov­­ernment and the City of Tshwane.

As part of the privilege of re­­ceiving Cyril Rama­phosa’s blessing during his 2019 presidential campaign, the Tasez has been integrated into a VIP energy grid to protect tenants against municipal power interruptions, alongside dedicated rail sidings connecting Rosslyn and Silverton factories straight to export ports.

### Break in the chain

Transnet’s CEO has actively engaged with automotive leaders during industry forums to build collaboration channels between the state-owned logistics provider and primary vehicle manufacturers.

“We will talk to the automotive industry about how best we can support them going forward, both on port and rail, and engage with them on collaboration initiatives and how they can support us to make sure that we do what is required for the industry,” Phillips told Daily Maverick after her conversation with Liu.

Transnet group CEO Michelle Phillips at the Africa Rail Expo that was held at the Sandton Convention Centre on 7 July 2026 in Johannesburg. (File photo: Fani Mahuntsi / Gallo Images)

“We are in this business because we know that it’s difficult, actually, and that there are problems to be solved. I think in the logistics space, if you don’t have a problem, then you have a problem... Look, we are trying hard together with the teams to support the industry as much as we can.”

To be fair to Transnet, it is on the right track to reform in two important ways. First, manufacturers acknowledge a marked improvement in Transnet’s willingness to communicate openly, resolving misunderstandings regarding rail usage versus road freighting.

And second, Phillips’s engagement with Rosslyn manufacturers on bi-directional corridor efficiency addresses line balancing – using inbound trains for imported components or vehicles and outbound trains for export vehicles – and has seemingly set clear objectives.

However, there is still an execution gap. Although leadership dialogue is welcomed, manufacturer evaluations – particularly from Ford – still show that reform milestones, access frameworks and private sector onboarding must rapidly translate into on-time rail schedules, sufficient rolling stock and seamless port handling to protect manufacturing competitiveness.

Van Binsbergen reveals a possible policy direction that could salvage the ailing industry. “If we really want to get economies of scale, we’ve got to actually agree that [we need to] specialise in South Africa … in wiring harnesses, car glass, tyres,” he suggests.

“And then we have to be able to talk to each other without breaking competition law to say, ‘Okay guys, these are the topics we’re going to focus on. We’re going to give enough ­volume to the producer so they can get their economies of scale in place and we can develop like pools of competence.’ ”

There must be something in the water on the west side of Tshwane because Liu was singing a similar tune of collaboration and united industrial action. Now, if only that message can spread. **DM**

# 高虹安競選總部成立 藍白要角站台

2026/10/18 19:00（10/18 19:50 更新）

爭取連任的新竹市長高虹安（前排左4）18日成立競選總部暨後援會，民眾黨創黨主席柯文哲（前排右3）、主席黃國昌（前排右2）等人到場站台。中央社記者魯鋼駿攝 115年10月18日

（中央社記者[魯鋼駿](https://cna.com.tw/author/0076/)新竹市18日電）新竹市長高虹安競選總部暨後援會今天成立，國民黨主席鄭麗文表示，國民黨將百分之百力挺高虹安連任；民眾黨創黨主席柯文哲、主席黃國昌及台中市長盧秀燕等人也到場站台。

高虹安競選總部暨後援會成立大會今天下午舉行，國民黨籍台中市長盧秀燕、嘉義市長黃敏惠、台東縣長饒慶鈴，以及鄭麗文、柯文哲與黃國昌先後到場力挺。

盧秀燕致詞表示，新竹是科技城市，家戶所得高，要讓新竹持續發展，市長必須懂科技、運用科技，而高虹安就是科技人，呼籲選民支持連任。

黃敏惠表示，新竹市與嘉義市是姊妹市，雙方持續互相學習，高虹安過去經歷許多挑戰與困難，仍積極參與縣市長聯盟交流，期盼選民團結支持高虹安，讓新竹持續進步。

饒慶鈴說，高虹安面臨司法案件及罷免壓力，但市政工作未曾停歇，持續推動地方建設，肯定高虹安外圓內方、溫柔堅強，期盼選民再次支持高虹安，為新竹市擘劃未來4年發展。

柯文哲表示，4年前由他推薦高虹安參選新竹市長，高虹安雖面臨司法案件壓力，仍持續推動市政，讓市府從負債百億元達成零負債，期待高虹安在第2任期持續建設。

鄭麗文說，高虹安過去4年面對國家機器打壓，仍未荒廢市政。高虹安雖非國民黨員，但為了國家、公平正義及新竹市未來，國民黨團隊將百分之百支持高虹安連任，此次支持已超越藍白。

黃國昌表示，高虹安投入新竹選戰時，民眾黨新竹隊尚未成形，如今已建立堅強團隊，即使高虹安曾因司法案件暫離市長職務，市府團隊仍持續推動市政，呼籲選民支持高虹安連任及民眾黨議員參選人。

高虹安表示，上任時承接逾新台幣100億元公共債務，今年7月已將受「公共債務法」債限管制的債務全數還清，每年可減少近2億元利息支出，市府也完成25條校園通學步道及多所學校新校舍等公共工程，盼選民支持連任。（編輯：管中維、蕭博文）1151018

# 中国对高市早苗向靖国神社供奉祭品表示强烈谴责 韩国表示遗憾

日本首相高市早苗于17日，在东京九段北的靖国神社开始举行秋季例行大祭的第一天，以“内阁总理大臣 高市早苗”的名义，向神社供奉了祭祀用品真榊（一种用于神道祭祀的供品）。为此，中国驻日使馆17日发表《驻日本使馆发言人就日方涉靖国神社消极动向答记者问》一文指出：中方强烈谴责日方涉靖国神社消极动向。韩国外交部17日就高市早苗首相在靖国神社秋季例行大祭期间奉纳供品一事发表发言人评论。评论称：“对于日本负有责任的领导人再次向美化日本过去侵略战争、合祀战争罪犯的靖国神社奉纳供品或反复参拜一事，我们再次表示深深的失望和遗憾。”

18日，自民党众议院议员、负责国家安全保障事务的首相助理若宫健嗣于靖国神社秋季例行大祭之际，前往靖国神社参拜，并以个人名义自费奉纳玉串料（祭祀供品费用）。秋季例行大祭于17日至19日举行。19日，跨党派议员联盟“大家一起参拜靖国神社的国会议员会”计划前往参拜。

日本时间17日晚，中国驻日使馆发表《驻日本使馆发言人就日方涉靖国神社消极动向答记者问》一文指出：中方强烈谴责日方涉靖国神社消极动向。日本二战时期发动对外侵略战争，犯下惨无人道罪行。所谓“靖国神社”是日本军国主义的精神工具和象征，供奉有对侵略战争负有直接罪责的14名甲级战犯。日本当政者对此顶礼膜拜，无论编造何种理由，都无法隐藏其为战犯翻案、掩盖战争罪责、歪曲历史事实，为加速“再军事化”铺路的真实企图。有关错误行径是对历史正义的亵渎，对文明底线的挑战，对战后国际秩序的挑衅，国际社会一致坚决反对。

韩国外交部17日就日本首相高市早苗在靖国神社秋季例大祭期间奉纳供品一事发表发言人评论。评论称：“对于日本负有责任的领导人再次向美化日本过去侵略战争、合祀战争罪犯的靖国神社奉纳供品或反复参拜一事，我们再次表示深切失望和遗憾。”评论还表示：“我们敦促日本负有责任的领导人正视历史，以实际行动展现对过去历史的谦虚反省和真诚悔悟。”评论强调：“这是构建以两国及两国人民之间的相互信任为基础、面向未来的韩日关系的重要基石。”

title: Chiang touts first-term results; Shen denies cash gift rumors - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 蒋宣扬第一任期的成果；沉否认送礼传闻 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月18日电 台北市市长蒋万安周日宣扬其政府的成就，而他的民进党竞争对手沈伯洋则承诺，如果在即将到来的市长竞选中当选，将保留台北市给老年人的礼金，有传言称他可能会废除这一政策。正在寻求连任国民党候选人的蒋介石在其松山区支持者协会的成立仪式上发表讲话时表示，自 2022 年 12 月上任以来，他通过改善交通基础设施、加强医疗保健服务和
content:
中新社台北10月18日电 台北市市长蒋万安周日宣扬其政府的成就，而他的民进党竞争对手沈伯洋则承诺，如果在即将到来的市长竞选中当选，将保留台北市给老年人的礼金，有传言称他可能会废除这一政策。

正在寻求连任国民党候选人的蒋介石在松山区支持者协会的成立仪式上发表讲话时表示，自 2022 年 12 月上任以来，他通过升级交通基础设施、加强医疗保健服务和吸引更多游客来促进当地商业发展，改善了松山区的状况。

他还表示，他最近宣布的降低城市更新计划资格门槛的政策将促进松山和台北各地老化建筑的重建。

蒋介石强调了他第一个任期内的关键儿童保育举措，包括将台北的儿童保育中心数量从上任前的四个增加到 45 个。他敦促选民再给他四年任期，以保持这座城市向前发展。

与此同时，周日晚上，沉在松山区和信义区举行了竞选车队，随后在民权公园举行了集会。

车队出发前，沉在信义区五分埔公园接受记者采访时表示，网上有传言称，如果他当选市长，他将取消台北市政府给老年人的礼金，这是不实的谣言。
这些礼物是在重阳节分发的，这是一个尊敬老人的传统节日。

沉表示，他会保留这些款项，但会努力让它们“更有意义、更有趣”。他引用其他国家的做法，建议在领取礼金时邀请长辈为年轻一代录制留言。

45 岁的台北居民 Sharlene Weng 是一名在五分埔公园参加活动的人，她在科技行业工作。她告诉中央社，她特别喜欢沉先生开发北投士林科技园的方法。

翁赞扬了沉对部分地下变电站为科技园供电的支持，称它可以比完全地下设施以更低的成本提供稳定的电力，同时纳入公共设施，例如为当地居民提供公园。

台湾定于11月28日举行的2026年地方选举也被称为“九合一”选举，因为该国22个市县的选民将选出九种地方政府职位的官员，包括市长、县长、市县议员。

其他竞选职位包括乡镇长、直辖市原住民区长、乡镇和原住民区议员、区长和村长。

此次选举总共将填补地方政府各级职位11,051个。

（叶志雄、黎阳）

Enditem/sfj

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 18 (CNA) Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) touted his administration's achievements on Sunday, while his Democratic Progressive Party rival, Puma Shen (沈伯洋), pledged to keep the city's cash gifts for senior citizens if elected in the upcoming mayoral race, amid rumors he might scrap the policy.

Speaking at the launch of his supporters' association in Songshan District, Chiang, who is seeking reelection as the Kuomintang candidate, said he had improved the district since taking office in December 2022 by upgrading transportation infrastructure, strengthening health care services and attracting more tourists to boost local businesses.

He also said his recently announced policy to lower the eligibility threshold for the city's urban renewal program would facilitate the redevelopment of aging buildings in Songshan and across Taipei.

Chiang highlighted key childcare initiatives from his first term, including increasing the number of childcare centers in Taipei from four before he took office to 45. He urged voters to give him another four-year term to keep the city moving forward.

Meanwhile, Shen held a campaign motorcade in Songshan and Xinyi districts on Sunday evening, followed by a rally at Minquan Park.

Speaking to reporters at Wufenpu Park in Xinyi District before the motorcade set off, Shen dismissed as false online rumors that he would cancel the Taipei City government's cash gifts for senior citizens if elected mayor.

The gifts are distributed for the Double Ninth Festival, a traditional holiday honoring the elderly.

Shen said he would keep the payments but seek to make them "more meaningful and interesting." Citing practices in other countries, he suggested inviting seniors to record messages for younger generations when collecting the cash gifts.

Among those attending the event at Wufenpu Park was Sharlene Weng, a 45-year-old Taipei resident who works in the technology sector. She told CNA she particularly liked Shen's approach to developing the Beitou-Shilin Technology Park.

Weng praised Shen's support for a partially underground substation to supply electricity to the technology park, saying it could provide stable power at a lower cost than a fully underground facility while incorporating public amenities, such as a park for local residents.

Taiwan's 2026 local elections, scheduled for Nov. 28, are also known as the "9-in-1" elections because voters in the country's 22 cities and counties will elect officials to nine types of local government posts, including city mayors, county magistrates, and city and county councilors.

Other positions up for election include township chiefs, chiefs of Indigenous districts in special municipalities, township and Indigenous district councilors, and borough and village chiefs.

In all, the elections will fill 11,051 posts at all levels of local government.

(By Joseph Yeh and Sunny Lai)

Enditem/sfj

title: Health minister decries bill subsidizing NHI premiums for most seniors - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 卫生部长谴责为大多数老年人提供国民健康保险保费补贴的法案 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月18日电 卫生部长石崇良警告说，新通过的立法全面补贴大多数老年人的国民健康保险(NHI)保费将增加年轻一代的经济负担。周五，来自反对党国民党和台湾人民党的立法机关以60票对39票通过了《老年人福利法》修正案。根据修正案，中央政府将被要求全额支付 65 岁及以上综合总收入需缴纳所得税的老年人的 NHI 保费
content:
中新社台北10月18日电 卫生部长石崇良警告说，新通过的立法全面补贴大多数老年人的国民健康保险(NHI)保费将增加年轻一代的经济负担。

周五，来自反对党国民党和台湾人民党的立法机关以60票对39票通过了《老年人福利法》修正案。

根据修正案，中央政府将被要求全额支付65岁及以上综合收入总额税率低于20%的老年人的国民健康保险费。

由于 20% 的税级仅适用于今年 133 万新台币（40,950 美元）以上的应税收入，据卫生部估计，多达 83% 的老年人符合资格。

施先生周六在接受记者采访时表示，台湾的医疗保健保费已经是世界上最低的。

施援引政府统计数据称，6岁及以下的儿童每年平均缴纳保费为新台币8,522元，但平均使用27,509点国民健康保险积分。每点的价值接近新台币 1 元，但不完全是新台币 1 元。

施说，65岁以上的人平均每年缴纳保费新台币9,912元，平均使用90,149个国民健康保险积分，是他们缴纳的保险费的九倍多。
施解释说，这些数据显示，幼儿和老年人在医疗保健服务上的使用量远多于他们支付的保费，而这一差异由工作年龄人口承担，他们生病的频率较低，平均支付的费用更高。

施说，在法案通过之前，政府已提议明年额外拨款600亿新台币，以支持国民健康保险体系。

卫生福利部在周日的一份声明中表示，按照目前的水平，每年的补贴费用约为新台币 400 亿元。该部表示，尽管保费收入因劳动力减少而下降，但随着人口老龄化，成本将会上升。

## NHI 积分解释

根据台湾国民健康保险“全球预算支付体系”，政府为每个医疗保健部门设定了固定的年度支出上限。

当医疗保健提供者提供服务时，他们会索要一定数量的 NHI“积分”，其货币价值会波动。

若医疗服务使用率较高，且所领取积分超过当期预算拨款，则积分价值低于新台币1元，医疗机构须吸收较低报销率。

近年来，每季度1点国民健康保险值在医院0.90元至1元之间波动，诊所在0.86元至1元之间波动，各地区存在差异。

（沈培尧、陈杰令、马修·马泽塔）

Enditem/sfj

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 18 (CNA) Health Minister Shih Chung-liang (石崇良) has warned that newly passed legislation fully subsidizing National Health Insurance (NHI) premiums for most seniors would increase the financial burden on younger generations.

The amendments to the Senior Citizens Welfare Act were passed 60-39 in the Legislature on Friday by lawmakers from the opposition Kuomintang (KMT) and Taiwan People's Party (TPP).

Under the amendments, the central government would be required to fully cover NHI premiums for people aged 65 and older whose total consolidated income is subject to an income tax rate below 20 percent.

Because the 20 percent tax bracket applies only to taxable income above NT$1.33 million (US$40,950) this year, as many as 83 percent of seniors would qualify, according to a health ministry estimate.

Speaking to reporters on Saturday, Shih said Taiwan already has some of the world's lowest health care premiums.

Citing government statistics, Shih said children aged 6 and younger pay an average of NT$8,522 a year in premiums but use an average of 27,509 NHI points. Each point is worth close to, but not exactly, NT$1.

People aged 65 and older pay an average of NT$9,912 a year in premiums and use an average of 90,149 NHI points, or over nine times what they pay in, Shih said.

The figures show that young children and seniors use far more in health care services than they pay in premiums, with the difference borne by the working-age population, who get sick less often and pay more on average, Shih explained.

Shih said that even before the bill was passed, the government had proposed allocating an additional NT$60 billion next year to shore up the NHI system.

In a statement on Sunday, the Ministry of Health and Welfare said the subsidies would cost about NT$40 billion a year at current levels. The cost would rise as the population ages, even as premium income falls because of a shrinking workforce, the ministry said.

## NHI points explained

Under Taiwan's NHI "global budget payment system," the government sets a fixed annual spending cap for each health care sector.

When health care providers deliver services, they claim a set number of NHI "points," whose monetary value fluctuates.

If use of medical services is high and the points claimed exceed the budget allocation for that period, the value of a point falls below NT$1, and medical institutions must absorb the lower reimbursement rate.

In recent years, the quarterly value of 1 NHI point has fluctuated between NT$0.90 and NT$1 for hospitals and NT$0.86 and NT$1 for clinics, with variations by region.

(By Shen Pei-yao, Chen Chieh-ling and Matthew Mazzetta)

Enditem/sfj

# BASEBALL/Zeng Sheng-an's three-run homer gives Dragons 2-0 lead in Taiwan Series

10/18/2026 08:18 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

Wei Chuan Dragons outfielder Zeng Sheng-an. CNA photo Oct. 18, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 18 (CNA) Wei Chuan Dragons outfielder Zeng Sheng-an (曾聖安) hit a three-run homer to power his team to a 3-1 win over the CTBC Brothers at Taipei Dome on Sunday, giving the Dragons a 2-0 lead in the Chinese Professional Baseball League's (CPBL) Taiwan Series.

With the Dragons trailing 1-0 in the bottom of the fifth inning, the 20-year-old Zeng, who joined the team last season and was making his Taiwan Series debut, drove a fastball from Brothers starter Félix Peña over the right-field wall.

Zeng became the second-youngest player in CPBL history to hit a home run in the Taiwan Series.

The homer came after he committed a fielding error in the top of the inning that ultimately allowed the Brothers to take a 1-0 lead.

In a post-game interview, Zeng said that after making a mistake in the top of the inning, his coaches and veteran teammates told him to put it behind him and focus on what he could do next to help the team. He was glad he was able to bounce back in his next at-bat, he said.

Dragons player Tseng Sheng-an hits a three-run homer in the bottom of the fifth inning to put his team ahead, sending fans cheering excitedly from the stands. CNA photo Oct. 18,2026

Peña was later pulled from the mound in the same inning after being hit by a batted ball. He gave up four hits and three walks and struck out three batters over 4.2 innings.

Dragons starter Cristopher Mercedes pitched six innings, allowing one run on five hits and a walk, while striking out three.

The Dragons' second straight win puts them in a strong position to claim their sixth CPBL championship.

In the CPBL's 37-year history, teams that have taken a 2-0 lead in a best-of-seven championship series have gone on to win the title 89.5 percent of the time.

After a day off Monday, the teams will meet again at Taipei Dome on Tuesday for Game 3.

title: 悉尼号返回澳大利亚，结束为期 131 天的印太部署
source: 澳洲唐人街 – Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻
summary: 在海上航行 131 天后，HMAS Sydney 号返回澳大利亚，结束了此次在印太地区与关键盟友并肩参与该地区最大规模海军演习的重大部署。 这艘导弹驱逐舰于周日返回东舰队基地，船员和军官们在一次跨越数千海里的任务结束后与家人和朋友团聚，突显了澳大利亚对地区安全和防务关系的重视。 HMAS Sydney 返回东舰队基地，结束了在印太地区航行的 131 天。图片来源：供稿 在部署期间，HMAS Sydney 号与包括美国、日本、加拿大、新西兰、韩国、西班牙、智利、意大利和印度尼西
content: 在海上航行 131 天后，HMAS Sydney 号返回澳大利亚，结束了此次在印太地区与关键盟友并肩参与该地区最大规模海军演习的重大部署。 这艘导弹驱逐舰于周日返回东舰队基地，船员和军官们在一次跨越数千海里的任务结束后与家人和朋友团聚，突显了澳大利亚对地区安全和防务关系的重视。 HMAS Sydney 返回东舰队基地，结束了在印太地区航行的 131 天。图片来源：供稿 在部署期间，HMAS Sydney 号与包括美国、日本、加拿大、新西兰、韩国、西班牙、智利、意大利和印度尼西亚在内的众多伙伴国家合作。 其计划包括重大多国演习，如环太平洋演习（RIMPAC），以及太平洋龙、太平洋先锋和七国三叉戟演习。 这些行动涵盖了从空天防御到复杂海上战斗训练等各个方面，同时加强了与印太地区其他海军的协调合作。 部署期间，该舰与印太地区的盟友和伙伴国家进行了重大多国演习。图片来源：供稿 舰队指挥官雷纳·威廉姆斯少将表示，此次部署是澳大利亚更广泛地区合作的重要组成部分。 “HMAS Sydney 号的部署展示了澳大利亚持续致力于与地区伙伴合作，以支持一个安全、稳定和繁荣的印太地区，”威廉姆斯少将表示。 她还表示，该舰的船员与地区内的盟友和伙伴紧密合作，加强了专业联系，同时也展示了海军支持集体海上安全的能力。 在完成国际演习日程后，HMAS Sydney 号与中国南海的 HMAS Stuart 号会合，开展进一步的地区存在活动。 该舰与来自美国、日本、加拿大、新西兰和其他几个国家的海军并肩工作。图片来源：供稿 该驱逐舰还按照国际法执行任务，同时维持了长期且艰巨的后勤努力，以确保持续在海上航行数月。 在整个部署期间，Sydney 号完成了 17 次海上补给，包括两次直升机补给任务，装载了燃料、食物和其他物资，以确保持船在远离家乡的地方运行。 指挥官海登·詹金斯上校强调了与其他国家进行训练的价值。 “与我们的地区伙伴并肩行动提供了宝贵的机会，以加强关系，提升专业技能，并进一步发展我们在海上协同工作的能力，”詹金斯上校表示。 周日船只回家时，船员和军官与家人和朋友团聚。图片来源：供稿 他还提到了 Sydney 号在高端战斗演习中的作用，包括一次成功的海军攻击导弹发射，以及在 RIMPAC 演习期间，该舰搭载的 MH-60R 海鹰直升机对 Hellfire 导弹的拦截。 “我非常自豪我们的船员和军官在整个部署期间展现了专业性、团队合作和奉献精神，”詹金斯上校表示。

title: Hong Kong leader hails Girl Guides carnival as 110th anniversary events roll on
zh_title: 香港领导人赞扬女童军嘉年华，庆祝 110 周年活动如火如荼地进行
summary: 香港 在西九龙为期两天的“Chill Fun WestK嘉年华”开幕式上，文化体育及旅游局局长赞扬女童军总会110年的传承。该活动有 4,000 名会员、主题区和即将举行的活动，包括 12 月的国际营。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 主编 [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 2026 年 10 月 18 日香港时间 15:25 · 2 分钟阅读文化、体育及旅游，杨子豪先生，10月2日18日
content:
香港
在西九龙为期两天的“Chill Fun WestK嘉年华”开幕式上，文化体育及旅游局局长赞扬女童军总会110年的传承。该活动有 4,000 名会员、主题区和即将举行的活动，包括 12 月的国际营。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 18 日 15:25 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

文化体育及旅游局局长杨润雄于2026年10月18日出席香港女童军总会举办的为期两天的「Chill Fun WestK嘉年华」开幕礼，庆祝该会成立110周年。杨先生在WestK艺术公园发表讲话时指出，该场地融合了自然景观、海港景观和文化氛围，称其为此次活动的“城市绿洲”。

嘉年华汇聚了近 4,000 名女童军和青年制服团体成员，以及许多公众游客。场地分为三个主题区：尝试新兴运动的冒险区、以舞台表演为特色的休闲区以及提供文化活动的艺术区。游戏摊位介绍香港各区的特色，旨在让参与者与城市建立联系。
杨先生感谢协会领导和会员的努力，并赞扬女孩们在组织活动、经营摊位和表演方面的能力。他赞同该协会主席梁贝蒂女士强调新时代女性的“非凡”才能。

国务卿还概述了周年纪念计划中即将举行的活动。 7月至8月举办暑期三峡交流游，让导游领略三峡自然风光和文化遗产。协会将于12月下旬在启德青年旅舍举办“宇宙之灵·女性之旅”国际营，参与者将探讨香港的怀旧游戏、非物质文化遗产和全球问题。

杨先生表示，这些活动将教育与体验结合起来，帮助年轻人了解国家发展、拓宽国际视野。他表示，这符合香港作为中外文化交流枢纽的地位、国家“十五五”规划青年发展战略和香港第一个五年规划目标。

杨先生将女童军描述为香港最大的女性青少年制服团体，并赞扬其 110 年来培养负责任领导人的记录。他感谢协会为社区带来欢乐，为城市带来活力，预祝嘉年华圆满成功，同时鼓励年轻人继续服务社会。
[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)
