title: Taiwan lawmakers pass health insurance premium subsidies for seniors - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 台湾“立法院”通过老年人健康保险保费补贴 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月16日电 距离地方选举仅剩六周，反对党议员周五通过一项法律修正案，要求中央政府全额补贴某些老年人的国民健康保险(NHI)保费。国民党、台湾人民党议员提出《老人福利法》第22条修正案，以60票对39票通过，在野党联手通过修改议案。
content:
中新社台北10月16日电 距离地方选举仅剩六周，反对党议员周五通过一项法律修正案，要求中央政府全额补贴某些老年人的国民健康保险(NHI)保费。

国民党、台湾人民党议员提出的《老人福利法》第22条修正案，以60票对39票通过，在野党议员联手通过修改议案

根据修正案，中央政府必须为经税务机关评估的最近一年综合收入低于纳税申报起征点或所得税税率低于20%的老年人全额支付国民健康保险费。

根据财政部今年累进所得税级数，合并净收入新台币138万元以下，适用20%以下税率。这意味着年净收入在该门槛以内的 65 岁及以上老年人将有资格获得补贴。

TPP核心小组表示，该政策兑现了其创始主席柯文哲在2024年总统竞选期间做出的竞选承诺，即为65岁及以上人群提供全面的国民健康保险保费补贴。
该党补充说，柯在担任台北市长期间推出了老年人健保保险费补贴，覆盖65岁以上居民以及55岁以上原住民居民。后来其他几个地方政府也采取了类似的政策，但一些财政紧张、老年人口较多的市县无力承担。

然而，卫生部长石崇良对修正案表示担忧，称其背离了国民健康保险制度基于支付能力的缴费原则，可能会损害其长期可持续性。

“选举是暂时的，但国民健康保险制度是人们所依赖的，需要稳定和可持续，”施周五下午在麦偕纪念医院参加新书发布会之前告诉记者。

施警告说，违反基于支付能力的缴款原则可能会导致进一步的措施扰乱系统的运行。

他表示，这一变化可能会造成代际不公平，导致保费上涨，限制国民健康保险总体预算的增长，加剧医疗机构面临的困难，或者要求政府将更多税收分配给健康保险，而牺牲其他福利项目。
台湾已成为超老龄社会，65岁以上人口占总人口五分之一。施说，这一群体已占国民健康保险支出的42%以上，而长期护理的年度经费已从2015年的不足新台币50亿元增加到今年的超过新台币1,100亿元。

TPP核心小组估计，按照每名老年人每月826元的补贴计算，该修正案将使政府年度支出增加近390亿元新台币。

与此同时，施警告称，随着台湾人口老龄化，财政负担将会增加，最终的财政影响可能超出最初的估计，并威胁到医疗保险体系的可持续性。

曾怡宁、沈培耀、许伟霆、林肖恩撰）

结局/AW

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 16 (CNA) With only six weeks remaining until local elections, opposition lawmakers on Friday passed a legal amendment requiring the central government to fully subsidize National Health Insurance (NHI) premiums for certain seniors.

The amendment to Article 22 of the Senior Citizens Welfare Act, proposed by lawmakers from the opposition Kuomintang (KMT) and Taiwan People's Party (TPP), passed by a vote of 60 to 39, with lawmakers from the opposition parties joining forces to approve a revised motion

Under the amendment, the central government must cover the full NHI premiums of seniors whose total consolidated income in the most recent year, as assessed by tax authorities, falls below the tax filing threshold or is subject to an income tax rate below 20 percent.

According to the Ministry of Finance's progressive income tax brackets for this year, net consolidated income of NT$1.38 million or less is taxed at a rate below 20 percent. This means seniors aged 65 and older with annual net income within that threshold will qualify for the subsidy.

The TPP caucus said the policy fulfilled a campaign pledge made by its founding chairman Ko Wen-je (柯文哲) during his 2024 presidential campaign to provide comprehensive NHI premium subsidies for people aged 65 and older.

The party added that Ko introduced subsidies for seniors' NHI premiums when he was Taipei mayor, covering residents aged 65 and older as well as Indigenous residents aged 55 and older. Several other local governments later adopted similar policies, but some financially strained cities and counties with large elderly populations were unable to afford them.

However, Health Minister Shih Chung-liang (石崇良) expressed concern about the amendment, saying it departed from the NHI system's principle of contributions based on ability to pay and could undermine its long-term sustainability.

"An election is temporary, but the NHI system is something people rely on and needs to be stable and sustainable," Shih told reporters before attending a book launch at Mackay Memorial Hospital on Friday afternoon.

Shih warned that breaking the principle of contributions based on ability to pay could lead to further measures that disrupt the system's operation.

He said the change could create intergenerational unfairness and prompt increases in premiums, limit growth in the overall NHI budget and exacerbate the difficulties faced by medical institutions, or require the government to allocate more tax revenue to health insurance at the expense of other welfare programs.

Taiwan has become a super-aged society, with people aged 65 and older accounting for one-fifth of the population. Shih said this group already accounts for more than 42 percent of NHI spending, while annual funding for long-term care has risen from less than NT$5 billion in 2015 to more than NT$110 billion this year.

The TPP caucus estimated that the amendment would add nearly NT$39 billion in annual government spending, based on a monthly subsidy of NT$826 per senior.

Meanwhile, Shih cautioned that the financial burden would grow as Taiwan's population ages, saying the eventual fiscal impact could exceed initial estimates and threaten the sustainability of the health insurance system.

By Tseng Yi-ning, Shen Pei-yao, Hsu Wei-ting and Sean Lin）

Enditem/AW

title: Chinese exchange student deported over video showing him 'pinching Lai' - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 中国交换生因“捏赖”视频被驱逐出境 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月16日电 一名中国交换生周五因发布一段视频而被驱逐出境，该视频似乎显示他用手指捏着赖清德总统，并发表了“抓住了小赖清德”的评论。据国家移民管理局发布的照片​​显示，这名王姓学生是在台湾大学进行交流项目的，在离开台湾之前由国家移民管理局官员护送至海关。 “王某的行为导致他的入境许可被吊销并被驱逐出境。他还将被禁止进入台湾5年
content:
中新社台北10月16日电 一名中国交换生周五因发布一段视频而被驱逐出境，该视频似乎显示他用手指捏着赖清德总统，并发表了“抓住了小赖清德”的评论。

据国家移民管理局发布的照片​​显示，这名王姓学生是在台湾大学进行交流项目的，在离开台湾之前由国家移民管理局官员护送至海关。

国家移民局在一份新闻稿中表示，“王的行为导致他的入境许可被吊销并被驱逐出境。他还将被禁止进入台湾五年”。

国家移民局表示，这一决定是根据《大陆地区人民进入台湾地区管理办法》第十二条规定，其中列出了驱逐出境的理由，包括“违反平等和尊严原则的行为”。

根据当地媒体获得的一段视频，王似乎在南洋理工大学礼堂拍摄了黎智英周一在一次有关人才发展的活动上发表讲话的画面，看起来王似乎在用手指捏着赖以生存。

帖子的标题是：“赖清德就在你面前，这会是你一生中唯一的机会吗？”以及标签#两岸统一、#反对台独、#愿台湾早日回归祖国。

据当地媒体报道，他还在评论中写道“得到了小赖清德”。
随后，王某在抖音上删除了该帖子，并在网上引起批评后发表道歉，但该事件已引起公众关注。

王在声明中表示，在阅读这些评论并进行反思后，他意识到该帖子的不当之处。他表示，他愿意接受批评和建议，并向受影响的人表示诚挚的歉意。

据《联合报》报道，国家移民局在与教育部和陆委会协商后，于周四晚间获悉该学生被驱逐出境的决定。

## 南洋理工大学回应

针对此案，南洋理工大学周五表示，该学生在接受当局讯问时，南洋理工大学一直陪伴在他身边，并为他提供了帮助。

南洋理工大学表示，尊重政府执行相关规定，并继续致力于言论自由和开放、多元化和尊重的校园。

南洋理工大学表示，希望这一事件能够帮助学生更好地理解，行使言论自由也应该包括尊重他人。

## 另一种观点

下午4点，海基会秘书长罗文嘉在宣布王某被驱逐出境之前表示，如果王某想留在台湾完成交换计划，“我认为我们应该尊重他的选择”。
“这也可能是了解台湾的一个教训，”他在下午 3 点的例行新闻发布会上说。当被要求对此案发表评论时。他补充说，海基会不负责或参与与其他当局就该案进行的讨论。

被驱逐出境后，罗表示尊重当局的决定，希望此案不会影响中国学生赴台交流。

（刘建邦、陈志忠、李亚文、石修全）

结局/AW

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 16 (CNA) A Chinese exchange student was deported on Friday after posting a video that appeared to show him pinching President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) between his fingers, with comments including "Got the little Lai Ching-te."

The student surnamed Wang (王), who was on an exchange program at National Taiwan University (NTU), was escorted by National Immigration Agency (NIA) officials to customs before leaving Taiwan, according to photos released by the NIA.

"Wang's behavior resulted in the revocation of his entry permit and deportation. He will also be barred from entering Taiwan for five years," the NIA said in a news release.

The NIA said the decision was based on Article 12 of the Regulations Governing Permission for People of the Mainland Area to Enter the Taiwan Area, which lists grounds for deportation, including "conduct that violates the principles of equality and dignity."

According to a video obtained by local media, Wang appeared to film Lai from an NTU hall where Lai spoke at an event about talent development Monday, making it look as though Wang was pinching Lai between his fingers.

The post carried the caption: "Lai Ching-te is right in front of you. Could this be the only chance in your lifetime?" and hashtags #Cross-strait unification, #Oppose Taiwan independence, and #May Taiwan soon return to the motherland.

He also wrote "Got the little Lai Ching-te" in the comments, local media reported.

Wang later deleted the post from Douyin and issued an apology after it drew criticism online, but the incident had already attracted public attention.

In the statement, Wang said he realized the post was inappropriate after reading the comments and reflecting on them. He said he was open to criticism and suggestions and sincerely apologized to those affected.

According to a report by the United Daily News, the student was informed of the deportation Thursday night after the NIA consulted with the Ministry of Education and the Mainland Affairs Council before making the decision.

## NTU response

In response to the case, NTU said Friday it had accompanied the student when he was questioned by authorities and providing him with assistance.

NTU said it respected the government's enforcement of relevant rules and remained committed to freedom of expression and an open, diverse and respectful campus.

It hoped that the incident would help students better understand that exercising free speech should also involve respecting others, NTU said.

## Another view

Before Wang's deportation was announced at 4 p.m., Strait Exchange Foundation (SEF) Secretary-General Luo Wen-jia (羅文嘉) said if the student wished to remain in Taiwan and complete his exchange program, "I think we should respect his choice."

"This could also be a lesson in understanding Taiwan," he told a regular news briefing at 3 p.m. when asked to comment on the case. He added that the SEF was not responsible for or involved in discussions with other authorities regarding the case.

After the deportation, Luo said he respected the authorities' decision and hoped the case would not affect the exchange of Chinese students to Taiwan.

(By Liu Chien-bang, Chen Chih-chung, Lee Ya-wen, and Shih Hsiu-chuan)

Enditem/AW

*   What to expect in the weeks and months ahead as economic conditions evolve.
*   How the economic numbers are impacting those in the San Francisco Bay Area and the technology industry!
*   How Trump's recent policies are affecting the job market and economy.
*   Other notable trends moving the market, including bonds, housing prices, quit rates, and more!
*   And much more!

Join us with your questions, comments, and concerns.

ABOUT DR. REILLY S. WHITE, PhD
 Dr. White is the Associate Dean of Teaching and Learning and an Associate Professor of Finance with tenure at the University of New Mexico. Dr. White also serves on the board of the CFA Society of New Mexico, advisor for the $4.7 Million student-run UNM Regent’s Portfolio, and leads a series of financial literacy projects in the community. Prior to his career in academia, Dr. White worked as an analyst for a large Boston-based bank, where he learned a great deal about company analysis, funding, and maintaining ethical corporate leadership. He has consulted with investment managers and municipalities on maintaining optimal portfolio strategies, particularly in response to economic challenges. Dr. White was also awarded the 2022 Paul Bartlett Ré Emerging Promotor of Peace Award and serves on the of board Voz Collegiate Preparatory School.

In addition to his PhD from the University of Connecticut, Dr. White graduated summa cum laude from the University of Massachusetts-Dartmouth with a degree in Finance. Dr. White has published nineteen articles in finance and financial technology in the last few years, including articles in Physica A, Journal of Corporate Finance, IEEE, Technological Forecasting and Social Change, and the Journal of Banking and Finance. With his students, he co-authored Financial Literacy for Immigrants and Refugees, a free financial literacy handbook that has been translated into Spanish, Arabic, and Dari. Since 2020, Dr. White has been interviewed over 150 times by local and national media outlets on various economic and finance topics.

Visit his website at [https://www.reillywhite.com/](https://www.reillywhite.com/).

Elections depend not only on counting votes, but also on people having enough confidence in the process to accept the results. Yet people across the political spectrum may have very different ideas about what makes an election trustworthy, fair, or legitimate.

At this meeting, we’ll explore where our confidence—or lack of confidence—in elections comes from and what experiences have shaped it.

We’ll ask questions such as:

• When you think about an election you trusted, what helped you feel confident that the process worked as it should?
 • Have you ever encountered something that made you question how fair or reliable an election was? What concerned you?
 • When people you respect have very different levels of trust in an election than you do, how do you make sense of that difference?
 • What would you personally need to see or know to have confidence in an election won by a candidate you strongly opposed?

This will be an opportunity to explore what shapes our trust in elections and better understand why people can look at the same election process and come away with very different levels of confidence.

summary: ## Details Day-to-Day Operations That Protect You - Rent Collection, Entry Rights, Communication & Bulletproof Documentation The middle of a tenancy is where most landlords get casual—and where small mistakes turn into big problems. Late fe
content:
## Details

Day-to-Day Operations That Protect You - Rent Collection, Entry Rights, Communication & Bulletproof Documentation
 The middle of a tenancy is where most landlords get casual—and where small mistakes turn into big problems. Late fees charged the wrong way, rent increases without proper notice, entries that violate ORS 90.322, and conversations that only happened verbally all become exhibits later.
 This class covers the daily systems that keep you protected: collecting rent and handling partial payments, the 4-day grace period and late-fee rules, statewide rent-increase notice and the current maximum percentage, local overlays, written communication habits, and the right of entry versus tenant privacy. We’ll also cover insurance basics and the record-keeping practices that win credibility fights in court or a fair-housing investigation.
 If you want fewer fires and stronger documentation when something does go wrong, this is the class that builds those habits.
 Where? Virtual Webinar - The links to join the webinar and to download the class materials will be sent out in the reminder email 30 minutes before the class starts.
 Presenter? Christian Bryant – President of North West Real Estate & Property Management ([www.NWRPM.com](http://www.nwrpm.com/)), RPM Landlord Education ([www.RPMEducation.org](http://www.rpmeducation.org/)), Portland Area Rental Owners Association ([www.PAROA.org](http://www.paroa.org/)), and NW Real Estate Investors Association ([www.NorthWestREIA.com](http://www.northwestreia.com/)).

 There will be scheduled Q&A breaks during the class, but if we can't get to your questions during class we always stick around to answer questions for up to 15 minutes after the class ends.

content:
**REGISTER ON OUR WEBSITE to attend this Zoom event:**
**[https://psychedelicadvocacy.org/event/meditation-on-death-letting-go/](https://psychedelicadvocacy.org/event/meditation-on-death-letting-go/)**
**After you register, you will receive a confirmation email with information and a link to join the meeting.**

Join Julia and Bill for a 25-minute guided Death Meditation, a gentle and meaningful practice of letting go that invites us to explore our relationship with death—and, in doing so, discover a deeper appreciation for the life we are living now.

**The meditation will be followed by an open Q&A and conversation.**

Rather than approaching death as something to fear or avoid, this practice uses imagination and contemplation to explore the process of letting go—of our relationships, surroundings, bodies, senses, and ultimately the identities we have constructed throughout our lives.

For those who have had profound psychedelic experiences, this territory may feel familiar. Psychedelics can sometimes bring experiences of ego dissolution, loss of a familiar sense of identity, or a feeling of egolessness.

The Death Meditation offers another contemplative way of exploring what it can mean to loosen our attachment to who we believe ourselves to be—and to meet that letting go with curiosity and openness.
 Drawing inspiration from Buddhist teachings on mortality and impermanence, as well as traditions of symbolic death, transformation, and rebirth found across cultures, the meditation invites us to deepen our appreciation for the preciousness and fragility of life.

The intention is to cultivate presence, appreciation, acceptance, and openness. By contemplating death and the letting go of identity, we may discover a renewed capacity to be more fully present for the life we are living now.

**Facilitators:**
**Julia Star** has been working with psychedelic-assisted therapy for over thirty years. She finds the model of finding answers to life's challenges through the plant medicines to be the most effective and heart-opening path towards personal freedom.

**Bill Wagg** has practiced Buddhism for nearly 50 years, a path that has taken him from Tibetan monasteries in India to decades of study, retreat, and meditation. He spent 18 months studying at a Tibetan monastery under the esteemed Kalu Rinpoche, along with six months making pilgrimages to Bodhgaya and other important Buddhist sites throughout India.

end of list
North Korean Premier Pak Thae-song expressed his belief that the crossing would “accelerate the advance for the prosperity of the two countries” and “add fresh vigour” to their economic cooperation.

Analysts on China-North Korea ties are much more circumspect.

While the bridge is a concrete symbol of China and North Korea’s efforts to revitalise relations that have waned from their Cold War-era peak, the prospects for trade are hindered by obstacles ranging from international sanctions to a North Korean leadership that prioritises security above all else, experts say.

“It reflects China’s renewed effort to strengthen its relationship with North Korea at a time of changing regional alignments,” Phillip Park, a professor at the University of North Korean Studies in Seoul, South Korea, told Al Jazeera.

“But whether this leads to substantially deeper economic integration, greater North Korean dependence, or a significant shift in Pyongyang’s strategic orientation remains an open question.

“The bridge could facilitate trade and logistics, but it does not remove international sanctions,” Park added.

A Chinese maritime patrol vessel travels along the Yalu River as trucks adorned with Chinese flags cross the newly opened New Yalu River Bridge into North Korea’s Sinuiju from China’s Dandong New Zone, as seen from Dandong, Liaoning province, China, on October 15, 2026 [Florence Lo/Reuters]

China, whose troops fought alongside Pyongyang in the 1950-53 Korean War, has long been North Korea’s most crucial economic benefactor.

China accounts for as much as 95 percent of official trade with the secretive country, which is among the world’s most diplomatically and economically isolated states.

Get instant alerts and updates based on your interests. Be the first to know when big stories happen.

Before the four-lane New Yalu River Bridge officially opened on Thursday, road and rail freight between Dandong and Sinuiju, the main route for China-North Korea trade, travelled exclusively via the ageing Sino-Korean Friendship Bridge.

Opened in 1943, the bridge, which has a single-lane road and a rail track, can only carry vehicles weighing a maximum of 20 tonnes.

Jae-woo Joo, a professor of Chinese foreign policy at Kyung Hee University in Seoul, said the new bridge could “tremendously” boost trade between the sides, including the transfer of components banned under sanctions against Pyongyang’s nuclear and missile programmes.

“It is therefore really significant to open this bridge with China,” Joo told Al Jazeera.

After coming under strain from North Korea’s nuclear weapons tests in the mid-2000s, Beijing-Pyongyang ties have warmed under Chinese President Xi Jinping and North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

At Xi and Kim’s most recent meeting in June, their seventh summit since 2018, the leaders pledged to enhance cooperation in areas spanning trade, defence, agriculture, law, science and technology.

Analysts have, in part, cast Beijing’s deepening engagement with Pyongyang as a response to the latter’s growing ties with Moscow, which have included the deployment of thousands of North Korean troops to the front lines of Russia’s war in Ukraine.

Last month, North Korean and Russian officials opened the first road bridge linking their countries across the Tumen River.

Chinese President Xi Jinping walks with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, right, to a reception following a military parade to commemorate the 80th anniversary of Japan’s World War II surrender held in front of Tiananmen Gate in Beijing, China, on September 3, 2025 [Mahesh Kumar/AP]

North Korea and China’s two-way trade grew 25 percent in 2025 to reach $2.74bn, according to figures from China’s General Administration of Customs.

Bilateral trade has continued to grow in 2026, jumping nearly 20 percent to reach $1.5bn in the first half of the year, putting it on track to reach its highest volumes since the COVID-19 pandemic.

But while growing, trade remains relatively minuscule in the context of global commerce.

With China’s overall trade hitting $6.36 trillion in 2025, North Korea’s contribution to the total was a little more than 0.04 percent.

Official trade between the neighbours also remains substantially below its 2010s heyday.

Trade hovered around $5-6bn throughout much of the decade, peaking at $6.45bn in 2013.

Economists have offered explanations for the slowdown that range from tightened sanctions to China’s waning reliance on imports amid its efforts to boost economic self-reliance.

Christopher Green, a senior consultant for the Korean Peninsula at International Crisis Group, said the new border crossing’s significance should not be overstated, considering that China-North Korea trade “is fundamentally driven by politics”.

“Lack of cross-border transit routes is not the main obstacle,” Green told Al Jazeera.

“If the bridge opening signifies a political desire on both sides to give political cover to rising trade volumes, then a boost to trade should follow,” Green said, describing ties up until now as “steady-as-she-goes” economic engagement.

“Time will tell. But the key is the politics of national security, not economics.”

Vehicles drive through a new bridge linking China and North Korea as it opened in North Phyongan province, North Korea, on October 15, 2026 [Cha Song Ho/AP]

As much as officials have hailed the New Yalu River Bridge as a reflection of Chinese-North Korean cooperation, the project had a long and torturous road to completion.

Construction began in 2011 and was finished on the Chinese side in 2014.

But North Korean authorities only completed roads and customs facilities on their side of the river this year following repeated pauses in construction amid tensions with Beijing.

“The 12-year delay certainly suggests that economic cooperation is more conditional than the language of friendship might imply,” Marco Mari, a PhD researcher at Bocconi University in Italy who studies China-North Korea economic ties, told Al Jazeera.

“The bridge can facilitate supplies and economic activity, while Russian support gives North Korea alternatives that diminish Beijing’s leverage,” Mari added.

“This does not necessarily imply broader economic reform or a comparable improvement in ordinary people’s lives.”

Chinese Premier Li Qiang, on screen, makes a speech through video conference as a new bridge linking China and North Korea opens in North Phyongan province, North Korea, Thursday, October 15, 2026 [Jon Chol Jin/AP]

Weiqi Zhang, an associate professor at Suffolk University who studies relations between North Korea and China, said the history of China-North Korea economic ties is littered with abortive projects, such as the Hwanggumpyong Special Economic Zone, a North Korean-Chinese development near Dandong.

“There were cases, like the Hwanggumpyong Special Economic Zone – established by China and North Korea – where China built infrastructure on its side, but North Korea didn’t even pave the road on their side,” Zhang told Al Jazeera.

“One reason is that, unlike its neighbours, North Korean government doesn’t really pay much attention to trade for economic development,” Zhang said.

“International trade is used by North Korea more like a foreign policy tool.”

With China wishing to demonstrate its “indispensability” as a trade partner and North Korea eager to strengthen their economic ties, trade is likely to grow, said Edward Howell, a lecturer in international Relations at the University of Oxford.

Even so, economic engagement will be subject to political considerations, Howell said.

“North Korea will obviously want to avoid facing any Chinese influence to change its economic model, but Pyongyang will want to reap the economic benefits of trade with its principal economic benefactor,” Howell told Al Jazeera.

**台湾 取消“社保等级制”的艰辛历程**

来源：https://qitongshe.com/article/5630427278639081

编者按：近日，中国官方表示要动员未参保人员加入社保体系，做到“应保尽保”，社保再次成为热议话题。本篇简略讲述了台湾国民年金的改革历程，或可为中国未来的社保改革提供某种参考。

**台湾“社保”，其正式名称叫：国民年金。**

台湾年金制度是一个非常复杂的系统，具体包括军人保险、军人退抚、公教人员保险(公务员、公私校教职员)、公务人员退休、学者教职员退休、私校退抚、政务人员退职、法官退养金、劳工保险、劳工退休、民众年金、老农津贴、农民健康保险等13种制度。

当时的年金制度确实对军公教群体有利，特别是18%的优惠存款利率，让军公教群体在退休后每月可以领取丰厚的退休金并享受较好的福利。这在岛内年轻人失业率颇高，工资水平连年未涨的背景下，确实显得十分“扎眼”。

可见的忧患就是：**按当时费率与给付水平，各行年金制度正面临收支失衡，且随着财政不断恶化，迟早要破产。**

首先要说的是，在马英九执政初期，台湾“社保”资金不足的压力就越来越大，到了2014年，台湾的退抚基金收支出现逆转，有人甚至预估10年后将会破产。

**年金改革势在必行，这也得到岛内主流民意认同。**

之前，历届台湾当局也曾对军公教群体的福利进行过改革，马英九当局于2012年直接取消了军公教的年终慰问金，引发该群体的强烈不满，而军公教群体政治意识形态普遍偏蓝，是国民党的“铁票仓”，这导致国民党在2014年的“九合一选举”中遭遇惨败。

长期以来，军公教群体一直被视为国民党坚定支持者、蓝营“铁票”，且迄今仍是“忠贞”国民党员的集结地。**国民党要改革当时的年金制度，必须刀口向内动基本盘**，也注定其年金改革必然成为短命动作。

**蔡英文上任之前，台湾这种长期实行的三六九等的社会保障制度，已经饱受诟病！**

公务员、军人、教师的社保待遇位于最高层，甩工农民众八条街。一直以来，实行退休金双轨制，吃皇粮人群的退休金是普通工人农民的3到5倍。

劳工与公务员同样工作30年，劳工退休后只能月领2.5万元左右，而公务员每月可以领到6万元，另外还有一笔一次领取的124万元公保养老金，由此不难看出劳工与军公教人員退休所得存在天壤之别。

台湾中底层民众怨声载道，苦不堪言，而国民党利益集团成员却享受着高高在上的特权，吃香喝辣，骄奢贪腐，因此台湾省内社会矛盾日益扩大，社会动荡不安！

**2016年蔡英文上任之后随即着手拆除不合理的等级制，大胆触动利益集团的蛋糕，发起“年金制度改革”。**

蔡英文任命陈建仁为年金改革委员会召集人、民进党智囊林万亿为副召集人兼执行长，全面推动改革事宜。他们接连召开20次年金改革座谈会;于当年12月31日和次年1月7日、8日、14日分别召开北中南东四区分场会议。按计划，行政机构与“考试院”要于5月20日前完成相关改革方案，提交给立法机构审议。

军公教群体成为此次改革的焦点，主要包括：一、是否继续维持军公教18%的优惠存款利率，即“18趴”;二、是否降低所得替代率，即员工退休后领取的给付与退休前薪资所得的比值;三、是否延迟退休到65岁;四、如何提升基金经营绩效，增加基金总额;五、特殊对象，如党职并公职、法官与检察官、公营行库职工、政务人员等这些人的退抚金计算与领取到底该如何处理。

**无论如何，军公教都是“改革”主要对象，****是最大的利益受损者****。**

动人利益，无异于“杀人父母”，按鲁迅的说法，搬张桌子都要流血，何况是这样大刀阔斧的砍别人的实打实的收入。

2017年的9月3日，军公教人员就开始了游行示威活动，参与人数出人意料地多达近15万人(警方保守估计)，成为蔡英文执政后首场规模最大的街头抗争活动。

针对年金改革方案，蓝绿双方在台立法机构曾大打出手；中华统一党等台湾党派还曾打出五星红旗，反对民进党当局推行的年金改革。

于是，我们有幸看到大陆各大媒体有关台湾军公教上街抗议蔡英文政府的消息，并配有大篇幅图文并茂的内容以及耸人听闻的标题，媒体集体得出的结论是：蔡英文政府完了！

然而，蔡英文并没有被军公教上街抗议所吓倒，她公开回应称：“我也理解，在改革的过程里，难免有些冲击。但是我要再一次强调，年金改革最重要的意义，就是要保障我们每一个人的下一代、保障世世代代台湾人都能够拥有安定的退休生活。我们这一代人的牺牲，是为了让下一代更好。如果我们不改革，我们就对不起下一代”。

经过反复沟通和不懈坚持，台湾的军公教利益群体在蔡英文及其团队的感召下终于理解并接受了政府的年金制度改革方案，从此台湾社会走向了人人平等，民安省富的时代！

现在，台湾各界退休人员的保障水平基本公平。以农民为例，65岁起领到的老农津贴加上退休储金每个月可以领到37027元（人民币8516.21元）。

## 香港新推工業品牌、廟宇文化等四個旅遊熱點項目

2026-10-16 17:10 聯合報／ 香港特派員[李春](https://udn.com/news/reporter/MDM4NjY=)/即時報導  香港

[**香港**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF)發展旅遊熱點，年底起再推出四個項目，包括九龍巴士車廠、廟宇漫遊等，為觀光客提供更多香港特色的多元化旅遊體驗。

[**港府**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E6%B8%AF%E5%BA%9C)政務司副司長卓永興領導的「發展旅遊熱點工作組」，首階段已推出九個旅遊熱點項目，包括香港工業[**品牌**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E5%93%81%E7%89%8C)旅遊、維園市集、紫花風鈴木園、舊城中環深度遊等，港府說這些項目受到歡迎，決意推出更多熱點項目。

卓永興說，港府要透過加強跨部門統籌並結合社會各界力量，在今年底起，分階段推出涵蓋工業品牌、微型藝術、宗教文化及地區風貌等主題的旅遊熱點項目，向旅客展現香港獨特的文化底蘊及城市面貌。

新的四個項目包括第二階段香港工業品牌旅遊，新增項目涵蓋九龍巴士車廠、港鐵「載遇‧站見」鐵路展，以及北京同仁堂香港生產研發基地等；

第二個項目是香港微型城市展，香港杜莎夫人蠟像館將於今年第四季起，於山頂凌霄閣重塑香港微型城市展。新展覽將加入全新精緻的微型藝術展品，立體展現香港的地標建築、地道習俗及生活特色；

第三個項目是推廣宗教文化深度遊，港府會進一步研究以廟宇為核心，串連各區具文化價值的歷史建築及古蹟，打造廟宇文化深度遊的漫遊路線；

第四個項目是元朗民政事務處將與地區團體合作，推出「元朗好時節」項目，鼓勵旅客全年按不同主題探索元朗地區特色，例如於天后誕到元朗市中心觀賞盛大的會景巡遊，以及於秋冬季節走訪自然生態景點，尋紅葉、覓候鳥等。

另外香港的「粵艇南下」項目，即廣東遊艇南下香港今日首航，首批五艘遊艇中午起駛入香港水域，並陸續進入大嶼山遊艇會停泊，香港海事處船隻鳴笛迎接。五艘遊艇分別來自深圳、珠海及南沙，將在香港休閒和購物數日。

# [China-Linked Hackers Exploited BeyondTrust Zero-Day to Take Over Remote Support Servers](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/china-linked-hackers-exploited.html)

__ Ravie Lakshmanan __ Oct 16, 2026 Zero-Day / Vulnerability

[![Image 7](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEic5zD5GBvYxe93igsDOMdwS6eyfDORIWio42Z9UY0enK0XKWYcQlLB9RLx3iO_V1xm8vqBxMVZ_R8Lt-xxOumO5_RIFN3hgB-yZyGGlVMypRx5lm2GJq-1c9cbzfRcjrMAIfBI67L4QUI-MwjjQjKL1RcgPnzFdYuAF3k1y2Ev-ppSmiG8sdQ5dbJkbjKR/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/beyond.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEic5zD5GBvYxe93igsDOMdwS6eyfDORIWio42Z9UY0enK0XKWYcQlLB9RLx3iO_V1xm8vqBxMVZ_R8Lt-xxOumO5_RIFN3hgB-yZyGGlVMypRx5lm2GJq-1c9cbzfRcjrMAIfBI67L4QUI-MwjjQjKL1RcgPnzFdYuAF3k1y2Ev-ppSmiG8sdQ5dbJkbjKR/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/beyond.jpg)

The China-nexus cyber espionage group tracked as **Armory Castle** (previously UNC5221 or Warp Panda) exploited a newly disclosed security flaw in BeyondTrust Remote Support (formerly Bomgar) as a zero-day in late August 2026.

The vulnerability, tracked as **[CVE-2026-102764](https://www.beyondtrust.com/trust-center/security-advisories/bt26-05)** (CVSS score: 9.3), is a case of improper origin validation in an internal messaging component that could be exploited by a remote attacker to perform file operations on an affected appliance.

"The vulnerability exists within internal components of Remote Support," BeyondTrust said in a Thursday alert. "The components did not adequately validate the origin of the messages it received. Under the right conditions, this could be used to perform file operations on the appliance."

Patches for the flaw have been pushed to all Remote Support SaaS customers as of October 9, 2026. Self-hosted customers of Remote Support running versions from 24.3.1 through 26.2.3 are advised to manually update to BT26-05-RS patch. Customers running a version older than 24.3.1 will be required to upgrade to a newer version to apply the fix.

[![Image 8: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVYuoalvwUlwvLZFDideJ8jW4rz-IodX0Lwi7uyP7Ab0wiDeu_BqVhPDdejQQ65MC3p9Xc4MApnHz56NJ5SDc1HMg0DvozkkGYv9TGtDLCh26v1yD5-GyzQxnA5-6A6B4beW96H_6FyrByq22cvU5JDF-i8e5GIfV4wg1SpCvjwAJt74FaqkAb2gzqE7ll/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/core-d.png)](https://thehackernews.uk/growth-ai-control-d)

According to a [timeline of events](https://www.beyondtrust.com/blog/entry/bt26-05) shared by BeyondTrust, Armory Castle is said to have exploited the flaw as a zero-day on a single self-hosted Remote Support appliance on August 29, 2026. Then, on September 27, 2026, "successful exploitation of another security device provider [became] public," it added, prompting it to initiate an investigation to hunt for similar activity.

Armory Castle has a [history](https://thehackernews.com/2025/09/unc5221-uses-brickstorm-backdoor-to.html) of [exploiting](https://thehackernews.com/2025/12/cisa-reports-prc-hackers-using.html) zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ([CVE-2023-4966](https://thehackernews.com/2025/04/critical-ivanti-flaw-actively-exploited.html)) and Ivanti Connect Secure ([CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2024-21887](https://thehackernews.com/2024/02/warning-new-malware-emerges-in-attacks.html), and [CVE-2025-0282](https://thehackernews.com/2025/01/ivanti-flaw-cve-2025-0282-actively.html)) appliances to break a wide range of sectors, including legal services, SaaS providers, business-process outsourcers, technology, and governments, for long-term intelligence collection. It's known to be active since October 2023.

"The actor uses a zero-day selectively against chosen targets, and once the vulnerability is public, the actor typically moves to broad exploitation of every instance still unpatched," BeyondTrust said. "Our working assessment is that this actor selects high-value software targets in advance and keeps a working model of the products the actor targets in an AI context that it uses on an ongoing basis to develop exploit chains."

[![Image 9](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhLfMw0HvD7xBNyWNPi2keqpAiWhQNzpvhDZZJXvgbev2m5S7rRPlOMcOrjd5kma4o4X837CKgYAK1wahxDSnXfF6BKbzm8_FtGkDSywV0HQVYbsGQMpwuiY3QMGDdCcNiS1z09qK4DK3CdV_sezo1hNe9xXj8r7s2BYhHt52EHcc4arESMcmbWJUAreKW5/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/ARMORY.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhLfMw0HvD7xBNyWNPi2keqpAiWhQNzpvhDZZJXvgbev2m5S7rRPlOMcOrjd5kma4o4X837CKgYAK1wahxDSnXfF6BKbzm8_FtGkDSywV0HQVYbsGQMpwuiY3QMGDdCcNiS1z09qK4DK3CdV_sezo1hNe9xXj8r7s2BYhHt52EHcc4arESMcmbWJUAreKW5/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/ARMORY.jpg)

Google-owned Mandiant, which shared additional details related to the exploitation activity, said a successful compromise is followed by the deployment of a lightweight PHP web shell codenamed SAWFLY for interactive remote access and bidirectional encrypted command-and-control (C2) communication.

The operator makes use of commercial VPN exit nodes and compromised home and small-office routers to blend into regular traffic, and then leverages the web shell as a conduit to escalate privileges, obtain full administrative control of the appliance, and establish persistence in a manner that survives reboots.

[![Image 10: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVV2rRkX8tRMF6gCzemvQNpwFwGxRWxY1cJEYfoLLSj1EZYJOlj5WTR77t0i6kELXujYcaHTpRDqTjCbVHH5Pnh7wzxUiKP5j4dsDkWIMlp2bmpZsL0jeAsA_19pHH5UPtyBvNkZdyGEULOAsXPcraMP5CYjQRFefhXRSdEjYkrdcpUnc4ILcvcdEfAauE/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/tl-d.jpg)](https://thehackernews.uk/network-defense-d)

The intrusion is characterized by efforts to facilitate credential theft by reading the appliance's stored secrets and abusing the administrative access to reach downstream systems and enable lateral movement. Details of the [post-exploitation actions](https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/armory-castle-exploits-beyondtrust/) undertaken by the threat actor are listed below -

*   Gaining root-level control of the appliance host by copying the system shell executable (/bin/sh) to the file "/usr/bin/dbus-authd" and modifying its ownership to root and enabling Set User ID (SUID) permissions, causing it to be executed with the privileges of the file's owner.
*   Attempting to harvest credentials directly from the appliance's native secrets management database by using the proprietary "/ns/sbin/bt-secrets" Command Line Interface (CLI) utility to manage, store, and retrieve passwords, API keys, and endpoint credentials.
*   Targeting the BeyondTrust configuration templates to obtain passwordless root privileges to the site service account and
*   Pivoted into the BeyondTrust Remote Support application to perform reconnaissance via compromised administrator credentials and then launch remote sessions to downstream systems populated within the appliance's [Jump Item list](https://docs.beyondtrust.com/pra/v24.3/docs/wac-jump-items).
*   Abusing the elevated administrative privileges to establish a remote support session to target internal endpoints and obtain full file-system access to those systems with an aim to download and exfiltrate sensitive internal documents for network reconnaissance.
*   Tunneling traffic through the BeyondTrust device via BARECLAW, a C-based custom SOCKS5 proxy tunneler that relays TCP connections between a remote client and destinations.
*   Modifying "/ns/config/haproxy.conf" file to ensure BARECLAW is accessible directly from the internet.
*   Hindering detection efforts by systematically deleting system, web server, and application-level logs.

"Throughout the intrusion, Armory Castle leveraged a deep understanding of BeyondTrust appliance internals, as evidenced by their abuse of proprietary CLI utilities, startup configuration templates and local reverse-proxy routing," Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) and Mandiant researchers Jayson Frost, Bryce Greathouse, Brian Meyer, John Palmisano, Rajesh Rajeshirke, Steve Rasch, and John Wolfram said.

"Any appliance that was reachable from the internet on a vulnerable version during the exploitation window should be treated as potentially compromised until it has been reviewed."

title: Hong Kong adds four tourism projects from Q4, including bus depot visits and temple trails
zh_title: 香港第四季度新增四个旅游项目，包括参观巴士站和寺庙步道
summary: 香港 香港将于第四季起推出四个新旅游项目，包括参观九巴车厂、铁路展览、微缩城市展示、寺庙文物径和元朗季节性旅游。这些举措旨在展示当地文化和城市特色。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 16 日香港时间 14:53 · 阅读 2 分钟 政府宣布由副局长牵头的旅游热点开发工作组
content:
香港
香港将于第四季起推出四个新旅游项目，包括参观九巴车厂、铁路展览、微缩城市展示、寺庙文物径和元朗季节性旅游。这些举措旨在展示当地文化和城市特色。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 16 日 14:53 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

政府宣布，由政务司副政务司长卓永兴领导的发展旅游热点工作小组将于今年第四季起陆续推出下一阶段的四个项目，为旅客提供更多元化、更独特的香港旅游体验。

卓先生表示，首期9个旅游热点项目的反应良好，得益于跨部门的加强协调和社会各界的贡献。今年年底起，工作组将分阶段推出新项目，涵盖工业品牌、微缩艺术、宗教文化、街区风光等主题，展示我市独特的文化遗产和城市风貌。
四个项目包括香港工业品牌旅游二期，新增景点包括九龙巴士车厂、港铁“Ride & See”铁路展览、北京同仁堂香港产研基地等。参观者将可以有组织地参观这些品牌设施，了解它们的历史和生产流程。

第二个项目是香港微型城市展览。香港杜莎夫人蜡像馆将于第四季度起在山顶广场重现展示，加入精雕细琢的微缩艺术品，从三个维度呈现香港的地标、风土人情和生活方式。

三是推进宗教文化深度游。华人庙宇委员会正在其管理的寺庙加强数字化和文化推广，包括安装二维码标牌和移动应用程序，让游客以互动方式了解寺庙文物并交换文化纪念品。政府将进一步研究将寺庙与各地区具有历史文化意义的建筑物和古迹联系起来，创建寺庙遗产步行路线。
第四个项目由元朗民政事务处牵头，联同地区团体推出“元朗好时节”，鼓励游客全年按主题探索该区，例如天后节期间到市中心观看盛大游行，或秋冬季节到自然景点观赏红叶和候鸟。该项目包括制作旅游地图、建立主题网站以及在城乡地标附近增加信息标志，预计从第四季度到明年第一季度分阶段推出。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong will roll out four new tourism projects from the fourth quarter, including visits to KMB depots, a railway exhibition, a miniature city display, temple heritage trails and seasonal tours of Yuen Long. The initiatives aim to showcase local culture and urban features.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

16 Oct 2026 at 14:53 HKT · 2 min read

The government announced that the Working Group on Developing Tourism Hotspots, led by Deputy Chief Secretary for Administration Cheuk Wing-hing, will progressively launch the next phase of four projects from the fourth quarter of this year, offering visitors a wider range of distinctive Hong Kong tourism experiences.

Cheuk said the first phase of nine tourism hotspot projects had been well received, thanks to strengthened cross-departmental coordination and contributions from across the community. From the end of this year, the working group will roll out new projects in phases, covering themes such as industrial brands, miniature art, religious culture and district scenery, to showcase the city's unique cultural heritage and urban landscape.

The four projects include the second phase of Hong Kong industrial brand tourism, with new attractions covering Kowloon Motor Bus depots, the MTR's "Ride & See" railway exhibition, and Beijing Tong Ren Tang's Hong Kong production and research base. Visitors will be able to tour these brand facilities in organised groups to learn about their histories and production processes.

The second project is a Hong Kong miniature city exhibition. Madame Tussauds Hong Kong will recreate the display at The Peak Galleria from the fourth quarter, adding finely crafted miniature artworks that present the city's landmarks, local customs and lifestyle in three dimensions.

The third project promotes in-depth religious culture tours. The Chinese Temples Committee is enhancing digitalisation and cultural promotion at its managed temples, including installing QR code signage and a mobile app that lets visitors interactively learn about temple relics and exchange for cultural souvenirs. The government will further study linking temples with historically and culturally significant buildings and monuments across districts to create temple heritage walking routes.

The fourth project, led by the Yuen Long District Office with district groups, is "Yuen Long Good Seasons", encouraging visitors to explore the district by theme throughout the year, such as watching the grand procession during Tin Hau Festival in the town centre, or visiting natural attractions in autumn and winter to see red leaves and migratory birds. The project includes producing tourist maps, setting up a themed website and adding information signs near urban and rural landmarks, with phased rollout expected from the fourth quarter to the first quarter of next year.

content:
香港
国际刑警组织第94届大会将于11月30日至12月3日在香港举行，吸引来自196个成员国的1,000多名代表。保安局局长邓克里斯分享了他过往国际刑警组织的经验，并概述了此次活动的广泛保安准备工作。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 16 日 15:08 · 阅读时间 3 分钟

保安局局长邓炳强证实，香港将于下个月首次主办国际刑事警察组织（国际刑警组织）大会。在接受《旗帜报》姊妹刊《星岛日报》的独家专访时，唐先生回顾了他被借调到法国里昂国际刑警组织总部两年的经历，并解释了即将举行的集会的意义。
2006 年至 2008 年，唐在里昂国际刑警组织秘书处担任专业官员，随后晋升为有组织犯罪和暴力犯罪部门负责人。他回忆说，这项工作与香港当地的警务工作有很大不同，需要与国际当局直接协调来应对不熟悉的犯罪行为。在任职期间，唐走遍了非洲、欧洲、美洲和亚洲，在坦桑尼亚协调索马里沿海的反海盗行动，并打击与意大利黑手党和日本黑帮等有组织犯罪网络有联系的跨国集团。这些行动针对人口贩运、非法移民和跨境赌博网络。
唐指出，国际刑警组织人员不进行直接逮捕。相反，他们从指挥中心运作来处理情报、协调机构间响应并实时监控行动。他称这次借调是一次宝贵的经历，拓宽了他的国际视野，增强了他对全球执法动态的理解。他说，与来自不同文化和法律背景的官员一起工作，对外国调查方法和组织管理风格提供了重要的接触，并补充说，驾驭国际关系、跨境安全协议和不同的工作文化，为他随后担任警务处处长和保安局局长的领导角色做好了必要的准备。

国际刑警组织第94届全体大会将于11月30日至12月3日在香港会议展览中心举行，吸引了来自196个成员国的1000多名警察局长、政府高级官员和机构领导人。唐英年感谢中央政府继1995年和2017年在北京举行两届集会后，委托香港主办这次活动。他表示，这次集会提供了一个机会，直接向国际代表展示香港的公共安全、法治和专业管治，抵制媒体的偏见，展示香港在“一国两制”框架下的运作能力。
为监督筹备工作，香港特区政府设立了三层指导架构：由政务司司长担任主席的督导委员会、由保安局局长领导的跨部门工作小组，以及由警务处处长领导的警务行动工作小组。充分准备

Hong Kong
Hong Kong will host the 94th Interpol General Assembly from November 30 to December 3, drawing over 1,000 delegates from 196 member countries. Secretary for Security Chris Tang shared his past Interpol experience and outlined extensive security preparations for the event.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

16 Oct 2026 at 15:08 HKT · 3 min read

Hong Kong will host the General Assembly of the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) for the first time next month, the Secretary for Security Chris Tang Ping-keung has confirmed. In an exclusive interview with Sing Tao Daily, the sister publication of The Standard, Tang reflected on his two-year secondment to Interpol headquarters in Lyon, France, and explained the significance of the upcoming assembly.

Tang served at Interpol's Secretariat in Lyon from 2006 to 2008 as a Specialized Officer before being promoted to Head of the Organized Crime and Violent Crime Unit. He recalled that the work differed significantly from local policing in Hong Kong, requiring direct coordination with international authorities to tackle unfamiliar offenses. During his posting, Tang travelled across Africa, Europe, the Americas and Asia, coordinating anti-piracy operations off the coast of Somalia while based in Tanzania, and countering transnational syndicates linked to organised crime networks such as the Italian Mafia and the Japanese Yakuza. These operations targeted human trafficking, illegal immigration and cross-border gambling networks.

Tang noted that Interpol personnel do not conduct direct arrests. Instead, they operate from command centres to process intelligence, coordinate inter-agency responses and monitor operations in real time. He described the secondment as an invaluable experience that broadened his international perspective and enhanced his understanding of global law enforcement dynamics. Working alongside officials from various cultural and legal backgrounds offered critical exposure to foreign investigative methodologies and organisational management styles, he said, adding that navigating international relations, cross-border security protocols and diverse working cultures served as essential preparation for his subsequent leadership roles as Commissioner of Police and Secretary for Security.

The 94th Interpol General Assembly will take place at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre from November 30 to December 3, drawing over 1,000 police chiefs, senior government officials and agency leaders from 196 member countries. Tang expressed gratitude to the Central Government for entrusting Hong Kong with hosting the event, following previous assemblies held in Beijing in 1995 and 2017. He stated that the gathering offers an opportunity to demonstrate Hong Kong's public safety, rule of law and professional governance directly to international delegates, counteracting biased media portrayals and showcasing the city's operational capabilities under the "One Country, Two Systems" framework.

To oversee preparations, the HKSAR Government established a three-tier steering structure: a Steering Committee chaired by the Chief Secretary for Administration, an Inter-departmental Working Group led by the Secretary for Security, and a Police Operational Working Group managed by the Commissioner of Police. Extensive preparations have been underway for over a year, including venue security, VIP protection, transport management and crisis management drills. The government is also mobilising youth volunteers and bilingual support staff via various bureaus.

Tang added that the event will incorporate cultural activities, technical showcases featuring robotics and artificial intelligence used by the police force, and high-level exchanges aimed at strengthening global policing partnerships.

zh_title: 香港科学馆展示2026年未来科学奖得奖者作品
summary: 香港 香港科学馆举办展览，展示今年未来科学奖获奖者的作品，涵盖生命科学、材料科学和数学。互动展览探讨密码学、乙型肝炎感染和单原子催化，并安排科学峰会 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 主编 [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 2026 年 10 月 16 日，香港时间 15:45 · 阅读 2 分钟 香港科学馆推出「2026 未来科学园」
content:
香港
香港科学馆举办展览，展示今年未来科学奖获奖者的作品，涵盖生命科学、材料科学和数学。互动展览探讨密码学、乙型肝炎感染和单原子催化，并安排了一场科学峰会

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 16 日 15:45 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港科学馆推出“2026未来科学奖展览”，展示今年获奖者的研究成果。未来科学奖设立于2016年，每年三届奖励中国大陆、港澳台地区杰出科学成就的科学家，旨在用科学精神激励中国、世界和子孙后代。

今年的生命科学奖颁给了张宏博士，以表彰他在揭示多细胞生物特有的自噬机制及其生理功能方面做出的开创性贡献。材料科学奖授予赵东源教授，以表彰他在介孔材料方面的开创性工作，包括受控合成、机理理解和工业应用。袁新一教授因其对算术几何的基础性贡献而荣获数学与计算机科学奖。
该展览以多种多媒体和互动装置为特色，以通俗易懂的方式解释了之前获奖项目背后的科学原理，包括密码学、催化和肝炎病毒。 “数字指纹实验室”让参观者体验密码学的防伪威力，探索2019年数学与计算机科学奖获得者王晓云教授的研究领域。互动展览展示了乙型肝炎病毒感染肝细胞的机制，展示了2022年生命科学奖获得者李文辉教授的突破性研究，他发现了乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎病毒如何利用人体肝细胞上的特定受体。通过“催化反应模拟器”，参观者可以了解2024年材料科学奖获得者张涛教授和李亚东教授的单原子催化研究，以及这种方法如何提高工业效率。

展览期间，将举办“2026未来科学大奖周”，其重头戏“科学峰会”将于11月6日至7日在博物馆报告厅举行。世界知名科学家将分享前沿研究成果。详情请浏览hk.science.museum/tc/web/scm/exhibition/fsp.html。

Hong Kong
The Hong Kong Science Museum has opened an exhibition featuring the work of this year's Future Science Prize winners, covering life science, material science and mathematics. Interactive exhibits explore cryptography, hepatitis B infection and single-atom catalysis, with a science summit scheduled f

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

16 Oct 2026 at 15:45 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong Science Museum has launched the "2026 Future Science Prize Exhibition", showcasing the research achievements of this year's laureates. The Future Science Prize, established in 2016, presents three annual awards to scientists from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan for outstanding scientific accomplishments, aiming to inspire China, the world and future generations through scientific spirit.

This year's Life Science Prize goes to Dr Zhang Hong for his pioneering contributions in revealing the autophagy mechanisms unique to multicellular organisms and their physiological functions. The Material Science Prize is awarded to Professor Zhao Dongyuan for his groundbreaking work on mesoporous materials, including controlled synthesis, mechanistic understanding and industrial applications. Professor Yuan Xinyi receives the Mathematics and Computer Science Prize for his foundational contributions to arithmetic geometry.

The exhibition features multiple multimedia and interactive installations that explain in accessible terms the science behind previous prize-winning projects, including cryptography, catalysis and hepatitis viruses. The "Digital Fingerprint Laboratory" lets visitors experience the anti-counterfeiting power of cryptography, exploring the research field of Professor Wang Xiaoyun, winner of the 2019 Mathematics and Computer Science Prize. An interactive exhibit on the mechanism of hepatitis B virus infection of liver cells presents the breakthrough research of Professor Li Wenhui, the 2022 Life Science Prize winner, who discovered how specific receptors on human liver cells are exploited by hepatitis B and D viruses. Through the "Catalysis Reaction Simulator", visitors can learn about the single-atom catalysis research of Professor Zhang Tao and Professor Li Yadong, winners of the 2024 Material Science Prize, and how this approach improves industrial efficiency.

During the exhibition period, the "2026 Future Science Prize Week" will be held, with its highlight event, the "Science Summit", taking place on 6 and 7 November at the museum's lecture hall. World-renowned scientists will share cutting-edge research findings. Details are available at hk.science.museum/tc/web/scm/exhibition/fsp.html.

由于伊朗战争扰乱了中东石油流动并提高了海外炼油厂的利润率，预计中石油今年将创下创纪录的贸易利润，其贸易部门PCI预计将超过200亿元人民币。截至 10 月初，其原油部门的 2025 年收益已增加一倍多

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 16 日 15:45 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

五名贸易高管表示，中石油(0857)今年的贸易利润有望创下历史新高，伊朗战争改变了中东石油买卖方式，在全球燃料市场吃紧的情况下，中石油(0857)在中国以外的炼油厂将获得丰厚的利润。

作为亚洲最大的石油和天然气生产商和中国第二大炼油厂，中石油正在从庞大的生产和供应组合以及广泛的炼油和零售网络中获利，这些网络有助于使其免受战争造成的破坏。

两名知情人士称，中国国有公司旗下交易平台中石油国际 (PCI) 的毛利润预计将在 2026 年突破 200 亿元人民币（234.7 亿港元），创历史新高。由于未获授权与媒体交谈，两位知情人士要求匿名。
两位贸易高管之一表示，到 10 月初，其原油部门（通常占 PCI 一半以上的利润）在 2025 年全年的盈利增加了一倍多，燃料产品和天然气部门也表现强劲。中石油没有立即回应置评请求。

这家中国炼油商并未在公开财务业绩中公布交易利润，8月份公布的上半年净利润约为146.5亿美元。 PCI 的业绩与整个石油行业的丰厚交易收益一致，欧洲主要石油公司 BP、壳牌和 TotalEnergies 的交易部门在伊朗战争的最初几个月赚取了数十亿美元。

董事长戴厚良今年3月表示，霍尔木兹海峡是受战争干扰的石油和天然气贸易流动的咽喉要道，仅占中石油系统原油和天然气需求的10%。相比之下，国内同行中石化（0386）是全球产能最大的炼油商，由于其大约一半的石油依赖中东，因此更容易受到供应中断的影响。
一位贸易高管表示，PCI 的原油交易收益是由实物货物利润推动的，因为中东生产商（不包括伊朗）降低了石油出口价格。套利贸易或地区之间的货物流动也为利润做出了贡献。由于伊朗战争和俄罗斯-乌克兰战争导致燃料市场收紧，中石油的海外炼油厂的大幅利润也支撑了中石油的交易。

伊朗战争促使以阿布扎比国家石油公司为首的海湾生产商部署穿梭船队穿越霍尔木兹海峡运送石油并通过现货招标出售，而生产商则纷纷降价以抵消不断飙升的运费。沙特阿拉伯国家石油公司 (Saudi Aramco) 最近将面向亚洲买家的官方售价降至六年来的最低水平，伊拉克国有石油销售商 SOMO 将其码头装货折扣加深至每桶 30 美元以上。中石油是在伊拉克生产石油的最大外国公司，也是在海湾地区装载伊拉克廉价石油的公司之一。

PetroChina is expected to post record trading profits this year, with its trading arm PCI projected to exceed 20 billion yuan, as the Iran war disrupts Middle East oil flows and boosts margins at its overseas refineries. Its crude division has already more than doubled 2025 earnings by early October

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

16 Oct 2026 at 15:45 HKT · 2 min read

PetroChina (0857) is poised for a record year in trading profits, five trading executives said, with its refineries outside China reaping bumper margins amid tight global fuel markets as the Iran war transforms the way Middle East oil is bought and sold.

PetroChina, Asia's largest oil and gas producer and China's second-biggest refiner, is cashing in on a large production and supply portfolio and an extensive refining and retail network that have helped insulate it from war-induced disruptions.

Gross profits at the state company's trading vehicle PetroChina International (PCI) are expected to top 20 billion yuan (HK$23.47 billion) for 2026, a record, two of the people briefed on the matter said, speaking on the condition of anonymity as they are not authorised to speak with media.

By early October, its crude oil division, which typically generates over half of PCI's profits, had more than doubled earnings for the whole of 2025, with fuel products and natural gas departments also performing strongly, one of the two trading executives said. PetroChina did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

The Chinese refiner, which does not break out trading profits in its public financial results, posted a first-half net profit of around US$14.65 billion for the whole group in August. PCI's performance was in line with bumper trading earnings across the petroleum sector, with trading desks at European majors BP, Shell and TotalEnergies earning billions of dollars in the early months of the Iran war.

The Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for oil and gas trade flows disrupted by the war, accounts for just 10 per cent of PetroChina's system requirements for both crude oil and natural gas, Chairman Dai Houliang said in March. In contrast, domestic peer Sinopec (0386), the world's biggest refiner by capacity, has been more vulnerable to the supply disruptions as it relies on the Middle East for roughly half its oil.

PCI's crude trading gains have been driven by profits made on physical cargoes as Middle Eastern producers, excluding Iran, cut prices to export oil, said one trading executive. Arbitrage trade, or cargo movements between regions, has also contributed to profits. PetroChina's trading is also supported by wide margins at its overseas refineries as both the Iran war and the Russia-Ukraine war have tightened fuel markets.

The Iran war has prompted Gulf producers led by Abu Dhabi National Oil Company to deploy shuttle fleets to ship oil across the Strait of Hormuz and sell via spot tenders, while producers have cut prices to offset soaring freight costs. Saudi Aramco recently lowered its official selling prices for Asian buyers to six-year lows, and Iraq's state oil marketer SOMO deepened discounts to more than US$30 a barrel for loading at its terminals. PetroChina, the largest foreign company producing oil in Iraq, is among those to have loaded discounted Iraqi oil inside the Gulf.

# Hong Kong stocks rise on tech gains; Lenovo rebounds 8 per cent

Hong Kong shares closed higher on Friday, driven by tech stocks, with the Hang Seng Index up 0.52 per cent. Lenovo rebounded 8 per cent after a sharp fall, while Kuaishou rose on its new AI video model. Mainland indices also gained.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 16 Oct 2026 at 16:35 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20stocks%20rise%20on%20tech%20gains%3B%20Lenovo%20rebounds%208%20per%20cent%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-stocks-rise-on-tech-gains-Lenovo-rebounds-8-per-ce-7c5a07 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-stocks-rise-on-tech-gains-Lenovo-rebounds-8-per-ce-7c5a07&text=Hong%20Kong%20stocks%20rise%20on%20tech%20gains%3B%20Lenovo%20rebounds%208%20per%20cent "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-stocks-rise-on-tech-gains-Lenovo-rebounds-8-per-ce-7c5a07 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-stocks-rise-on-tech-gains-Lenovo-rebounds-8-per-ce-7c5a07&text=Hong%20Kong%20stocks%20rise%20on%20tech%20gains%3B%20Lenovo%20rebounds%208%20per%20cent "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20stocks%20rise%20on%20tech%20gains%3B%20Lenovo%20rebounds%208%20per%20cent&body=Hong%20Kong%20stocks%20rise%20on%20tech%20gains%3B%20Lenovo%20rebounds%208%20per%20cent%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-stocks-rise-on-tech-gains-Lenovo-rebounds-8-per-ce-7c5a07 "Email")

Hong Kong shares ended higher on Friday, lifted by technology stocks, with the benchmark Hang Seng Index rising 124 points, or 0.52 per cent, to 24,186 points. Full-day market turnover reached HK$178.2 billion, according to exchange data.

The Hang Seng Tech Index advanced 1.16 per cent to 4,108 points. Lenovo rebounded 8 per cent at the close after slumping 14 per cent a day earlier, making it the best performer among blue-chip stocks.

Property developers also gained, with Longfor (0960) climbing 6.2 per cent and China Resources Land (1109) rising 3.3 per cent. Among tech heavyweights, Alibaba (9988) added 2.3 per cent, while Tencent (0700) closed flat.

Kuaishou (1024) once jumped over 6 per cent before closing 2.5 per cent higher, as the company released its latest video generation model, Kling 4.0.

On the mainland, the Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index rose 0.95 per cent to 3,742 points, and the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Component Index increased 1.19 per cent to 11,957 points.

## 美沙冬是毒還是藥？從香港經驗看台灣選戰戒毒爭議

音頻加註文字，

**美沙冬是毒還是藥？從香港經驗看台灣選戰戒毒爭議**

Published 57 分鐘前

台灣「九合一」選舉即將舉行，近日台北市長選戰引發對「美沙冬」（又稱「美沙酮」）與毒品減害政策的辯論，社會對於是否降低使用門檻掀起熱議。

然而在海峽對岸的香港，這項計劃已運作超過半世紀，是亞洲最早大規模採用美沙冬緩解措施的地區之一。這項療法究竟有多大效用？為什麼國際醫學界視其為有效降低毒品相關犯罪與血液傳染病的關鍵？

ISLAMABAD -- Chinese solar panels are pouring into Pakistan, fueling demand for lithium-ion batteries and persuading local companies to partner with Chinese manufacturers to assemble the power packs domestically, even as prices plunge globally and insiders predict they will fall even further.

ME Solar Energy, a Karachi-based solar power solutions company, is setting up an assembly plant in the city through a tie-up with China's Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Ltd. (CATL). With a $15 million investment and technical support from CATL, the plant will be operational in March and able to produce 10,000 5-kilowatt lithium-ion batteries per month, ME Solar CEO Zubair Ahmed told Nikkei Asia.

ME Solar Energy is not alone.

Advertisement

According to disclosures submitted to the Pakistan Stock Exchange, Treet Battery, a subsidiary of blade and razor manufacturer Treet Corporation, is planning to set up a lithium-ion battery assembly plant with China's Contemporary Nebula Technology Energy. Also, Kohinoor Energy, an Islamabad-based independent power producer, plans to build a battery assembly plant in partnership with China's Hebei Juhang Energy Technology Group.

The companies aim to capture growing local demand for lithium-ion batteries that foreign suppliers currently feed.

According to United Nations data, Pakistan's imports of lithium-ion electric accumulators, or rechargeable batteries, jumped nearly threefold to $171 million in 2025 from $60 million the previous year, with China accounting for $167 million. Ember, a U.K.-based think tank that compiles Chinese customs data, says that, in a broader category, these battery imports from China rose to $294.3 million in 2025 from $147.1 million in 2024. In the first eight months of this year, these imports came to $537.2 million.

"The clearest industrial opportunity is therefore not simply to import more batteries; it is to move part of the engineering, assembly, testing and integration value chain into Pakistan," the Pakistan Solar Association said in a recent report.

Industry insiders say China's Dongjin Group has operated a battery factory in Karachi since 2021, producing lithium-ion batteries on a limited scale. But Pakistani companies and their Chinese partners are now venturing into battery assembly one after another as a solar boom spreads across the country.

According to Ember, Pakistan was the second-largest importer of Chinese solar panels in 2025, up from fifth in 2023, behind the Netherlands, and imports of Chinese panels hit a record high of 16.86 gigawatts in 2025, more than double 2023. The World Nuclear Industry Status Report 2026, authored by a group of independent analysts, says Pakistan generated an estimated 36.3 terawatt-hours of power from solar panels in 2025, 60% more than from reactors.

Higher electricity tariffs and declining grid reliability are pushing people to install solar panels, which need rechargeable batteries to store the energy they collect.

"Pakistan's battery market could [create] a multibillion-dollar industrial opportunity," Osama Rizvi, a global market and product strategist at Primary Vision, a U.S.-based energy market consultancy, told Nikkei Asia. "At current import volumes, even capturing a fraction would support skilled employment and domestic industry," he said.

However, declining local battery prices could cap revenues for companies now preparing assembly plants. Ahmed of ME Solar Energy said the local average price of a basic 5-kw battery has halved since 2024 to $720 "due to a global price decline and overproduction by China" and, if a new assembly plant becomes operational in Pakistan, the average price "could fall by 18%" to $590.

Experts also warn that Pakistan cannot afford to consider integrated production of lithium-ion batteries beyond assembly.

"Assembly is relatively feasible in the short term, but manufacturing battery cells requires significant capital, technological expertise, and economies of scale," Khalid Waleed, a research fellow at the Sustainable Development Policy Institute in Islamabad, told Nikkei Asia.

Vaqar Ahmed, an Islamabad-based economist, agrees, saying Pakistan's market cannot afford to move to "full cell manufacturing," as it "requires a market size and capital intensity." He added that the realistic near-term approach is "capturing assembly, integration and warranty value rather than cell production," meaning embedding the battery cell in a comprehensive system and after-sales services.

title: Madlanga Commission witness nabbed at OR Tambo airport
summary: A suspect was arrested at OR Tambo International Airport as he was about to leave the country, and his travel plans now include heading to a court to face charges for failing to appear at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry. The police have
content:
A suspect was arrested at OR Tambo International Airport as he was about to leave the country, and his travel plans now include heading to a court to face charges for failing to appear at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry.

The police have not yet named the suspect, and this detail will be added to this developing story once he has been in court.

He was expected to appear in the Pretoria Magistrate’s Court on Friday, 16 October 2026.

### ‘International flight’

According to a South African Police Service (SAPS) statement, the suspect, 49, was taken into custody late on Thursday, “moments before he was due to board an international flight”.

The SAPS statement read: “The suspect was arrested for failing to appear before the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry.”

He was detained by the Commissions Recommendations Task Team, which is following up on and probing matters arising from the Madlanga Commission, which is investigating accusations that a cartel has infiltrated the state.

While the police have not named the suspect, there have been several issues with witnesses not appearing before the commission.

### Carrim’s Cape Town visit

About two months ago, in August, it emerged that the Madlanga Commission would lodge criminal complaints against North West ANC member and businessman Suliman Carrim after he repeatedly failed to appear before it.

Carrim’s legal team had put forward medical reasons why he could not testify. But Carrim refused an independent medical assessment, which sparked questions around his condition.

Before that, it emerged that Carrim had been at a shop and an eatery in Cape Town – even though a doctor had deemed him medically unfit to testify before the commission.

Carrim had also wanted an application to postpone his testimony at the commission heard in camera – in other words, to be heard in private.

Businessman Suliman Carrim testifies at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry on 10 March 2026. (Photo: Gallo Images / Frennie Shivambu)

Earlier this year, when Carrim initially failed to obtain a ruling that his testimony be heard in camera, he was questioned about his ties to various individuals.

He admitted to having dealings with organised crime accused Vusimuzi “Cat” Matlala, who faces accusations that he colluded with corrupt police officers and is a member of a drug cartel known as the Big Five. (This is the cartel that is alleged to have infiltrated the state.)

### Khan and the criminal charges

Another Madlanga Commission witness who has failed to appear before it is former Crime Intelligence officer Feroz Khan.

He was initially meant to have testified before the commission at the start of July, but just days before he was wounded in a shooting in Houghton, Johannesburg.

Khan’s lawyer had also said that his medical condition had prevented him from appearing on a few occasions.

Former Crime Intelligence officer Feroz Khan appears in the Kempton Park Magistrate’s Court on 11 May 2026. (Photo: Gallo Images / OJ Koloti)

Last month, after Khan again did not appear despite a subpoena, the commission announced it would lodge criminal complaints against him.

He was again expected to testify privately earlier this month, but on the eve of that, [his uncle, Preggy Padayachee, was murdered](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-10-06-feroz-khans-commission-testimony-postponed-after-uncle-murdered/) in a shooting in Gauteng.

Padayachee’s murder meant Khan’s testimony did not go ahead as planned. **DM**

_This is a developing story. Daily Maverick has a team at the court and will update this story as details become available._

# 沈伯洋指都更新政出口窄無解 蔣萬安：將增105名人力

2026/10/16 16:17（10/16 16:56 更新）

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 16](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

台北市長蔣萬安（圖）16日上午接受廣播節目專訪時宣布將放寬都更門檻，下午隨即在市府召開記者會，說明都更新政策。中央社記者葉蓁芸攝 115年10月16日

（中央社記者[葉蓁芸](https://cna.com.tw/author/0275/)台北16日電）台北市長蔣萬安今天宣布放寬都更門檻，民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋說，若放寬入口但出口仍窄，就沒有解決問題。蔣萬安表示，因應新政，將增加都更處人力約105人，以加速審議。

蔣萬安下午在市府召開記者會說明都更政策，會後接受媒體聯訪時被問及沈伯洋說法時表示，水源二、三期及斯文里二期馬上要更新，還有南機場、信維整宅、虎林街60巷等案，不只加快整合意願，也提高審議速度。因應新政，市府會增加1倍人力、提前到位。

媒體提問，若都更門檻降低，是否會導致案量囤積。蔣萬安回應，將增加都更處人力，以利加速審查，他舉出信維整宅、南機場單元三等案例，加速前段整合、審議程序，才能完成招商簽約並拆除更新。

記者追問人力缺乏問題，蔣萬安說，目前已有具體方案，預計增加105名正式員額。至於政策上路時間，蔣萬安說，正進行相關程序，接下來將實施上路。

蔣萬安在記者會中說明，現行都更專案「7599」將調整為「5099」，第一階段自主整合意願門檻從75%降至50%，只要過半人數或戶數有意願，市府就會進場協助試算；第二階段若有90％住戶有意願，即進入第三階段模擬選配，若90％住戶同意，就會公告招商。

蔣萬安表示，第一階段最困難，面對產權複雜、戶數不足情形，須花費許多時間協調整合，降低門檻有助於加速都更，預估將有1214.26公頃地區受惠。

蔣萬安說，第二項新政則是有條件將基準容積從225％增至300％，提高開發誘因，適用於基地面積3000平方公尺以上、位於捷運站或水岸周邊，並在部分容積導入托育、長照服務、圖書館、社會住宅等設施，創造公共利益。

蔣萬安提到，市府已啟動2例大街廓都更案旗艦計畫，第1例為中山行政園區，即過去拆除的第一殯儀館，基地面積1.5公頃，串聯圓山創新聚落、松南AI園區，未來導入區公所、社福照護等，打造中山行政中心。

蔣萬安說，第2例則是南港行政中心，將遷移至南港高工位址，將0.7公頃基地全面都更並提高容積，導入金融、商辦等，結合交通，建構TOD廊帶樞紐。（編輯：林恕暉）1151016

title: Meta推出新款开放权重AI模型 宣称可与中国匹敌
summary: （法新社旧金山15日电） Meta推出新款开放权重AI模型Muse Spark Open，宣称性能可与中国顶尖开发商匹敌，部分表现更胜一筹。 发表时间： 16/10/2026 - 08:01 6 分钟 浏览时间 Meta指出，此模型亦进一步针对苹果（Apple）先进的M5 Ultra晶片「最佳化」，外界认为这代表两大科技巨擘之间罕见的合作关系。 Meta今天推出新款开放权重（open-weight）AI模型，宣称可与中国主要开发商的同类产品较劲，部分情况下表现甚至更优。Met
content:
（法新社旧金山15日电） Meta推出新款开放权重AI模型Muse Spark Open，宣称性能可与中国顶尖开发商匹敌，部分表现更胜一筹。

发表时间： 16/10/2026 - 08:01

6 分钟 浏览时间

Meta指出，此模型亦进一步针对苹果（Apple）先进的M5 Ultra晶片「最佳化」，外界认为这代表两大科技巨擘之间罕见的合作关系。

Meta今天推出新款开放权重（open-weight）AI模型，宣称可与中国主要开发商的同类产品较劲，部分情况下表现甚至更优。Meta人工智慧长汪滔（Alexandr Wang）在X平台写道，Muse Spark Open「是迄今最强大的美国开放权重模型」。

有别于所谓封闭式模型，例如Anthropic的Claude或OpenAI的ChatGPT，开发者可下载开放权重模型的参数（即权重），再进行客制化。

过去几年，中国开发商已成为AI模型开放权重市场的主导者。

阿里巴巴（Alibaba）的通义千问（Qwen）、月之暗面（Moonshot AI）的Kimi K3，以及智谱（Z.ai）的GLM模型，长期以来被视为全球开放权重领域的领先者，但Meta宣称其新款开放模型如今已能在相近水准上竞争。

Meta在部落格贴文中说，Muse Spark Open「专为程式设计与代理工作打造」，「擅长长期任务、复杂软体工程与多步骤推理」，并补充新模型已整合「强大的安全防护措施」。

Meta执行长祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）在X平台写道，新模型「在新款Mac Studio上运行表现极佳，这要归功于」与苹果及其新任执行长特纳斯（John Ternus）的合作。

特纳斯于9月接替库克（Tim Cook）出任苹果掌门人，他回应说，「在桌上能以如此高效能执行Muse Spark Open此水准与规模的模型，真是太棒了。Mac Studio持续突破装置端AI的界限！」

不过，Muse Spark Open仍需要庞大算力。Meta表示，使用者可在两台搭载M5 Ultra晶片的Mac Studio运行此模型，在自己的桌面上打造一台「超级电脑」。

这项发表距离Meta宣布最新封闭式模型仅隔数天。

Meta已于12日发表名为Wonder与Wonder Full的两款新「前沿」模型，宣称可与最先进版本的ChatGPT和Claude相提并论。

Meta的AI发展最初聚焦于开放模型，但近来祖克柏已推动公司与OpenAI及Anthropic一较高下。

Meta于4月推出Spark模型，标志着与旗下开源模型Llama分道扬镳，后者表现落后于业界其他对手。

content:
中新社台北10月16日电 中华经济研究院(CIER)周五预测，在内需和出口的双重支持下，台湾经济将在2026年以39年来最快的速度增长。

该智库将2026年经济增长预期上调至12.16%，比7月份预测的10.35%提高了1.81个百分点。

根据政府统计数据，如果预测准确，台湾经济增长速度将是自1987年12.75%以来最快的。

据《自由时报》报道，CIER 总裁连贤明在发布会前对记者表示：“今年是非常强劲的一年，国内外需求都表现良好。”

根据 CIER 的介绍，国内需求预计将贡献总体预计年度增长的 55%，而海外净需求将占剩余的 45%。

该智库表示，经济增长动力在很大程度上继续受到对人工智能相关产品的强劲需求的推动，这支持了强劲的出口增长以及更强劲的投资和消费者支出。

根据 CIER 的数据，其对 7 月份增长的上修主要是由于对内需增长而不是出口增长的预期。

在内需方面，连恩表示，全球云服务提供商持续扩大资本支出，带动本土制造商增加产能。
Lien 表示，产能的增长，加上非科技行业对自动化投资的增加，导致 CI​​ER 预计 2026 年私人投资将增长 10.77%。

该智库表示，私人消费预计增长 4.94%。

CIER 预测 2025 年整体增长将轻松超过台湾 8.76% 的增长，尽管季度增速预计将在年底放缓。

该智库预计第三季度增长率为 12.73%，第四季度增长率为 8.20%，因为较高的比较基数影响了同比数据。

第四季度预测较 7 月份预测的 6.04% 上调。该智库引用的政府数据显示，台湾第一季度和第二季度的增长率分别为15.43%和12.93%。

台湾的高预期增长率与全球经济活动放缓的预期形成鲜明对比。

CIER 援引标准普尔全球 9 月份的预测指出，预计今年世界经济增长将从 2025 年的 2.90% 放缓至 2.41%，这是自 COVID-19 大流行以来的最弱表现。

在评估台湾的前景时，CIER 强调了主要云服务提供商资本支出的持续扩张，但指出潜在融资需求的不确定性和现金流表现的差异是值得关注的问题。
报告还指出，主要经济体的货币政策变化、金融市场走势、国内投资、地缘政治风险和海峡两岸关系都可能拖累台湾的高增长环境。

在物价方面，CIER预测年度通胀率为2.06%，略高于7月份预测的2.02%和去年1.66%的通胀率。第四季度通胀率预计为 2.42%。

对于 2027 年，该机构将增长预测从 7 月份的 3.71% 上调至 5.97%，表明经济将继续以更为温和的速度扩张。

（赵彦祥摄）

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 16 (CNA) Taiwan's economy will grow at its fastest pace in 39 years in 2026, supported by both domestic demand and exports, the Chung-Hua Institution for Economic Research (CIER) forecast on Friday.

The think tank raised its growth forecast to 12.16 percent for 2026, up 1.81 percentage points from its previous forecast of 10.35 percent made in July.

If the forecast is accurate, the pace of growth would be the fastest since Taiwan's economy grew 12.75 percent in 1987, according to government statistics.

"This is a very strong year, with both domestic and external demand performing very well," CIER President Lien Hsien-ming (連賢明) told reporters before the presentation, according to the Liberty Times.

Domestic demand is expected to contribute 55 percent of the overall projected annual growth, while net overseas demand would account for the remaining 45 percent, according to the CIER's presentation.

Much of the economic momentum continues to be driven by strong demand for AI-related products, which has supported robust export growth and stronger investment and consumer spending, according to the think tank.

Based on the CIER's figures, its upward revision of growth from July was largely due to expectations of higher growth in domestic demand rather than exports.

In terms of domestic demand, Lien said global cloud service providers were continuing to expand capital expenditures, leading local manufacturers to increase capacity.

That rise in capacity, combined with increased investment in automation by non-tech industries, led the CIER to project private investment to grow 10.77 percent in 2026, according to Lien.

Private consumption is forecast to grow 4.94 percent, the think tank said.

The CIER's projection of overall growth would easily surpass Taiwan's 8.76 percent growth in 2025, though the quarterly pace is expected to ease at the end of the year.

The think tank estimated third-quarter growth of 12.73 percent, followed by 8.20 percent in the fourth quarter as a higher base of comparison weighs on the year-over-year figure.

The fourth-quarter forecast was raised from July's estimate of 6.04 percent. Taiwan recorded growth of 15.43 percent and 12.93 percent in the first and second quarters, respectively, government data cited by the think tank showed.

Taiwan's high projected growth rate contrasts with expectations of moderated economic activity globally.

Citing S&P Global's September projections, the CIER noted that world economic growth was expected to slow to 2.41 percent this year from 2.90 percent in 2025, marking the weakest performance since the COVID-19 pandemic.

In assessing Taiwan's outlook, the CIER highlighted continued expansion in capital spending by major cloud service providers, but pointed to uncertainties over potential financing requirements and diverging cash flow performance as issues to watch.

It also cited monetary policy changes in major economies, financial market movements, domestic investment, geopolitical risks and cross-Taiwan Strait relations as potential drags on Taiwan's high-growth environment.

On prices, the CIER forecast annual inflation of 2.06 percent, slightly above its July estimate of 2.02 percent and last year's inflation rate of 1.66 percent. Fourth-quarter inflation was projected at 2.42 percent.

For 2027, the institute raised its growth forecast to 5.97 percent from 3.71 percent in July, pointing to continued expansion at a more moderate pace.

(By Chao Yen-hsiang)

title: ONSITE Reiki OR Access Bars WellBEing Session w/ Lisa Helmly, Mon, Oct 19, 2026, 6:00 PM   | Meetup
summary: **6:00 - 7:00 pm (EST) AND 7:15 - 8:15 pm (EST), weekly on Monday in the HEALING room at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd, The Mezzanine Suite 228 in Mt. Pleasant. We have a NEW dedicated space for private WellBEing sessions in the HEALING ro
content:
**6:00 - 7:00 pm (EST) AND 7:15 - 8:15 pm (EST), weekly on Monday in the HEALING room at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd, The Mezzanine Suite 228 in Mt. Pleasant. We have a NEW dedicated space for private WellBEing sessions in the HEALING room at bliss available M-SU 8AM-8PM. We have implemented an in-house scheduling calendar that Practitioners may reference to determine an available mutually beneficial time if the recommended time below is not convenient for you.**

**This is a private 1-hour session. Please RSVP directly to the Practitioner to book the session time and then go to [givetobliss.com](http://givetobliss.com/) to make a $33 donation via VENMO (no fees), PayPal or credit card. Thank you!**

**Reiki** is a Japanese energy healing technique developed in the early 1900’s by Mikao Usui to stimulate health and vitality through channeling life force energy. While promoting a deep state of relaxation, Reiki therapy may reduce stress, anxiety, and pain through gentle touch and transferring of energy. The practitioner delivers this energy through their hands to assist in improving the recipients biofield flow and balance on the physical, emotional, mental, and spiritual levels. By having a tranquil effect on the mind and body, Reiki promotes healing and restoration while having a favorable influence on the parasympathetic and autonomic nervous systems.

**Access Bars** was developed by Gary Douglas as a set of tools and processes applied to facilitate more consciousness. As a restorative modality, Access Bars involves the practitioner connecting with 32 points on participants head through gentle touch. This contact facilitates the release of negative energetic thought forms, ideas, beliefs, emotions, and considerations that create barriers. As energetic blockages are discharged, a rebalancing occurs making room for improved thought patterns. Results may include a more peaceful mind, relaxed body, improved outlook, stress relief, more energy, and feeling replenished. Measurements of electrical activity of the brain conducted after an Access Bars treatment were shown to have literally calmed brain activity down.

**Facilitator: Lisa Ann Helmly,MS,RDN,LDN, [lisa@lisahelmly.com**](http://lisa@lisahelmly.com**/)

*   Holy Fire III/Karuna Reiki Master
*   Certified Kundalini Reiki Practitioner
*   Certified Access Bars Practitioner
*   Passionate about inspiring people to optimize their health and wellbeing.
*   Small changes yield big results.

As a Low Country Native, Lisa is enthused to share complimentary integrated healing and restorative modalities to promote optimal health and well-being. Holding a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration equipped Lisa to gain experience in the corporate environment, flip residential housing properties, and continue managing her rental property business. Completing a Master of Science in Nutrition as a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist prepared Lisa for working in the medical sector assisting patients with a variety of illnesses, disease states, and conditions. During this time to the present, Lisa pursued further studies in alternative and integrative health practices attaining multiple credentials. While working in these areas, Lisa continued serving in her roles as a mother, daughter, sister, and friend.

**Sounds Productive Right? Does Being More Productive Support Health and Well-Being?**

“Getting busier does not necessarily make you better…affectively managing your stress does!”

You really didn’t think all of that activity was done perfectly with complete ease and grace, did you? Of course not. As Lisa was stressed out creating elevated levels of cortisol and adrenaline, this lack of balance was in opposition to a positive state of health and well-being. How ironic is that behavior? Lisa more fully understands how stress and being out of balance can have a negative impact on the mind and body. Sometimes the vehicle that drives a person to do, may eventually run them over. Hypothetically speaking, imagine being in a hit and run accident driven by yourself in your very own car. Can you relate now? The coping mechanism of burning the candle at both ends is comfortable because it is familiar. However, the candle may eventually burn out.
 If there is one commonality that we all have in this human experience, it’s managing our own life stressors. Add a dose or two of trauma along the way and what do you get…**Amplified Stress with Triggers.** The well-being sessions are offered here for interested participants to explore complementary and integrative approaches on processing and managing stress to ultimately feel and function better. You are invited to take this peaceful exploration on optimizing your own health and happiness.

title: 中国在老挝建空军“据点”，东南亚要倒向北京？美学者：没那么简单

content: * 原文作者：Lucas Myers * 本文系编译，请在这里阅读原文完整内容：https://warontherocks.com/chinas-military-expansion-in-southeast-asia-masks-a-more-complicated-reality/ 一条尚在施工的2000米跑道，停着8架轻型攻击机，这是卫星图像中的老挝班根（Ban Keun）机场。9月29日，中国国防部宣布在此设立“联合保障与训练中心”，并称其“不针对任何第三方”。 班根机场仍是中国首个公开承认、以空中力量为核心的海外军事设施。东南亚是否正在倒向北京？一位美国学者的回答是：没那么简单。 美国马里兰大学公共政策学院中美项目副主任卢卡斯·迈尔斯（Lucas Myers）10月15日在《War on the Rocks》撰文指出，中国在该地区的军事存在确实在扩大。但各国与北京走近，更多是出于政权安全和区域内部矛盾，而不是冷战式的选边站队。 文章指出，班根机场与吉布提基地、柬埔寨云壤海军基地（Ream Naval Base）一道，成为中国海外安全设施网络的新节点，可能增强中国的后勤与情报能力。军售方面，中国已取代美国成为泰国最大的武器供应方。北京最突出的优势是为威权伙伴提供“政权安全”。 柬埔寨、老挝、缅甸军政府和越南都已加入“全球安全倡议”（Global Security Initiative）。2026年，中国与柬、老、越三国的“2+2”对话又升级为纳入内政安全部门的“3+3”机制。 不过，民意数据起伏很大。新加坡智库东南亚研究所（ISEAS）的年度精英调查显示，在被迫选边的情况下，2024年中国以50.5%领先，2025年多数人转向美国，2026年天平又回到北京。 迈尔斯认为，这些起伏多是对美国支持以色列、南海局势升温等具体事件的即时反应，并不代表持久的阵营转移。 在作者看来，各国都有自己的算盘。老挝与中国同为共产党执政，并不把北京视为威胁。柬埔寨则提防越南和泰国两个邻国，2025年柬泰曾因边界争端爆发短暂而激烈的冲突。但金边也不愿全盘押注北京，美柬计划在中断十年后于2027年恢复联合军演。 泰国同样心存芥蒂。柬军在战场上使用中国武器，令曼谷不满。2025年打击诈骗园区期间，一名中国高级官员亲自督办经泰国遣返被拘中国公民，引发主权争议，事后为“误会”致歉。调查显示，90.6%的泰国受访者担忧中国的影响力。 越南的情况最耐人寻味。对外，河内忌惮北京，两国1979年曾兵戎相见，越南因此与美国走近。对内，越共总书记苏林（To Lam）却务实地深化与中国的内部安全合作。文章点出了其中的逻辑：中国大概不会推翻越共，但一场革命可能会。 迈尔斯建议，美国应放弃对柬埔寨那种收效甚微的制裁，转而因国施策：加大对债务沉重的老挝的发展援助，与泰国合作打击跨国犯罪，加快对越军售审批。他总结说，东南亚国家或许不信任美国，但没有哪个政府希望美国离开。
